```html
    .categoria-select {
        padding: 8px 12px;
        border-radius: 20px;
        background: #1a1a1a;
        color: #a0a0a0;
        border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }

    .modal-overlay {
        display: none;
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
        z-index: 1000;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .modal-overlay.show {
        display: flex;
    }

    .modal-content {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 16px;
        padding: 24px;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 400px;
    }

    .modal-content h3 {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .modal-content .form-group {
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .modal-content label {
        display: block;
        color: #a0a0a0;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .modal-content input, .modal-content select {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 12px;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
        border-radius: 8px;
        color: #f5f5f5;
    }

    .modal-actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: 12px;
        margin-top: 20px;
    }

    .modal-actions button {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 12px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: none;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .btn-cancel {
        background: #374151;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-confirm {
        background: #10b981;
        color: #fff;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
        .page-container {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.index') }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1><i class="fas fa-file-invoice"></i> Contas a Pagar</h1>
        </div>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.nova_conta_pagar') }}" class="btn-add">
            <i class="fas fa-plus"></i>
        </a>
    </div>

    <div class="kpi-grid">
        <div class="kpi-card red">
            <div class="kpi-label">Vencidas</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(total_vencidas) }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card yellow">
            <div class="kpi-label">Prox. 7 dias</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(total_7_dias) }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card blue">
            <div class="kpi-label">Este Mes</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(total_mes) }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-bar">
        {% if categoria_filter %}
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar', status='pending', categoria=categoria_filter) }}" class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'pending' else '' }}">Pendentes</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar', status='overdue', categoria=categoria_filter) }}" class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'overdue' else '' }}">Vencidas</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar', status='paid', categoria=categoria_filter) }}" class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'paid' else '' }}">Pagas</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar', status='all', categoria=categoria_filter) }}" class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'all' else '' }}">Todas</a>
        {% else %}
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar', status='pending') }}" class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'pending' else '' }}">Pendentes</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar', status='overdue') }}" class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'overdue' else '' }}">Vencidas</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar', status='paid') }}" class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'paid' else '' }}">Pagas</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar', status='all') }}" class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'all' else '' }}">Todas</a>
        {% endif %}
        <select class="categoria-select" onchange="handleCategoriaChange(this.value)">
            <option value="">Todas Categorias</option>
            {% for cat in categorias %}
            <option value="{{ cat }}" {{ 'selected' if categoria_filter == cat else '' }}>{{ cat|replace('_', ' ')|title }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
        </select>
    </div>
    <script>
    function handleCategoriaChange(categoria) {
        var baseUrl = '{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar') }}';
        var status = '{{ status_filter }}';
        var params = [];
        if (status) params.push('status=' + encodeURIComponent(status));
        if (categoria) params.push('categoria=' + encodeURIComponent(categoria));
        window.location.href = baseUrl + (params.length ? '?' + params.join('&') : '');
    }
    </script>

    <div class="folders-section">
        <div class="section-title">
            <i class="fas fa-calendar-alt"></i> 
            {% if qtd_vencidas > 0 %}
                Contas por Mes <span class="badge-overdue">{{ qtd_vencidas }} vencida{{ 's' if qtd_vencidas > 1 else '' }}</span>
            {% else %}
                Proximos 12 Meses
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        {% for mes_key, pasta in pastas.items() %}
        <div class="folder-card {{ 'overdue' if pasta.state == 'overdue' else '' }} {{ 'empty' if pasta.qtd == 0 else '' }}">
            <div class="folder-header" onclick="toggleFolder('{{ mes_key }}')">
                <div class="folder-info">
                    <div class="folder-icon">
                        {% if pasta.state == 'overdue' %}
                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
                        {% else %}
                        <i class="fas fa-folder{{ '-open' if mes_key == mes_atual_key else '' }}"></i>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <div class="folder-name">
                            {{ pasta.label }}
                            {% if pasta.state == 'overdue' %}
                            <span class="badge-overdue">Vencida</span>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                        <div class="folder-stats">
                            <span class="qtd">{{ pasta.qtd }} conta{{ 's' if pasta.qtd != 1 else '' }}</span>
                            {% if pasta.qtd > 0 %}
                            <span class="total">R$ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(pasta.total).replace(",", ".") }}</span>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="folder-toggle" id="icon-{{ mes_key }}">▼</div>
            </div>
            <div class="folder-content" id="content-{{ mes_key }}">
                <div class="folder-content-inner">
                    {% if pasta.contas %}
                        {% for conta in pasta.contas %}
                        {% set dias_ate = (conta.due_date - today).days if conta.due_date else 999 %}
                        <div class="conta-item {{ 'urgente' if dias_ate < 0 else 'atencao' if dias_ate <= 7 else 'ok' }}">
                            <div class="conta-desc">
                                <h5>{{ conta.description[:40] }}{% if conta.description|length > 40 %}...{% endif %}</h5>
                                <p>{{ conta.supplier or conta.category }}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="conta-right">
                                <div class="amount">R$ {{ "{:,.2f}".format(conta.amount).replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".") }}</div>
                                <div class="due">{{ conta.due_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</div>
                                <div class="conta-actions-mini">
                                    <button class="btn-mini pagar" onclick="abrirModalPagar({{ conta.id }}, '{{ conta.description[:30] }}', {{ conta.amount }})">Pagar</button>
                                    <a href="{{ url_for('financial.editar_conta_pagar', id=conta.id) }}" class="btn-mini editar">Editar</a>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    {% else %}
                        <div class="empty-folder">
                            <i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> Nenhuma conta para este mes
                        </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>

    {% if anos_repositorio %}
    <a href="{{ url_for('financial.repositorio_contas') }}" class="repositorio-link">
        <i class="fas fa-archive"></i>
        <h4>Repositorio de Contas Pagas</h4>
        <span>Anos: {{ anos_repositorio|join(', ') }}</span>
    </a>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="modalPagar">
    <div class="modal-content">
        <h3><i class="fas fa-check-circle" style="color: #10b981;"></i> Registrar Pagamento</h3>
        <form id="formPagar" method="post">
            <input type="hidden" id="conta_id" name="conta_id">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label>Conta</label>
                <input type="text" id="conta_desc" readonly style="color: #888;">
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label>Valor Pago</label>
                <input type="number" step="0.01" name="valor_pago" id="valor_pago" required>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label>Data do Pagamento</label>
                <input type="date" name="data_pagamento" id="data_pagamento" required>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-actions">
                <button type="button" class="btn-cancel" onclick="fecharModal()">Cancelar</button>
                <button type="submit" class="btn-confirm">Confirmar</button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
function toggleFolder(folderId) {
    const content = document.getElementById('content-' + folderId);
    const icon = document.getElementById('icon-' + folderId);
    
    if (content.classList.contains('expanded')) {
        content.classList.remove('expanded');
        icon.classList.remove('expanded');
    } else {
        content.classList.add('expanded');
        icon.classList.add('expanded');
    }
}

function abrirModalPagar(id, desc, valor) {
    document.getElementById('conta_id').value = id;
    document.getElementById('conta_desc').value = desc;
    document.getElementById('valor_pago').value = valor.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById('data_pagamento').value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    document.getElementById('formPagar').action = '/financial/contas-pagar/' + id + '/pagar';
    document.getElementById('modalPagar').classList.add('show');
}

function fecharModal() {
    document.getElementById('modalPagar').classList.remove('show');
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const mesAtualKey = '{{ mes_atual_key }}';
    const contentAtual = document.getElementById('content-' + mesAtualKey);
    const iconAtual = document.getElementById('icon-' + mesAtualKey);
    if (contentAtual && iconAtual) {
        contentAtual.classList.add('expanded');
        iconAtual.classList.add('expanded');
    }
    
    {% if contas_vencidas %}
    const contentVencidas = document.getElementById('content-vencidas');
    const iconVencidas = document.getElementById('icon-vencidas');
    if (contentVencidas && iconVencidas) {
        contentVencidas.classList.add('expanded');
        iconVencidas.classList.add('expanded');
    }
    {% endif %}
});
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.index') }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1><i class="fas fa-hand-holding-usd"></i> Contas a Receber</h1>
        </div>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.nova_conta_receber') }}" class="btn-add">
            <i class="fas fa-plus"></i>
        </a>
    </div>

    <div class="kpi-grid">
        <div class="kpi-card green">
            <div class="kpi-label">Vencidas</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(total_vencidas) if total_vencidas else '0' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card yellow">
            <div class="kpi-label">Prox. 7 dias</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(total_7_dias) if total_7_dias else '0' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card blue">
            <div class="kpi-label">Este mes</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(total_mes) if total_mes else '0' }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-bar">
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_receber', status='pending') }}" 
           class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'pending' else '' }}">Pendentes</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_receber', status='overdue') }}" 
           class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'overdue' else '' }}">Vencidas</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_receber', status='received') }}" 
           class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'received' else '' }}">Recebidas</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_receber', status='all') }}" 
           class="filter-btn {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'all' else '' }}">Todas</a>
    </div>

    <div class="list-section">
        {% if contas %}
            {% for conta in contas %}
            <div class="conta-card {{ 'recebido' if conta.status == 'received' else 'urgente' if conta.days_until_due < 0 else 'atencao' if conta.days_until_due < 7 else 'ok' }}">
                <div class="conta-header">
                    <div class="conta-info">
                        <h4>
                            {{ conta.client_name if conta.client_name else 'Cliente' }}
                            {% if conta.total_installments and conta.total_installments > 1 %}
                                <span class="badge-rec" style="background: rgba(14,165,233,0.2); color: #38bdf8;">{{ conta.installment_number }}/{{ conta.total_installments }}</span>
                            {% endif %}
                            {% if conta.status == 'received' %}<span class="badge-paid">RECEBIDO</span>{% endif %}
                        </h4>
                        <p>{{ conta.description }}</p>
                        {% if conta.category %}
                        <p style="color: #666; font-size: 0.75rem;">{{ conta.category|capitalize }}</p>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <div class="conta-value">
                        <div class="amount">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(conta.amount) }}</div>
                        <div class="date {{ 'overdue' if conta.days_until_due < 0 and conta.status == 'pending' else '' }}">
                            {% if conta.status == 'received' %}
                                Recebido em {{ conta.received_at.strftime('%d/%m') if conta.received_at else '-' }}
                            {% elif conta.days_until_due < 0 %}
                                Vencida ha {{ conta.days_until_due|abs }} dias
                            {% elif conta.days_until_due == 0 %}
                                Vence HOJE
                            {% else %}
                                Vence {{ conta.due_date.strftime('%d/%m') }}
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                {% if conta.status == 'pending' %}
                <div class="conta-actions">
                    <button class="btn-receber" data-id="{{ conta.id }}" data-desc="{{ conta.description|e }}" data-amount="{{ conta.amount }}" onclick="openReceiveModal(this)">
                        <i class="fas fa-check"></i> Receber
                    </button>
                    <form action="{{ url_for('financial.excluir_conta_receber', id=conta.id) }}" method="POST" style="display:inline;" 
                          onsubmit="return confirm('Cancelar esta conta?')">
                        <button type="submit" class="btn-excluir">
                            <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                        </button>
                    </form>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        {% else %}
            <div class="empty-state">
                <i class="fas fa-hand-holding-usd" style="font-size: 3rem;"></i>
                <h3>Nenhuma conta encontrada</h3>
                <p><a href="{{ url_for('financial.nova_conta_receber') }}">Cadastrar primeira conta a receber</a></p>
            </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="receiveModal">
    <div class="modal-content">
        <h3><i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> Confirmar Recebimento</h3>
        <p id="receiveDescription" style="color: #888; margin-bottom: 16px;"></p>
        <form id="receiveForm" method="POST">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label>Valor Recebido</label>
                <input type="text" name="received_amount" id="receiveAmount" placeholder="0,00">
            </div>
            <div class="modal-actions">
                <button type="button" class="btn-cancel" onclick="closeReceiveModal()">Cancelar</button>
                <button type="submit" class="btn-confirm">Confirmar Recebimento</button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
function openReceiveModal(btn) {
    var id = btn.dataset.id;
    var desc = btn.dataset.desc;
    var amount = btn.dataset.amount;
    
    document.getElementById('receiveDescription').textContent = desc;
    document.getElementById('receiveAmount').value = parseFloat(amount).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
    document.getElementById('receiveForm').action = '/financial/contas-receber/' + id + '/receber';
    document.getElementById('receiveModal').classList.add('show');
}

function closeReceiveModal() {
    document.getElementById('receiveModal').classList.remove('show');
}

document.getElementById('receiveModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) closeReceiveModal();
});
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{{ 'Editar' if contract else 'Novo' }} Contrato - TOUR Manager{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-3">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h4 class="mb-0" style="color: #d4a574;">
            {{ 'Editar Contrato' if contract else 'Novo Contrato' }}
        </h4>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contracts') }}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm">
            Voltar
        </a>
    </div>

    <form method="POST" id="contractForm">
        <div class="card mb-3" style="background: #1a1a1a; border-color: #2a2a2a;">
            <div class="card-header" style="border-color: #2a2a2a;">
                <strong style="color: #d4a574;">Dados do Cliente</strong>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
                <div class="row">
                    <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Nome do Cliente *</label>
                        <input type="text" name="client_name" class="form-control" 
                               value="{{ contract.client_name if contract else '' }}" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">CPF/CNPJ</label>
                        <input type="text" name="client_document" class="form-control"
                               value="{{ contract.client_document if contract else '' }}">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="row">
                    <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Email</label>
                        <input type="email" name="client_email" class="form-control"
                               value="{{ contract.client_email if contract else '' }}">
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Telefone</label>
                        <input type="text" name="client_phone" class="form-control"
                               value="{{ contract.client_phone if contract else '' }}">
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Endereço</label>
                        <input type="text" name="client_address" class="form-control"
                               value="{{ contract.client_address if contract else '' }}">
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card mb-3" style="background: #1a1a1a; border-color: #2a2a2a;">
            <div class="card-header" style="border-color: #2a2a2a;">
                <strong style="color: #d4a574;">Detalhes do Contrato</strong>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
                <div class="row">
                    <div class="col-md-8 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Título do Contrato *</label>
                        <input type="text" name="title" class="form-control" 
                               value="{{ contract.title if contract else '' }}" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Código</label>
                        <input type="text" name="code" class="form-control" 
                               value="{{ contract.code if contract else '' }}" readonly
                               style="background: #0a0a0a;">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="row">
                    <div class="col-md-3 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Data Início *</label>
                        <input type="date" name="start_date" class="form-control" 
                               value="{{ contract.start_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if contract and contract.start_date else '' }}" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-3 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Data Fim *</label>
                        <input type="date" name="end_date" class="form-control" 
                               value="{{ contract.end_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if contract and contract.end_date else '' }}" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-3 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Valor Total *</label>
                        <input type="number" step="0.01" name="total_value" class="form-control" 
                               value="{{ contract.total_value if contract else '' }}" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-3 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Caução/Depósito</label>
                        <input type="number" step="0.01" name="deposit_value" class="form-control" 
                               value="{{ contract.deposit_value if contract else '0' }}">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="row">
                    <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Status</label>
                        <select name="status" class="form-select">
                            <option value="draft" {{ 'selected' if not contract or contract.status == 'draft' else '' }}>Rascunho</option>
                            <option value="active" {{ 'selected' if contract and contract.status == 'active' else '' }}>Ativo</option>
                            <option value="completed" {{ 'selected' if contract and contract.status == 'completed' else '' }}>Finalizado</option>
                            <option value="cancelled" {{ 'selected' if contract and contract.status == 'cancelled' else '' }}>Cancelado</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card mb-3" style="background: #1a1a1a; border-color: #2a2a2a;">
            <div class="card-header" style="border-color: #2a2a2a;">
                <strong style="color: #d4a574;">Termos e Condições</strong>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
                <div class="mb-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Descrição do Serviço</label>
                    <textarea name="service_description" class="form-control" rows="4"
                              placeholder="Descreva os serviços/equipamentos incluídos neste contrato...">{{ contract.service_description if contract and contract.service_description else '' }}</textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="mb-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Condições de Pagamento</label>
                    <textarea name="payment_terms" class="form-control" rows="3"
                              placeholder="Ex: 50% na assinatura, 50% na entrega...">{{ contract.payment_terms if contract and contract.payment_terms else '' }}</textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="mb-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Termos Adicionais</label>
                    <textarea name="additional_terms" class="form-control" rows="4"
                              placeholder="Condições especiais, penalidades, responsabilidades...">{{ contract.additional_terms if contract and contract.additional_terms else '' }}</textarea>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="d-flex gap-2 mb-4">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary flex-grow-1">
                Salvar Contrato
            </button>
            {% if contract %}
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-success" onclick="shareContract()">
                Compartilhar
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger" onclick="deleteContract()">
                Excluir
            </button>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        {% if request.args.get('continue_wizard') %}
        <div class="card mb-4" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4a574 0%, #c49464 100%); border: none;">
            <div class="card-body text-center py-4">
                <h5 class="text-dark mb-3">Contrato Criado!</h5>
                <p class="text-dark mb-3">Edite os detalhes acima, compartilhe com o cliente e depois continue a automação.</p>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-dark btn-lg" onclick="continueWizard()">
                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-right-circle"></i> Continuar Automação
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </form>
</div>

{% if contract %}
<div class="modal fade" id="shareModal" tabindex="-1">
    <div class="modal-dialog">
        <div class="modal-content" style="background: #1a1a1a; border: 2px solid #d4a574;">
            <div class="modal-header" style="border-color: #2a2a2a;">
                <h5 class="modal-title" style="color: #d4a574;">Compartilhar Contrato</h5>
                <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body text-center py-4">
                <div class="d-grid gap-3">
                    <a href="https://wa.me/?text={{ 'Contrato: ' ~ contract.title ~ ' - Valor: R$ ' ~ ("%.2f"|format(contract.total_value or 0)) | urlencode }}" 
                       target="_blank" class="btn btn-success btn-lg">
                        <i class="bi bi-whatsapp"></i> WhatsApp
                    </a>
                    <a href="mailto:{{ contract.client_email or '' }}?subject=Contrato {{ contract.code }}&body=Segue o contrato {{ contract.title }}" 
                       class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">
                        <i class="bi bi-envelope"></i> Email
                    </a>
                    <button onclick="window.print()" class="btn btn-secondary btn-lg">
                        <i class="bi bi-printer"></i> Imprimir/PDF
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/wizard.js') }}"></script>
<script>
function shareContract() {
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('shareModal')).show();
}

function deleteContract() {
    if (confirm('Tem certeza que deseja excluir este contrato?')) {
        fetch('{{ url_for("financial.contract_delete", contract_id=contract.id) }}', {
            method: 'POST'
        }).then(r => {
            if (r.ok) window.location.href = '{{ url_for("financial.contracts") }}';
        });
    }
}

function continueWizard() {
    const stateStr = sessionStorage.getItem('wizardState');
    if (!stateStr) {
        alert('Estado do wizard não encontrado. Redirecionando para orçamentos.');
        window.location.href = '/orcamento';
        return;
    }
    
    const state = JSON.parse(stateStr);
    sessionStorage.removeItem('wizardState');
    
    const wizard = new WizardController({
        onComplete: (data) => {
            showToast('Fluxo concluído com sucesso!', 'success');
            setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '/orcamento', 1500);
        }
    });

    wizard.addStep({
        title: 'Gerar Contas a Receber?',
        content: (data) => `
            <div class="text-center mb-4">
                <i class="bi bi-cash-stack" style="font-size: 3rem; color: #28a745;"></i>
            </div>
            <p class="text-center mb-3">Configurar parcelas do recebimento:</p>
            <div class="mb-3">
                <label class="form-label">Número de Parcelas</label>
                <select name="installments" class="form-select bg-dark text-white border-secondary">
                    <option value="1">À vista</option>
                    <option value="2">2x</option>
                    <option value="3">3x</option>
                    <option value="4">4x</option>
                    <option value="6">6x</option>
                    <option value="12">12x</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            <div class="mb-3">
                <label class="form-label">Primeiro Vencimento</label>
                <input type="date" name="first_due_date" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary" 
                       value="${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}">
            </div>`,
        endpoint: `/financial/contas-receber/from-quote/${state.quoteId}`
    });

    wizard.addStep({
        title: 'Registrar Evento',
        content: () => `
            <div class="text-center mb-4">
                <i class="bi bi-calendar-plus" style="font-size: 4rem; color: #d4a574;"></i>
            </div>
            <h4 class="text-center mb-4" style="color: #fff;">
                Adicionar <span style="color: #d4a574;">"${state.quoteName}"</span><br>em Eventos?
            </h4>
            <div class="d-flex gap-3 justify-content-center mt-4">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-lg px-5" id="btnEventoSim" 
                        style="background: #d4a574; color: #000; font-weight: 600;">
                    SIM
                </button>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-lg btn-outline-secondary px-5" id="btnEventoNao">
                    NÃO
                </button>
            </div>`,
        onEnter: () => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                const btnSim = document.getElementById('btnEventoSim');
                const btnNao = document.getElementById('btnEventoNao');
                const wizardNext = document.getElementById('wizardNext');
                const wizardPrev = document.getElementById('wizardPrev');
                const wizardClose = document.getElementById('wizardClose');
                
                if (wizardNext) wizardNext.style.display = 'none';
                if (wizardPrev) wizardPrev.style.display = 'none';
                if (wizardClose) wizardClose.style.display = 'none';
                
                if (btnSim) {
                    btnSim.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                        btnSim.disabled = true;
                        btnSim.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> Criando...';
                        try {
                            const response = await fetch('/api/automation/quote/' + state.quoteId + '/create-event', {
                                method: 'POST',
                                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                                body: JSON.stringify({ name: state.quoteName })
                            });
                            const result = await response.json();
                            if (result.success && result.data && result.data.tour_id) {
                                showToast('Evento criado!', 'success');
                                setTimeout(() => {
                                    window.location.href = '/tour/' + result.data.tour_id;
                                }, 800);
                            } else {
                                showToast(result.message || 'Erro ao criar evento', 'error');
                                btnSim.disabled = false;
                                btnSim.innerHTML = 'SIM';
                            }
                        } catch (e) {
                            showToast('Erro ao criar evento', 'error');
                            btnSim.disabled = false;
                            btnSim.innerHTML = 'SIM';
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                if (btnNao) {
                    btnNao.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        showToast('Orçamento aprovado!', 'success');
                        const modal = document.getElementById('wizardModal');
                        if (modal) modal.remove();
                        setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '/orcamento', 1000);
                    });
                }
            }, 100);
        }
    });

    wizard.setData('quote_id', state.quoteId);
    wizard.setData('contract_id', state.contractId);
    wizard.start();
}

function showToast(message, type) {
    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = `alert alert-${type === 'success' ? 'success' : 'danger'} position-fixed`;
    toast.style.cssText = 'top: 20px; right: 20px; z-index: 10000; animation: fadeIn 0.3s;';
    toast.textContent = message;
    document.body.appendChild(toast);
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 3000);
}
</script>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Contratos - TOUR Manager{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-3">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h4 class="mb-0" style="color: #d4a574;">Contratos</h4>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contract_new') }}" class="btn btn-primary">
            + Novo Contrato
        </a>
    </div>

    <div class="btn-group mb-3" role="group">
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contracts') }}" 
           class="btn btn-sm {{ 'btn-primary' if not request.args.get('status') else 'btn-outline-secondary' }}">
            Todos
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contracts', status='draft') }}" 
           class="btn btn-sm {{ 'btn-primary' if request.args.get('status') == 'draft' else 'btn-outline-secondary' }}">
            Rascunho
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contracts', status='active') }}" 
           class="btn btn-sm {{ 'btn-primary' if request.args.get('status') == 'active' else 'btn-outline-secondary' }}">
            Ativos
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contracts', status='completed') }}" 
           class="btn btn-sm {{ 'btn-primary' if request.args.get('status') == 'completed' else 'btn-outline-secondary' }}">
            Finalizados
        </a>
    </div>

    {% if contracts %}
    <div class="list-group">
        {% for contract in contracts %}
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contract_edit', contract_id=contract.id) }}" 
           class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" 
           style="background: #1a1a1a; border-color: #2a2a2a;">
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start">
                <div>
                    <h6 class="mb-1" style="color: #fff;">{{ contract.title }}</h6>
                    <small style="color: #a0a0a0;">
                        {{ contract.code }} | {{ contract.client_name }}
                    </small>
                </div>
                <div class="text-end">
                    <span class="badge 
                        {% if contract.status == 'draft' %}bg-secondary
                        {% elif contract.status == 'active' %}bg-success
                        {% elif contract.status == 'completed' %}bg-primary
                        {% else %}bg-warning{% endif %}">
                        {% if contract.status == 'draft' %}Rascunho
                        {% elif contract.status == 'active' %}Ativo
                        {% elif contract.status == 'completed' %}Finalizado
                        {% else %}{{ contract.status }}{% endif %}
                    </span>
                    <div class="mt-1" style="color: #d4a574; font-weight: 600;">
                        R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(contract.total_value or 0) }}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <small style="color: #666;">
                {{ contract.start_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if contract.start_date else '' }} 
                - {{ contract.end_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if contract.end_date else '' }}
            </small>
        </a>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <div class="text-center py-5" style="color: #a0a0a0;">
        <p>Nenhum contrato encontrado</p>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}

        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.index') }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1><i class="fas fa-arrow-down"></i> Despesas</h1>
            <p>Visao geral de gastos</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="kpi-grid">
        <div class="kpi-card red">
            <div class="kpi-label">Total Mes</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(total_mes).replace(",", ".") }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card orange">
            <div class="kpi-label">Folha CLT</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(folha_clt).replace(",", ".") }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card yellow">
            <div class="kpi-label">Contas Pagas</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(contas_fixas).replace(",", ".") }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card purple">
            <div class="kpi-label">Manutencao</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(manutencao).replace(",", ".") }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card green" style="grid-column: span 2;">
            <div class="kpi-label">Freelancers</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">R$ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(freelancers_total).replace(",", ".") }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="action-grid">
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.folha_clt') }}" class="action-btn blue">
            <i class="fas fa-user-tie"></i>
            <span>Folha</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.freelancers') }}" class="action-btn green">
            <i class="fas fa-user-friends"></i>
            <span>Freelancers</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar') }}" class="action-btn orange">
            <i class="fas fa-file-invoice"></i>
            <span>Contas</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('maintenance.index') }}" class="action-btn purple">
            <i class="fas fa-tools"></i>
            <span>Manutencao</span>
        </a>
    </div>

    <h4 class="section-title">Ultimas Despesas</h4>

    <div class="list-card">
        {% if ultimas_despesas and ultimas_despesas|length > 0 %}
            {% for despesa in ultimas_despesas %}
            <div class="list-item">
                <div class="icon">
                    {% if despesa.tipo == 'freelancer' %}
                        🎯
                    {% elif despesa.tipo == 'conta' %}
                        💡
                    {% elif despesa.tipo == 'manutencao' %}
                        🔧
                    {% elif despesa.tipo == 'folha' %}
                        👔
                    {% else %}
                        📋
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                <div class="info">
                    <h4>{{ despesa.categoria }}</h4>
                    <p>{{ despesa.descricao[:40] }}{% if despesa.descricao|length > 40 %}...{% endif %}</p>
                </div>
                <div class="value">
                    <div class="amount">R$ {{ "{:,.2f}".format(despesa.valor).replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".") }}</div>
                    <div class="date">{{ despesa.data.strftime('%d/%m') }}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        {% else %}
            <div class="empty-state">
                <i class="fas fa-inbox"></i>
                <p>Nenhuma despesa registrada este mes</p>
            </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}DRE - Financeiro{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .page-container {
        padding: 0;
        min-height: 100vh;
        padding-bottom: 90px;
        background-color: #0a0a0a;
    }

    .page-header {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(100,116,139,0.3) 0%, rgba(26,26,26,0.95) 100%);
        padding: 20px 16px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 16px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    }

    .back-btn {
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        color: #d4a574;
        text-decoration: none;
    }

    .page-title h1 {
        font-size: 1.5rem;

        margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .page-title p {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .summary-cards {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 12px;
        margin: 16px;
    }

    .summary-card {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 16px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .summary-card.receitas {
        border-top: 3px solid #10b981;
    }

    .summary-card.despesas {
        border-top: 3px solid #ef4444;
    }

    .summary-card.lucro {
        border-top: 3px solid #3b82f6;
    }

    .summary-label {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        color: #888;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .summary-value {
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #f5f5f5;
    }

    .dre-card {
        margin: 16px;
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 20px;
        border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    }

    .dre-section {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .dre-section-title {
        color: #10b981;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
    }

    .dre-section-title.despesas {
        color: #ef4444;
    }

    .dre-section-title.pessoal {
        color: #8b5cf6;
    }

    .dre-section-title.impostos {
        color: #f59e0b;
    }

    .dre-item {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 12px;
        background: #252525;
        border-radius: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .dre-item .label {
        color: #a0a0a0;
    }

    .dre-item .value {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .dre-item .value.receita {
        color: #10b981;
    }

        color: #ef4444;
    }

    .dre-item.pendente {
        background: rgba(245,158,11,0.1);
        border: 1px dashed #f59e0b;
    }

    }

    .dre-item.sub-item {

    }

    }

    .dre-subtotal .dre-item {

    }

    .dre-subtotal .label {
        color: #8b5cf6;

    }

        text-align: center;
        padding: 40px;
        color: #666;
    }

{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.index') }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1><i class="fas fa-file-contract"></i> DRE</h1>
            <p>Demonstrativo de Resultado - {{ mes_atual }}</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="summary-cards">
        <div class="summary-card receitas">
            <div class="summary-label">Receitas</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(total_receitas) }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-card despesas">
            <div class="summary-label">Despesas</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(total_despesas) }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-card lucro">
            <div class="summary-label">Resultado</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(lucro) }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="dre-card">
        <!-- RECEITAS -->
        <div class="dre-section">
            <div class="dre-section-title">
                <i class="fas fa-arrow-up"></i> RECEITAS
            </div>
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">Recebimentos do mes</span>
                <span class="value receita">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(receitas_locacao) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% if receitas_pendentes > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item pendente">
                <span class="label">Pendente de recebimento</span>
                <span class="value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(receitas_pendentes) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        <!-- CUSTOS COM PESSOAL -->
        <div class="dre-section">
            <div class="dre-section-title pessoal">
                <i class="fas fa-users"></i> CUSTOS COM PESSOAL
            </div>

            {% if despesas_folha > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">Salarios (Folha CLT)</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_folha) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if despesas_adiantamento is defined and despesas_adiantamento > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item sub-item">
                <span class="label">Adiantamentos pagos</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_adiantamento) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if despesas_13 is defined and despesas_13 > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item sub-item">
                <span class="label">13o Salario</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_13) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if despesas_ferias is defined and despesas_ferias > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item sub-item">
                <span class="label">Ferias</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_ferias) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if despesas_freelancers > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">Freelancers</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_freelancers) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% set total_pessoal = (despesas_folha|float) + (despesas_freelancers|float) + (despesas_adiantamento|default(0)|float) + (despesas_13|default(0)|float) + (despesas_ferias|default(0)|float) %}
            {% if total_pessoal > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-subtotal">
                <div class="dre-item">
                    <span class="label">Subtotal Pessoal</span>
                    <span class="value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(total_pessoal) }}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        <!-- IMPOSTOS E ENCARGOS -->
        {% if despesas_inss is defined or despesas_fgts is defined or despesas_irrf is defined %}
        <div class="dre-section">
            <div class="dre-section-title impostos">
                <i class="fas fa-landmark"></i> IMPOSTOS E ENCARGOS
            </div>

            {% if despesas_inss is defined and despesas_inss > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">INSS</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_inss) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if despesas_fgts is defined and despesas_fgts > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">FGTS</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_fgts) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if despesas_irrf is defined and despesas_irrf > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">IRRF</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_irrf) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
        {% endif %}

        <!-- OUTRAS DESPESAS -->
        <div class="dre-section">
            <div class="dre-section-title despesas">
                <i class="fas fa-arrow-down"></i> OUTRAS DESPESAS
            </div>

            {% if despesas_contas > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">Contas Pagas</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_contas) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if despesas_manutencao is defined and despesas_manutencao > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">Manutencao</span>
                <span class="value despesa">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_manutencao) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if despesas_pendentes > 0 %}
            <div class="dre-item pendente">
                <span class="label">Pendente de pagamento</span>
                <span class="value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(despesas_pendentes) }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if despesas_folha == 0 and despesas_contas == 0 and despesas_freelancers == 0 and (despesas_manutencao is not defined or despesas_manutencao == 0) %}
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">Nenhuma despesa registrada</span>
                <span class="value">R$ 0,00</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        <!-- RESULTADO -->
        <div class="dre-total">
            <div class="dre-item">
                <span class="label">RESULTADO DO MES</span>
                <span class="value {{ 'positivo' if lucro >= 0 else 'negativo' }}">
                    R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(lucro) }}
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.view_invoice', id=invoice.id) }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1><i class="fas fa-file-invoice"></i> Emitir NFSe</h1>
            <p>{{ invoice.code }}</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Info da Fatura -->
    <div class="info-card">
        <h3><i class="fas fa-receipt"></i> Dados da Fatura</h3>
        <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">Cliente</span>
            <span class="info-value">{{ invoice.client_name }}</span>
        </div>
        {% if invoice.client_document %}
        <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">CPF/CNPJ</span>
            <span class="info-value">{{ invoice.client_document }}</span>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
        <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">Valor</span>
            <span class="info-value total">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(invoice.total|float) }}</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    {% if not invoice.client_document %}
    <div class="alert-warning">
        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
        <strong>Atencao:</strong> O CPF/CNPJ do cliente nao esta preenchido. 
        Algumas prefeituras exigem este dado para emissao da NFSe.
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="alert-info">
        <i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i>
        A NFSe sera agendada e emitida automaticamente pelo Asaas. 
        Voce pode acompanhar o status na tela da fatura.
    </div>

    <form method="POST" id="nfseForm">
        <!-- Servico Municipal -->
        <div class="form-card">
            <h3><i class="fas fa-list-alt"></i> Servico Municipal</h3>

            {% if services %}
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Selecione o servico</label>
                <select name="service_id" id="serviceSelect" class="form-control" onchange="updateServiceInfo()">
                    <option value="">-- Selecione --</option>
                    {% for service in services %}
                    <option value="{{ service.id }}" 
                            data-code="{{ service.code }}" 
                            data-name="{{ service.description }}">
                        {{ service.code }} - {{ service.description }}
                    </option>
                    {% endfor %}
                </select>
            </div>
            <input type="hidden" name="service_code" id="serviceCode">
            <input type="hidden" name="service_name" id="serviceName">

            <div id="selectedServiceInfo" class="selected-service" style="display: none;">
                <div class="label">Servico selecionado:</div>
                <div class="value" id="selectedServiceText"></div>
            </div>
            {% else %}
            <div class="alert-warning" style="margin: 0;">
                <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
                Nenhum servico municipal encontrado. Configure os servicos no painel do Asaas 
                ou informe o codigo manualmente abaixo.
            </div>

            <div class="form-group" style="margin-top: 16px;">
                <label class="form-label">Codigo do servico (manual)</label>
                <input type="text" name="service_code" class="form-control" 
                       placeholder="Ex: 1.01, 7.02">
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Nome do servico</label>
                <input type="text" name="service_name" class="form-control" 
                       placeholder="Ex: Analise e desenvolvimento de sistemas">
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        <!-- Descricao -->
        <div class="form-card">
            <h3><i class="fas fa-align-left"></i> Descricao do Servico</h3>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Discriminacao dos servicos</label>
                <textarea name="service_description" class="form-control" required
                          placeholder="Descreva os servicos prestados...">{{ invoice.description or ('Servicos de locacao de equipamentos conforme fatura ' + invoice.code) }}</textarea>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Observacoes (opcional)</label>
                <textarea name="observations" class="form-control" 
                          placeholder="Informacoes adicionais..."></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Impostos -->
        <div class="form-card">
            <h3><i class="fas fa-calculator"></i> Impostos (%)</h3>

            <div class="tax-grid">
                <div class="tax-item">
                    <label>ISS</label>
                    <input type="number" name="iss" step="0.01" value="{{ invoice.tax_percent or 5 }}" min="0" max="100">
                </div>
                <div class="tax-item">
                    <label>COFINS</label>
                    <input type="number" name="cofins" step="0.01" value="0" min="0" max="100">
                </div>
                <div class="tax-item">
                    <label>CSLL</label>
                    <input type="number" name="csll" step="0.01" value="0" min="0" max="100">
                </div>
                <div class="tax-item">
                    <label>INSS</label>
                    <input type="number" name="inss" step="0.01" value="0" min="0" max="100">
                </div>
                <div class="tax-item">
                    <label>IR</label>
                    <input type="number" name="ir" step="0.01" value="0" min="0" max="100">
                </div>
                <div class="tax-item">
                    <label>PIS</label>
                    <input type="number" name="pis" step="0.01" value="0" min="0" max="100">
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="checkbox-group">
                <input type="checkbox" name="retain_iss" id="retainIss">
                <label for="retainIss">Reter ISS na fonte</label>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div style="padding: 0 16px 16px;">
            <button type="submit" class="btn-emitir" id="btnEmitir">
                <i class="fas fa-file-invoice"></i>
                Emitir NFSe
            </button>
        </div>
    </form>
</div>

<script>
function updateServiceInfo() {
    const select = document.getElementById('serviceSelect');
    const option = select.options[select.selectedIndex];

    if (option.value) {
        document.getElementById('serviceCode').value = option.dataset.code;
        document.getElementById('serviceName').value = option.dataset.name;
        document.getElementById('selectedServiceText').textContent = option.dataset.code + ' - ' + option.dataset.name;
        document.getElementById('selectedServiceInfo').style.display = 'block';
    } else {
        document.getElementById('serviceCode').value = '';
        document.getElementById('serviceName').value = '';
        document.getElementById('selectedServiceInfo').style.display = 'none';
    }
}

document.getElementById('nfseForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('btnEmitir');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Emitindo...';
});
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
    }

        color: #666;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
    }

        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.index') }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1><i class="fas fa-user-tie"></i> Folha CLT</h1>
            <small style="color:#888;">Visualizacao - Editar no RH</small>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="summary-card">
        <div class="summary-label">Custo Total Mensal - {{ ['Janeiro', 'Fevereiro', 'Marco', 'Abril', 'Maio', 'Junho', 'Julho', 'Agosto', 'Setembro', 'Outubro', 'Novembro', 'Dezembro'][mes-1] }}/{{ ano }}</div>
        <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(custo_total) }}</div>
        <div class="summary-grid">
            <div class="summary-item">
                <div class="label">SALARIOS</div>
                <div class="value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(total_salarios) }}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="summary-item">
                <div class="label">ENCARGOS (~68%)</div>
                <div class="value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(encargos_estimados) }}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="summary-item">
                <div class="label">FUNCIONARIOS</div>
                <div class="value">{{ funcionarios|length }}</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="list-section">
        {% if funcionarios %}
            {% for func in funcionarios %}
            <a href="{{ url_for('rh.view_employee', id=func.id) }}" class="funcionario-card" style="display:block; text-decoration:none;">
                <div class="funcionario-header">
                    <div>
                        <div class="funcionario-name">{{ func.name }}</div>
                        <div class="funcionario-cargo">{{ func.position or 'Tecnico' }}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="funcionario-liquido">
                        <div class="value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(func.custo_total) }}</div>
                        <div class="label">Custo Total</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="deducoes-grid">
                    <div class="deducao-item">
                        <div class="label">Salario</div>
                        <div class="value">{{ "%.0f"|format(func.salary) }}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="deducao-item">
                        <div class="label">Admissao</div>
                        <div class="value">{{ func.admission_date.strftime('%m/%Y') if func.admission_date else '-' }}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="deducao-item">
                        <div class="label">Prox. Ferias</div>
                        <div class="value">{{ func.prox_ferias.strftime('%m/%Y') if func.prox_ferias else '-' }}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </a>
            {% endfor %}
        {% else %}
            <div class="empty-state">
                <i class="fas fa-user-tie"></i>
                <p>Nenhum funcionario CLT cadastrado</p>
                <a href="{{ url_for('rh.new_employee') }}" class="btn-holerite" style="display:inline-block; margin-top:16px; text-decoration:none;">
                    <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Cadastrar no RH
                </a>
            </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
    
    <div style="padding:0 16px 24px;">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.employees') }}" class="btn-holerite" style="display:block; text-align:center; text-decoration:none;">
            <i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i> Gerenciar no RH
        </a>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
            <h1><i class="fas fa-qrcode"></i> Gerar PIX</h1>

    <div class="form-card">
        <form method="POST">
            <div class="form-group">

            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <select class="form-control" name="fatura_id">
                    <option value="">Vincular a fatura...</option>
                    {% for fatura in faturas %}
                    <option value="{{ fatura.id }}">{{ fatura.code }} - R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(fatura.total|float) }}</option>
                    {% endfor %}
                </select>
            </div>
            <button type="submit" class="btn-gerar">Gerar QR Code</button>
        </form>

        <div class="qr-section">
            <div class="qr-placeholder">
                <span>QR Code</span>
            </div>
            <div class="pix-code">
                00020126360014BR.GOV.BCB.PIX...
            </div>
            <button class="btn-copiar" onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText('00020126360014BR.GOV.BCB.PIX...')">
                Copiar Codigo
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="fin-container">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('dashboard') }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1><i class="fas fa-chart-line"></i> Financeiro</h1>
            <p>{{ date.today().strftime('%B/%Y') }}</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- KPIs 2x2 -->
    <div class="kpi-grid">
        <div class="kpi-card green">
            <div class="kpi-label">Receitas</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">{{ "%.0f"|format(faturamento_mes/1000) }}k</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub">este mes</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card red">
            <div class="kpi-label">Despesas</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">{{ "%.0f"|format(despesas_mes/1000) }}k</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub">este mes</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card blue">
            <div class="kpi-label">Lucro</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">{{ "%.0f"|format(lucro_mes/1000) }}k</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub">liquido</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card purple">
            <div class="kpi-label">Margem</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">{{ "%.0f"|format(margem) }}%</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub">meta 35%</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Card Cobrancas Pendentes -->
    {% if cobrancas_qtd and cobrancas_qtd > 0 %}
    <a href="{{ url_for('financial.cobrancas_pendentes') }}" class="cobrancas-card" style="text-decoration: none;">
        <div class="cobrancas-icon">
            <i class="fas fa-credit-card"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="cobrancas-info">
            <div class="cobrancas-title">
                Cobrancas Pendentes
                <span class="cobrancas-badge">{{ cobrancas_qtd }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="cobrancas-value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(cobrancas_total) }}</div>
            <div class="cobrancas-sub">PIX/Boleto aguardando</div>
        </div>
        <div class="cobrancas-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
        </div>
    </a>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Grafico Fluxo de Caixa -->
    <div class="chart-section">
        <div class="chart-header">
            <h3 class="chart-title"><i class="fas fa-chart-area"></i> Fluxo de Caixa</h3>
            <div class="period-pills">
                <button class="period-pill" onclick="changePeriod('diario')">D</button>
                <button class="period-pill" onclick="changePeriod('semanal')">S</button>
                <button class="period-pill active" onclick="changePeriod('mensal')">M</button>
                <button class="period-pill" onclick="changePeriod('anual')">A</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        <canvas id="fluxo-canvas"></canvas>
    </div>

    <!-- Contas a Vencer -->
    <div class="section-header">
        <h4 class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i> Contas a Vencer</h4>
    </div>
    <div class="pending-list">
        {% if pending_accounts %}
            {% for conta in pending_accounts[:3] %}
            <div class="pending-item {{ conta.badge_class }}">
                <div class="pending-info">
                    <h4>{{ conta.description[:25] }}{% if conta.description|length > 25 %}...{% endif %}</h4>
                    <p>{{ conta.days_left }}d - R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(conta.amount) }}</p>
                </div>
                <span class="pending-badge {{ conta.badge_class }}">{{ conta.badge }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
            {% if pending_accounts|length > 3 %}
            <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar') }}" style="display: block; text-align: center; color: #d4a574; font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 10px; text-decoration: none;">
                Ver todas ({{ pending_accounts|length }}) <i class="fas fa-arrow-right"></i>
            </a>
            {% endif %}
        {% else %}
            <div class="empty-msg">Nenhuma conta nos proximos 7 dias</div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    <!-- Acoes Rapidas -->
    <div class="section-header">
        <h4 class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> Acoes Rapidas</h4>
    </div>
    <div class="actions-grid">
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.receitas') }}" class="action-item receitas">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-up"></i>
            <span>Receitas</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar') }}" class="action-item despesas">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-down"></i>
            <span>Despesas</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_pagar') }}" class="action-item pagar">
            <i class="fas fa-file-invoice"></i>
            <span>A Pagar</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.contas_receber') }}" class="action-item receber">
            <i class="fas fa-hand-holding-usd"></i>
            <span>A Receber</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.folha_clt') }}" class="action-item folha">
            <i class="fas fa-user-tie"></i>
            <span>Folha</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.freelancers') }}" class="action-item freelancers">
            <i class="fas fa-user-clock"></i>
            <span>Freelancer</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.clientes') }}" class="action-item clientes">
            <i class="fas fa-users"></i>
            <span>Clientes</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.dre') }}" class="action-item dre">
            <i class="fas fa-chart-bar"></i>
            <span>DRE</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('financial.centros_custo') }}" class="action-item" style="color: #d4a574;">
            <i class="fas fa-sitemap" style="color: #d4a574;"></i>
            <span>Centros</span>
        </a>
    </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<script>
let fluxoChart;

const initialData = {
    labels: {{ fluxo_labels|tojson }},
    receitas: {{ fluxo_receitas|tojson }},
    despesas: {{ fluxo_despesas|tojson }}
};

function createChart(data) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('fluxo-canvas').getContext('2d');
    if (fluxoChart) fluxoChart.destroy();

    fluxoChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: data.labels,
            datasets: [
                {
                    label: 'Receitas',
                    data: data.receitas,
                    borderColor: '#10b981',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.1)',
                    fill: true,
                    tension: 0.4,
                    pointRadius: 3,
                    borderWidth: 2
                },
                {
                    label: 'Despesas',
                    data: data.despesas,
                    borderColor: '#ef4444',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.1)',
                    fill: true,
                    tension: 0.4,
                    pointRadius: 3,
                    borderWidth: 2
                }
            ]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
                legend: {
                    display: true,
                    position: 'top',
                    labels: {
                        color: '#888',
                        boxWidth: 12,
                        padding: 10,
                        font: { size: 10 }
                    }
                },
                tooltip: {
                    backgroundColor: '#1a1a1a',
                    titleColor: '#fff',
                    bodyColor: '#888',
                    borderColor: '#333',
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    padding: 8,
                    displayColors: false,
                    callbacks: {
                        label: ctx => 'R$ ' + ctx.parsed.y.toLocaleString('pt-BR')
                    }
                }
            },
            scales: {
                y: {
                    beginAtZero: true,
                    grid: { color: '#1a1a1a' },
                    ticks: {
                        color: '#555',
                        font: { size: 9 },
                        callback: v => (v/1000).toFixed(0) + 'k'
                    }
                },
                x: {
                    grid: { display: false },
                    ticks: { color: '#555', font: { size: 9 } }
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

function changePeriod(periodo) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.period-pill').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    event.target.classList.add('active');

    fetch('/financial/api/fluxo-caixa?periodo=' + periodo)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(data => createChart(data))
        .catch(e => console.error(e));
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => createChart(initialData));
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{% if edit %}Editar Fatura{% else %}Nova Fatura{% endif %}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 700px;">
    <h2 class="text-white mb-4">
        <i class="bi bi-receipt"></i> 
        {% if edit %}Editar Fatura {{ invoice.code }}{% else %}Nova Fatura{% endif %}
    </h2>

    <form method="POST" action="{% if edit %}{{ url_for('financial.edit_invoice', id=invoice.id) }}{% else %}{{ url_for('financial.new_invoice') }}{% endif %}">
        <div class="card bg-dark border-secondary mb-4">
            <div class="card-header bg-transparent border-secondary">
                <h5 class="text-white mb-0">Dados do Cliente</h5>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
                <div class="row g-3">
                    <div class="col-md-6">
                        <label class="form-label text-white">Nome do Cliente *</label>
                        <input type="text" name="client_name" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary" 
                               value="{{ invoice.client_name if edit else '' }}" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-6">
                        <label class="form-label text-white">CPF/CNPJ</label>
                        <input type="text" name="client_document" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary"
                               value="{{ invoice.client_document if edit else '' }}">
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-12">
                        <label class="form-label text-white">Email</label>
                        <input type="email" name="client_email" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary"
                               value="{{ invoice.client_email if edit else '' }}">
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card bg-dark border-secondary mb-4">
            <div class="card-header bg-transparent border-secondary">
                <h5 class="text-white mb-0">Detalhes da Fatura</h5>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
                <div class="row g-3">
                    {% if not edit %}
                    <div class="col-md-6">
                        <label class="form-label text-white">Tour (opcional)</label>
                        <select name="tour_id" class="form-select bg-dark text-white border-secondary">
                            <option value="">Nenhuma</option>
                            {% for tour in tours %}
                            <option value="{{ tour.id }}">{{ tour.name }}</option>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                    <div class="col-md-6">
                        <label class="form-label text-white">Vencimento *</label>
                        <input type="date" name="due_date" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary" 
                               value="{{ invoice.due_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if edit and invoice.due_date else '' }}" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-12">
                        <label class="form-label text-white">Descricao</label>
                        <textarea name="description" rows="3" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary"
                                  placeholder="Descricao do servico">{{ invoice.description if edit else '' }}</textarea>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-4">
                        <label class="form-label text-white">Valor (R$) *</label>
                        <input type="number" name="subtotal" step="0.01" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary" 
                               value="{{ '%.2f'|format(invoice.subtotal|float) if edit else '' }}" required>
                    </div>
                    {% if not edit %}
                    <div class="col-md-4">
                        <label class="form-label text-white">ISS (%)</label>
                        <input type="number" name="tax_percent" step="0.01" value="5" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary">
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="d-flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success">
                <i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> {% if edit %}Salvar Alteracoes{% else %}Criar Fatura{% endif %}
            </button>
            <a href="{% if edit %}{{ url_for('financial.view_invoice', id=invoice.id) }}{% else %}{{ url_for('financial.receitas') }}{% endif %}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">Cancelar</a>
        </div>
    </form>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```
