```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Manutencao - Relatorios{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .reports-container {
        padding: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 100px;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .page-header {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .page-title {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .year-selector select {
        background: #252525;
        border: 1px solid #333;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 8px 12px;
        color: #f5f5f5;
    }

    .section-title {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        margin: 24px 0 12px;
    }

    .critical-list {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .critical-item {
        padding: 16px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    }

    .critical-item:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }

    .critical-header {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .critical-code {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .critical-count {
        background: #c62828;
        color: white;
        padding: 2px 10px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .critical-info {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .critical-cost {
        color: #e65100;
        font-weight: 600;
        margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .warning-card {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c62828 0%, #b71c1c 100%);
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .warning-card i {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
        color: white;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .warning-card h3 {
        color: white;
        font-size: 1rem;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .warning-card p {
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
        font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .empty-state {
        text-align: center;
        color: #666;
        padding: 60px 20px;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="reports-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="page-title"><i class="fas fa-chart-bar"></i> Relatorios</h1>
        <form class="year-selector" method="GET">
            <select name="year" onchange="this.form.submit()">
                {% for y in range(2024, 2027) %}
                <option value="{{ y }}" {% if y == year %}selected{% endif %}>{{ y }}</option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>
        </form>
    </div>

    {% if critical_equipment %}
    <div class="warning-card">
        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
        <h3>Equipamentos Criticos</h3>
        <p>{{ critical_equipment|length }} equipamento(s) com 3+ manutencoes em {{ year }}</p>
    </div>

    <h3 class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-tools"></i> Equipamentos com Mais Manutencoes</h3>

    <div class="critical-list">
        {% for eq in critical_equipment %}
        <div class="critical-item">
            <div class="critical-header">
                <span class="critical-code">{{ eq.code }}</span>
                <span class="critical-count">{{ eq.total_maintenances }} manutencoes</span>
            </div>
            <div class="critical-info">{{ eq.brand or '-' }} {{ eq.model or '' }}</div>
            <div class="critical-cost">
                Custo total: R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(eq.total_cost or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}
                {% if eq.value %} (Valor: R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(eq.value).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}){% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <div class="empty-state">
        <i class="fas fa-check-circle fa-3x" style="color: #2e7d32; margin-bottom: 16px;"></i>
        <p>Nenhum equipamento critico em {{ year }}</p>
        <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #888; margin-top: 8px;">Equipamentos com 3+ manutencoes aparecem aqui.</p>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Manutencao - Estoque{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .stock-container {
        padding: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 100px;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .page-header {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .page-title {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .btn-new {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #455a64 0%, #263238 100%);
        color: white;
        border: none;
        padding: 10px 20px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-decoration: none;
    }

    .category-filter {
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
        overflow-x: auto;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .filter-btn {
        padding: 8px 16px;
        border-radius: 20px;
        border: 1px solid #333;
        background: #1a1a1a;
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-decoration: none;
    }

    .filter-btn.active {
        background: #455a64;
        border-color: #455a64;
        color: white;
    }

    .stock-card {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 16px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .stock-header {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: flex-start;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .stock-name {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .stock-category {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }

    .stock-qty-badge {
        padding: 4px 12px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .qty-ok { background: #1b5e20; color: white; }
    .qty-low { background: #e65100; color: white; }
    .qty-critical { background: #c62828; color: white; }

    .stock-details {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 12px;
        padding-top: 12px;
        border-top: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    }

    .detail-item {
        text-align: center;
    }

    .detail-value {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .detail-label {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
    }

    .stock-actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
        margin-top: 12px;
    }

    .btn-movement {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: none;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .btn-in { background: #2e7d32; color: white; }
    .btn-out { background: #c62828; color: white; }

    .empty-state {
        text-align: center;
        color: #666;
        padding: 60px 20px;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="stock-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="page-title"><i class="fas fa-boxes"></i> Estoque</h1>
        <a href="{{ url_for('maintenance.new_stock') }}" class="btn-new">
            <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Novo
        </a>
    </div>

    <div class="category-filter">
        <a href="{{ url_for('maintenance.stock') }}" class="filter-btn {% if current_category == 'all' %}active{% endif %}">Todos</a>
        {% for cat in categories %}
        <a href="{{ url_for('maintenance.stock', category=cat) }}" class="filter-btn {% if current_category == cat %}active{% endif %}">{{ cat }}</a>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>

    {% if materials %}
        {% for item in materials %}
        <div class="stock-card">
            <div class="stock-header">
                <div>
                    <div class="stock-name">{{ item.name }}</div>
                    <div class="stock-category">{{ item.category }} {% if item.brand %}- {{ item.brand }}{% endif %}</div>
                </div>
                <span class="stock-qty-badge {% if item.quantity <= 0 %}qty-critical{% elif item.quantity < item.minimum_quantity %}qty-low{% else %}qty-ok{% endif %}">
                    {{ item.quantity }} {{ item.unit }}
                </span>
            </div>
            
            <div class="stock-details">
                <div class="detail-item">
                    <div class="detail-value">{{ item.minimum_quantity }} {{ item.unit }}</div>
                    <div class="detail-label">Minimo</div>
                </div>
                <div class="detail-item">
                    <div class="detail-value">{% if item.reference_value %}R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(item.reference_value).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}{% else %}-{% endif %}</div>
                    <div class="detail-label">Valor Ref.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="detail-item">
                    <div class="detail-value">{{ item.supplier or '-' }}</div>
                    <div class="detail-label">Fornecedor</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('maintenance.stock_movement', id=item.id) }}" class="stock-actions">
                <input type="hidden" name="quantity" value="1">
                <input type="hidden" name="reason" value="manual">
                <button type="submit" name="type" value="in" class="btn-movement btn-in">
                    <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Entrada
                </button>
                <button type="submit" name="type" value="out" class="btn-movement btn-out">
                    <i class="fas fa-minus"></i> Saida
                </button>
            </form>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    {% else %}
        <div class="empty-state">
            <i class="fas fa-box-open fa-3x" style="margin-bottom: 16px; color: #444;"></i>
            <p>Nenhum item no estoque</p>
            <a href="{{ url_for('maintenance.new_stock') }}" class="btn-new" style="margin-top: 16px; display: inline-block;">Adicionar Primeiro</a>
        </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{% if material %}Editar{% else %}Novo{% endif %} Material{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .form-container {
        padding: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 100px;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .page-header {
        margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .page-title {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .form-card {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 20px;
    }

    .form-group {
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .form-label {
        display: block;
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .form-control {
        width: 100%;
        background: #252525;
        border: 1px solid #333;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 12px;
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .form-control:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: #455a64;
    }

    .form-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn-submit {
        width: 100%;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #455a64 0%, #263238 100%);
        color: white;
        border: none;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
        margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .btn-cancel {
        width: 100%;
        background: #333;
        color: #888;
        border: none;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        margin-top: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="form-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="page-title">
            <i class="fas fa-box"></i> 
            {% if material %}Editar Material{% else %}Novo Material{% endif %}
        </h1>
    </div>

    <form method="POST" class="form-card">
        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">Nome *</label>
            <input type="text" name="name" class="form-control" value="{{ material.name if material else '' }}" required>
        </div>

        <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Categoria *</label>
                <select name="category" class="form-control" required>
                    <option value="connector" {% if material and material.category == 'connector' %}selected{% endif %}>Conector</option>
                    <option value="cable" {% if material and material.category == 'cable' %}selected{% endif %}>Cabo/Metro</option>
                    <option value="hardware" {% if material and material.category == 'hardware' %}selected{% endif %}>Hardware</option>
                    <option value="consumable" {% if material and material.category == 'consumable' %}selected{% endif %}>Consumivel</option>
                    <option value="other" {% if material and material.category == 'other' %}selected{% endif %}>Outro</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Subcategoria</label>
                <input type="text" name="sub_category" class="form-control" value="{{ material.sub_category if material else '' }}">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Quantidade *</label>
                <input type="number" name="quantity" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ material.quantity if material else '0' }}" required>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Unidade *</label>
                <select name="unit" class="form-control" required>
                    <option value="unit" {% if material and material.unit == 'unit' %}selected{% endif %}>Unidade</option>
                    <option value="m" {% if material and material.unit == 'm' %}selected{% endif %}>Metro</option>
                    <option value="kg" {% if material and material.unit == 'kg' %}selected{% endif %}>Kg</option>
                    <option value="l" {% if material and material.unit == 'l' %}selected{% endif %}>Litro</option>
                    <option value="box" {% if material and material.unit == 'box' %}selected{% endif %}>Caixa</option>
                </select>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">Quantidade Minima</label>
            <input type="number" name="minimum_quantity" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ material.minimum_quantity if material else '0' }}">
        </div>

        <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Marca</label>
                <input type="text" name="brand" class="form-control" value="{{ material.brand if material else '' }}">
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Modelo</label>
                <input type="text" name="model" class="form-control" value="{{ material.model if material else '' }}">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Valor Referencia (R$)</label>
                <input type="number" name="reference_value" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ material.reference_value if material else '' }}">
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Fornecedor</label>
                <input type="text" name="supplier" class="form-control" value="{{ material.supplier if material else '' }}">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">Observacoes</label>
            <textarea name="notes" class="form-control" rows="3">{{ material.notes if material else '' }}</textarea>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="btn-submit">
            <i class="fas fa-save"></i> Salvar
        </button>
        
        <a href="{{ url_for('maintenance.stock') }}" class="btn-cancel">Cancelar</a>
    </form>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
    .modal-buttons { display: flex; gap: var(--spacing-md); margin-top: var(--spacing-lg); }
    .btn-secondary { background-color: #333; color: #f5f5f5; flex: 1; padding: var(--spacing-md); border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: none; font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold); cursor: pointer; }

</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <div class="header-content">
            <a href="{{ url_for('orcamento.index') }}" class="back-button">←</a>
            <h1 class="header-title">{{ sep_list.name }}</h1>
            <span class="badge badge-{{ sep_list.status }}">
                {% if sep_list.status == 'pending' %}Pendente{% elif sep_list.status == 'approved' %}Aprovado{% else %}Rejeitado{% endif %}
            </span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="info-section">
        <div class="info-card">
            <div class="info-row">
                <span class="info-label">Criado por</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ sep_list.creator.name }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-row">
                <span class="info-label">Data</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ sep_list.created_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y às %H:%M') }}</span>
            </div>
            {% if sep_list.tour %}
            <div class="info-row">
                <span class="info-label">Tour</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ sep_list.tour.name }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            <div class="info-row">
                <span class="info-label">Tipo</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ 'Completo' if sep_list.list_type == 'complete' else 'Simples' }}</span>
            </div>
            {% if sep_list.client_name %}
            <div class="info-row">
                <span class="info-label">Cliente</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ sep_list.client_name }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            {% if sep_list.event_name %}
            <div class="info-row">
                <span class="info-label">Evento</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ sep_list.event_name }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            {% if sep_list.event_date %}
            <div class="info-row">
                <span class="info-label">Data do Evento</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ sep_list.event_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}{% if sep_list.event_time %} às {{ sep_list.event_time }}{% endif %}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            {% if sep_list.observations %}
            <div class="info-row">
                <span class="info-label">Observações</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ sep_list.observations }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        <div class="info-card">
            <div class="section-title">Itens do Orçamento</div>
            {% for item in sep_list.items %}
            <div class="item-row">
                <span class="item-name">{{ item.item_name }}</span>
                <span class="item-qty">{{ item.quantity }}x</span>
                {% if sep_list.list_type == 'complete' and item.unit_price %}
                <span class="item-price">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(item.total_price or 0)|replace('.', ',') }}</span>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
            {% endfor %}

            <div class="total-section">
                <div class="total-row">
                    <span>Total de itens:</span>
                    <span>{{ sep_list.items|list|length }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="total-row">
                    <span>Total de unidades:</span>
                    <span>{{ sep_list.items|list|sum(attribute='quantity') }}</span>
                </div>
                {% if sep_list.list_type == 'complete' %}
                <div class="total-row grand">
                    <span>TOTAL:</span>
                    <span>R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(sep_list.items|list|sum(attribute='total_price') or 0)|replace('.', ',') }}</span>
                </div>
                {% else %}
                <div class="total-row grand">
                    <span>VALOR TOTAL:</span>
                    <span>R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(sep_list.total_value or 0)|replace('.', ',') }}</span>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    {% if sep_list.status == 'pending' %}
    <div class="action-buttons">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-approve" onclick="startQuoteApprovalWizard({{ sep_list.id }}, '{{ sep_list.name|e }}', '{{ "%.2f"|format(sep_list.total_value or sep_list.items|list|sum(attribute="total_price") or 0)|replace(".", ",") }}')">
            <i class="bi bi-magic"></i> Aprovar com Wizard
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-reject" onclick="document.getElementById('rejectModal').classList.add('show')">Rejeitar</button>
    </div>
    {% elif sep_list.status == 'approved' %}
    <div class="action-buttons">
        <button type="button" class="btn" style="background: #28a745; color: #fff;" onclick="startPostApprovalWizard({{ sep_list.id }}, '{{ sep_list.name|e }}', '{{ "%.2f"|format(sep_list.total_value or sep_list.items|list|sum(attribute="total_price") or 0)|replace(".", ",") }}')">
            <i class="bi bi-arrow-right-circle"></i> Contrato / Recebíveis
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="btn" style="background: #6f42c1; color: #fff;" onclick="startWorkListWizard({{ sep_list.id }}, '{{ sep_list.name|e }}', '{{ sep_list.client_name|e if sep_list.client_name else '' }}')">
            <i class="bi bi-list-check"></i> Gerar WorkList
        </button>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="action-buttons" style="flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;">
        <a href="{{ url_for('orcamento.generate_pdf', id=sep_list.id) }}" class="btn btn-pdf" style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;">
            <i class="fas fa-file-pdf"></i> Visualizar / Baixar PDF
        </a>
        <button type="button" onclick="shareOrcamento()" class="btn" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #25d366 0%, #128c7e 100%); color: white; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; border: none; cursor: pointer;">
            <i class="fas fa-share-alt"></i> Compartilhar
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="approveModal">
    <div class="modal">
        <div class="modal-title">Aprovar Orçamento</div>
        <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('orcamento.approve', id=sep_list.id) }}">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Observações (opcional)</label>
                <input type="text" name="notes" class="form-input" placeholder="Notas sobre a aprovação">
            </div>
            <div class="modal-buttons">
                <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" onclick="document.getElementById('approveModal').classList.remove('show')">Cancelar</button>
                <button type="submit" class="btn-primary">Confirmar</button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="rejectModal">
    <div class="modal">
        <div class="modal-title">Rejeitar Orçamento</div>
        <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('orcamento.reject', id=sep_list.id) }}">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Motivo da rejeição *</label>
                <input type="text" name="reason" class="form-input" placeholder="Informe o motivo" required>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-buttons">
                <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" onclick="document.getElementById('rejectModal').classList.remove('show')">Cancelar</button>
                <button type="submit" class="btn-primary" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e74c3c 0%, #c0392b 100%);">Rejeitar</button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
async function shareOrcamento() {
    const orcamentoNome = "{{ sep_list.name }}";
    const companyName = "{{ current_user.company.name }}";
    {% if sep_list.list_type == 'complete' %}
    const valorTotal = "R$ {{ '%.2f'|format(sep_list.items|list|sum(attribute='total_price') or 0)|replace('.', ',') }}";
    {% else %}
    const valorTotal = "R$ {{ '%.2f'|format(sep_list.total_value or 0)|replace('.', ',') }}";
    {% endif %}
    
    const mensagem = `*${companyName}*\n\n` +
        `Orçamento: *${orcamentoNome}*\n` +
        `Valor Total: *${valorTotal}*\n\n` +
        `Acesse o link para visualizar os detalhes completos.`;
    
    const pdfUrl = window.location.origin + "{{ url_for('orcamento.generate_pdf', id=sep_list.id) }}";
    
    if (navigator.share) {
        try {
            await navigator.share({
                title: `Orçamento - ${orcamentoNome}`,
                text: mensagem,
                url: pdfUrl
            });
        } catch (err) {
            if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
                fallbackShare(mensagem, pdfUrl);
            }
        }
    } else {
        fallbackShare(mensagem, pdfUrl);
    }
}

function fallbackShare(mensagem, pdfUrl) {
    const textoCompleto = mensagem + '\n\n' + pdfUrl;
    const whatsappUrl = `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=${encodeURIComponent(textoCompleto)}`;
    window.open(whatsappUrl, '_blank');
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
    }

    .tab {
        flex: 1;
        padding: var(--spacing-md);
        text-align: center;
        text-decoration: none;

        position: relative;
        text-transform: uppercase;

    }

    .tab.active {
        color: #d4a574;

    .tab-badge {
        position: absolute;
        top: 6px;

        background-color: #e74c3c;

        border-radius: 50%;

        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);

    .lists-container {
        padding: var(--spacing-md);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;

    .list-card {
        background-color: var(--bg-secondary);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        padding: var(--spacing-lg);
        text-decoration: none;
        color: inherit;

        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--spacing-sm);
        border-left: 4px solid #d4a574;

    .list-header {

        font-size: 1.2rem;

    .badge-pending { background: rgba(243, 156, 18, 0.2); color: #f39c12; }
    .badge-approved { background: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.2); color: #2ecc71; }

</style>

{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <div class="header-content">
            <a href="{{ url_for('dashboard') }}" class="back-button">←</a>
            <h1 class="header-title">Orçamentos</h1>
        </div>
    </div>

    <a href="{{ url_for('orcamento.new') }}" class="new-button">+ NOVO ORÇAMENTO</a>

    <div class="tabs">
        <a href="{{ url_for('orcamento.index', status='pending') }}" 
           class="tab {% if status_filter == 'pending' %}active{% endif %}">
            Pendentes
            {% if pending_count > 0 %}<span class="tab-badge">{{ pending_count }}</span>{% endif %}
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('orcamento.index', status='approved') }}"
           class="tab {% if status_filter == 'approved' %}active{% endif %}">
            Aprovados
            {% if approved_count > 0 %}<span class="tab-badge" style="background:#2ecc71;">{{ approved_count }}</span>{% endif %}
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('orcamento.index', status='rejected') }}"
           class="tab {% if status_filter == 'rejected' %}active{% endif %}">
            Rejeitados
            {% if rejected_count > 0 %}<span class="tab-badge">{{ rejected_count }}</span>{% endif %}
        </a>
    </div>

    <div class="lists-container">
        {% if lists %}
            {% for list in lists %}
            <a href="{{ url_for('orcamento.detail', id=list.id) }}" class="list-card">
                <div class="list-header">
                    <div class="list-name">{{ list.name }}</div>
                    <span class="badge badge-{{ list.status }}">
                        {% if list.status == 'pending' %}Pendente{% elif list.status == 'approved' %}Aprovado{% else %}Rejeitado{% endif %}
                    </span>
                </div>
                {% if list.tour %}<div class="list-tour">🎸 {{ list.tour.name }}</div>{% endif %}
                <div class="list-meta">
                    <span>📦 {{ list.total_items }} itens</span>
                    <span>👤 {{ list.creator.name }}</span>
                    <span>📅 {{ list.created_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') }}</span>
                </div>
            </a>
            {% endfor %}
        {% else %}
            <div class="empty-state">
                <div style="font-size:3rem;opacity:0.5;">📋</div>
                <div>Nenhum orçamento {{ status_filter == 'pending' and 'pendente' or status_filter == 'approved' and 'aprovado' or 'rejeitado' }}</div>
            </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="header-title">Orçamento Completo</h1>
        <div class="badge">COM PREÇOS DETALHADOS</div>
        <p class="header-subtitle">Para propostas comerciais com detalhamento de valores</p>
    </div>

    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('orcamento.new_complete') }}" id="listForm">
        <div class="form-section">
            <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; color: #d4a574; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md); text-transform: uppercase;">Dados do Cliente</div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">NOME DO CLIENTE *</label>
                <input type="text" name="client_name" class="form-input" placeholder="Nome ou razão social" required>
            </div>
            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--spacing-md);">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">TELEFONE</label>
                    <input type="text" name="client_phone" class="form-input" placeholder="(00) 00000-0000">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">EMAIL</label>
                    <input type="email" name="client_email" class="form-input" placeholder="email@cliente.com">
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">ENDEREÇO</label>
                <input type="text" name="client_address" class="form-input" placeholder="Endereço completo do cliente">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-section">
            <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; color: #d4a574; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md); text-transform: uppercase;">Informações do Evento</div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">NOME DO EVENTO *</label>
                <input type="text" name="event_name" class="form-input" placeholder="Ex: Festival de Verão 2025" required>
            </div>
            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--spacing-md);">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">DATA DO EVENTO *</label>
                    <input type="date" name="event_date" class="form-input" required>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">HORÁRIO</label>
                    <input type="time" name="event_time" class="form-input">
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">LOCAL DO EVENTO</label>
                <input type="text" name="event_location" class="form-input" placeholder="Ex: Parque Unipraias - Balneário Camboriú/SC">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-section">
            <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; color: #d4a574; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md); text-transform: uppercase;">Dados do Orçamento</div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">TOUR (OPCIONAL)</label>
                <select name="tour_id" class="form-select">
                    <option value="">Selecione uma tour...</option>
                    {% for tour in tours %}
                    <option value="{{ tour.id }}">{{ tour.name }} - {{ tour.artist }}</option>
                    {% endfor %}
                </select>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">NOME DO ORÇAMENTO *</label>
                <input type="text" name="name" class="form-input" placeholder="Ex: Show ABC - Dia 1" required>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">OBSERVAÇÕES</label>
                <textarea name="observations" class="form-input" rows="4" placeholder="Condições de pagamento, inclusões, exclusões, etc."></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="search-section">
            <label class="form-label" style="margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);">BUSCAR EQUIPAMENTO</label>
            <input type="text" class="search-input" id="searchInput" placeholder="Digite nome, marca ou modelo..." autocomplete="off">
            <div class="autocomplete-results" id="autocompleteResults"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="items-list-section">
            <div class="list-header">
                <div class="list-title">Itens do Orçamento</div>
                <div class="list-count" id="itemCount">0 itens</div>
            </div>
            <div id="itemsList">
                <div class="empty-state">
                    <div style="font-size:2.5rem;opacity:0.5;margin-bottom:var(--spacing-md);">📦</div>
                    <div>Nenhum item adicionado</div>
                    <div style="font-size:0.85rem;margin-top:8px;">Use a busca acima para adicionar equipamentos</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="totals-section" id="totalsSection" style="display: none;">
            <div class="total-row"><span>Total de itens:</span><span id="totalItems">0</span></div>
            <div class="total-row"><span>Total de unidades:</span><span id="totalUnits">0</span></div>
            <div class="total-row grand-total"><span>TOTAL GERAL:</span><span id="grandTotal">R$ 0,00</span></div>
        </div>

        <div style="height: 80px;"></div>
        <button type="submit" class="submit-button">CRIAR ORÇAMENTO</button>
    </form>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="quantityModal">
    <div class="modal">
        <div class="modal-header">
            <div class="modal-title" id="modalTitle">Equipamento</div>
            <div class="modal-subtitle" id="modalSubtitle">disponíveis</div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">QUANTIDADE</label>
            <input type="number" class="form-input" id="quantityInput" min="1" value="1">
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">VALOR POR DIA (R$)</label>
            <input type="number" class="form-input" id="priceInput" min="0" step="0.01" value="0">
        </div>

        <div class="modal-subtotal">
            <div class="modal-subtotal-label">SUBTOTAL</div>
            <div class="modal-subtotal-value" id="modalSubtotal">R$ 0,00</div>
        </div>

        <div class="modal-buttons">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addItemFromModal()">Adicionar</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
window.items = [];
window.selectedItem = null;
window.allEquipment = [];

const equipmentTypes = {{ types_by_category|tojson }};

Object.keys(equipmentTypes).forEach(categoryName => {
    const category = equipmentTypes[categoryName];
    if (category.types) {
        category.types.forEach(eq => {
            window.allEquipment.push({
                id: eq.id, name: eq.name, code: eq.code, brand: eq.brand, model: eq.model,
                value: eq.value || 0, available: eq.available, total: eq.total,
                category: categoryName, type_name: eq.type_name
            });
        });
    }
});

document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', function(e) {
    const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    const results = document.getElementById('autocompleteResults');
    if (term.length < 2) { results.classList.remove('show'); return; }

    const filtered = window.allEquipment.filter(eq => 
        eq.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) || eq.code.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        (eq.brand && eq.brand.toLowerCase().includes(term)) ||
        (eq.model && eq.model.toLowerCase().includes(term))
    );

    const grouped = {};
    filtered.forEach(eq => {
        const key = `${eq.brand}|${eq.model}|${eq.type_name}`;
        if (!grouped[key]) {
            grouped[key] = { items: [], brand: eq.brand, model: eq.model, type_name: eq.type_name,
                category: eq.category, total: 0, available: 0, firstValue: 0 };
        }
        grouped[key].items.push(eq);
        grouped[key].total++;
        grouped[key].available += eq.available;
        if (!grouped[key].firstValue && eq.value) grouped[key].firstValue = eq.value;
    });

    const groupedArray = Object.values(grouped).slice(0, 8);
    if (groupedArray.length === 0) {
        results.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:20px;text-align:center;color:#888;">Nenhum resultado</div>';
        results.classList.add('show');
        return;
    }

    results.innerHTML = groupedArray.map(g => `
        <div class="autocomplete-item" data-brand="${g.brand}" data-model="${g.model}" data-typename="${g.type_name}">
            <div class="autocomplete-name">${g.type_name}</div>
            <div class="autocomplete-info">${g.brand} • ${g.model} • ${g.available}/${g.total} disponíveis • R$ ${(g.firstValue||0).toFixed(2).replace('.',',')}/dia</div>
        </div>
    `).join('');

    results.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item').forEach(el => {
        el.addEventListener('click', function() {
            selectGroup(this.getAttribute('data-brand'), this.getAttribute('data-model'), this.getAttribute('data-typename'));
        });
    });
    results.classList.add('show');
});

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('.search-section')) document.getElementById('autocompleteResults').classList.remove('show');
});

function selectGroup(brand, model, typeName) {
    const groupItems = window.allEquipment.filter(eq => eq.brand === brand && eq.model === model && eq.type_name === typeName);
    if (!groupItems.length) return;
    const totalAvailable = groupItems.reduce((sum, eq) => sum + eq.available, 0);
    const first = groupItems[0];
    window.selectedItem = { id: first.id, name: first.name, brand: first.brand, model: first.model, value: first.value, maxQuantity: totalAvailable };
    document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = first.type_name;
    document.getElementById('modalSubtitle').textContent = `${first.brand} • ${first.model} • ${totalAvailable} disponíveis`;
    document.getElementById('quantityInput').value = 1;
    document.getElementById('priceInput').value = first.value || 0;
    calculateSubtotal();
    document.getElementById('quantityModal').classList.add('show');
    document.getElementById('autocompleteResults').classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
}

function calculateSubtotal() {
    const qty = parseInt(document.getElementById('quantityInput').value) || 0;
    const price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceInput').value) || 0;
    document.getElementById('modalSubtotal').textContent = 'R$ ' + (qty * price).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
}
document.getElementById('quantityInput').addEventListener('input', calculateSubtotal);
document.getElementById('priceInput').addEventListener('input', calculateSubtotal);

function closeModal() { document.getElementById('quantityModal').classList.remove('show'); }

function addItemFromModal() {
    const quantity = parseInt(document.getElementById('quantityInput').value);
    const price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceInput').value);
    if (!quantity || quantity < 1) { alert('Digite uma quantidade válida'); return; }

    const existingIndex = window.items.findIndex(i => i.id === window.selectedItem.id);
    if (existingIndex !== -1) {
        window.items[existingIndex].quantity += quantity;
        window.items[existingIndex].subtotal = window.items[existingIndex].quantity * window.items[existingIndex].price;
    } else {
        window.items.push({
            id: window.selectedItem.id, name: window.selectedItem.name, brand: window.selectedItem.brand,
            model: window.selectedItem.model, quantity: quantity, price: price, subtotal: quantity * price,
            available: window.selectedItem.maxQuantity
        });
    }
    renderItems();
    closeModal();
}

function renderItems() {
    const container = document.getElementById('itemsList');
    if (!window.items.length) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state"><div style="font-size:2.5rem;opacity:0.5;margin-bottom:var(--spacing-md);">📦</div><div>Nenhum item adicionado</div><div style="font-size:0.85rem;margin-top:8px;">Use a busca acima para adicionar equipamentos</div></div>`;
        document.getElementById('totalsSection').style.display = 'none';
        updateCounts();
        return;
    }

    container.innerHTML = window.items.map((item, index) => `
        <div class="item-card">
            <div class="item-info-wrapper">
                <div class="item-name">${item.name}</div>
                ${item.brand || item.model ? `<div class="item-details">${[item.brand, item.model].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}</div>` : ''}
            </div>
            <div class="item-controls-wrapper">
                <div class="quantity-stepper">
                    <button type="button" class="stepper-btn" data-action="decrease" data-index="${index}">−</button>
                    <div class="stepper-value">${item.quantity}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="stepper-btn" data-action="increase" data-index="${index}">+</button>
                </div>
                <div class="item-price">R$ ${item.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</div>
                <button type="button" class="delete-btn" data-index="${index}">×</button>
            </div>
            <input type="hidden" name="quantity-${item.id}" value="${item.quantity}">
            <input type="hidden" name="unit_price-${item.id}" value="${item.price}">
        </div>
    `).join('');

    container.querySelectorAll('.stepper-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const index = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-index'));
            const action = this.getAttribute('data-action');
            const maxQty = window.items[index].available || 999;
            if (action === 'increase' && window.items[index].quantity < maxQty) {
                window.items[index].quantity++;
                window.items[index].subtotal = window.items[index].quantity * window.items[index].price;
                renderItems();
            } else if (action === 'decrease' && window.items[index].quantity > 1) {
                window.items[index].quantity--;
                window.items[index].subtotal = window.items[index].quantity * window.items[index].price;
                renderItems();
            }
        });
    });

    container.querySelectorAll('.delete-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.items.splice(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-index')), 1);
            renderItems();
        });
    });

    document.getElementById('totalsSection').style.display = 'block';
    updateCounts();
}

function updateCounts() {
    const totalItems = window.items.length;
    const totalUnits = window.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
    const grandTotal = window.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.subtotal, 0);
    document.getElementById('itemCount').textContent = `${totalItems} itens • ${totalUnits} un`;
    document.getElementById('totalItems').textContent = totalItems;
    document.getElementById('totalUnits').textContent = totalUnits;
    document.getElementById('grandTotal').textContent = 'R$ ' + grandTotal.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="header-title">Orçamento Simples</h1>
        <div class="badge">SÓ VALOR TOTAL</div>
        <p class="header-subtitle">Para uso interno sem detalhamento de preços</p>
    </div>

    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('orcamento.new_simple') }}" id="listForm">
        <div class="form-section">
            <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; color: #2ecc71; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md); text-transform: uppercase;">Dados do Cliente</div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">NOME DO CLIENTE *</label>
                <input type="text" name="client_name" class="form-input" placeholder="Nome ou razão social" required>
            </div>
            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--spacing-md);">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">TELEFONE</label>
                    <input type="text" name="client_phone" class="form-input" placeholder="(00) 00000-0000">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">EMAIL</label>
                    <input type="email" name="client_email" class="form-input" placeholder="email@cliente.com">
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">ENDEREÇO</label>
                <input type="text" name="client_address" class="form-input" placeholder="Endereço completo do cliente">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-section">
            <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; color: #2ecc71; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md); text-transform: uppercase;">Informações do Evento</div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">NOME DO EVENTO *</label>
                <input type="text" name="event_name" class="form-input" placeholder="Ex: Festival de Verão 2025" required>
            </div>
            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--spacing-md);">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">DATA DO EVENTO *</label>
                    <input type="date" name="event_date" class="form-input" required>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">HORÁRIO</label>
                    <input type="time" name="event_time" class="form-input">
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">LOCAL DO EVENTO</label>
                <input type="text" name="event_location" class="form-input" placeholder="Ex: Parque Unipraias - Balneário Camboriú/SC">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-section">
            <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; color: #2ecc71; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md); text-transform: uppercase;">Dados do Orçamento</div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">TOUR (OPCIONAL)</label>
                <select name="tour_id" class="form-select">
                    <option value="">Selecione uma tour...</option>
                    {% for tour in tours %}
                    <option value="{{ tour.id }}">{{ tour.name }} - {{ tour.artist }}</option>
                    {% endfor %}
                </select>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">NOME DO ORÇAMENTO *</label>
                <input type="text" name="name" class="form-input" placeholder="Ex: Show ABC - Dia 1" required>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">OBSERVAÇÕES</label>
                <textarea name="observations" class="form-input" rows="4" placeholder="Condições de pagamento, inclusões, exclusões, etc."></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="search-section">
            <label class="form-label" style="margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm);">BUSCAR EQUIPAMENTO</label>
            <input type="text" class="search-input" id="searchInput" placeholder="Digite nome, marca ou modelo..." autocomplete="off">
            <div class="autocomplete-results" id="autocompleteResults"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="items-list-section">
            <div class="list-header">
                <div class="list-title">Itens do Orçamento</div>
                <div class="list-count" id="itemCount">0 itens</div>
            </div>
            <div id="itemsList">
                <div class="empty-state">
                    <div style="font-size:2.5rem;opacity:0.5;margin-bottom:var(--spacing-md);">📦</div>
                    <div>Nenhum item adicionado</div>
                    <div style="font-size:0.85rem;margin-top:8px;">Use a busca acima para adicionar equipamentos</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="totals-section" id="totalsSection" style="display: none;">
            <div class="total-row"><span>Total de itens:</span><span id="totalItems">0</span></div>
            <div class="total-row"><span>Total de unidades:</span><span id="totalUnits">0</span></div>
        </div>

        <div class="value-section">
            <label class="value-label">VALOR TOTAL DA LOCAÇÃO *</label>
            <input type="number" name="total_value" class="value-input" placeholder="R$ 0,00" min="0" step="0.01" required>
            <p style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#888;margin-top:8px;">Este valor não será visível para técnicos</p>
        </div>

        <div style="height: 80px;"></div>
        <button type="submit" class="submit-button">CRIAR ORÇAMENTO</button>
    </form>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="quantityModal">
    <div class="modal">
        <div class="modal-header">
            <div class="modal-title" id="modalTitle">Equipamento</div>
            <div class="modal-subtitle" id="modalSubtitle">disponíveis</div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">QUANTIDADE</label>
            <input type="number" class="form-input" id="quantityInput" min="1" value="1">
        </div>

        <div class="modal-buttons">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addItemFromModal()">Adicionar</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
window.items = [];
window.selectedItem = null;
window.allEquipment = [];

const equipmentTypes = {{ types_by_category|tojson }};

Object.keys(equipmentTypes).forEach(categoryName => {
    const category = equipmentTypes[categoryName];
    if (category.types) {
        category.types.forEach(eq => {
            window.allEquipment.push({
                id: eq.id, name: eq.name, code: eq.code, brand: eq.brand, model: eq.model,
                available: eq.available, total: eq.total, category: categoryName, type_name: eq.type_name
            });
        });
    }
});

document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', function(e) {
    const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    const results = document.getElementById('autocompleteResults');
    if (term.length < 2) { results.classList.remove('show'); return; }

    const filtered = window.allEquipment.filter(eq => 
        eq.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) || eq.code.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        (eq.brand && eq.brand.toLowerCase().includes(term)) ||
        (eq.model && eq.model.toLowerCase().includes(term))
    );

    const grouped = {};
    filtered.forEach(eq => {
        const key = `${eq.brand}|${eq.model}|${eq.type_name}`;
        if (!grouped[key]) {
            grouped[key] = { items: [], brand: eq.brand, model: eq.model, type_name: eq.type_name, category: eq.category, total: 0, available: 0 };
        }
        grouped[key].items.push(eq);
        grouped[key].total++;
        grouped[key].available += eq.available;
    });

    const groupedArray = Object.values(grouped).slice(0, 8);
    if (groupedArray.length === 0) {
        results.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:20px;text-align:center;color:#888;">Nenhum resultado</div>';
        results.classList.add('show');
        return;
    }

    results.innerHTML = groupedArray.map(g => `
        <div class="autocomplete-item" data-brand="${g.brand}" data-model="${g.model}" data-typename="${g.type_name}">
            <div class="autocomplete-name">${g.type_name}</div>
            <div class="autocomplete-info">${g.brand} • ${g.model} • ${g.available}/${g.total} disponíveis</div>
        </div>
    `).join('');

    results.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item').forEach(el => {
        el.addEventListener('click', function() {
            selectGroup(this.getAttribute('data-brand'), this.getAttribute('data-model'), this.getAttribute('data-typename'));
        });
    });
    results.classList.add('show');
});

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('.search-section')) document.getElementById('autocompleteResults').classList.remove('show');
});

function selectGroup(brand, model, typeName) {
    const groupItems = window.allEquipment.filter(eq => eq.brand === brand && eq.model === model && eq.type_name === typeName);
    if (!groupItems.length) return;
    const totalAvailable = groupItems.reduce((sum, eq) => sum + eq.available, 0);
    const first = groupItems[0];
    window.selectedItem = { id: first.id, name: first.name, brand: first.brand, model: first.model, maxQuantity: totalAvailable };
    document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = first.type_name;
    document.getElementById('modalSubtitle').textContent = `${first.brand} • ${first.model} • ${totalAvailable} disponíveis`;
    document.getElementById('quantityInput').value = 1;
    document.getElementById('quantityModal').classList.add('show');
    document.getElementById('autocompleteResults').classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
}

function closeModal() { document.getElementById('quantityModal').classList.remove('show'); }

function addItemFromModal() {
    const quantity = parseInt(document.getElementById('quantityInput').value);
    if (!quantity || quantity < 1) { alert('Digite uma quantidade válida'); return; }

    const existingIndex = window.items.findIndex(i => i.id === window.selectedItem.id);
    if (existingIndex !== -1) {
        window.items[existingIndex].quantity += quantity;
    } else {
        window.items.push({
            id: window.selectedItem.id, name: window.selectedItem.name, brand: window.selectedItem.brand,
            model: window.selectedItem.model, quantity: quantity, available: window.selectedItem.maxQuantity
        });
    }
    renderItems();
    closeModal();
}

function renderItems() {
    const container = document.getElementById('itemsList');
    if (!window.items.length) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state"><div style="font-size:2.5rem;opacity:0.5;margin-bottom:var(--spacing-md);">📦</div><div>Nenhum item adicionado</div><div style="font-size:0.85rem;margin-top:8px;">Use a busca acima para adicionar equipamentos</div></div>`;
        document.getElementById('totalsSection').style.display = 'none';
        updateCounts();
        return;
    }

    container.innerHTML = window.items.map((item, index) => `
        <div class="item-card">
            <div class="item-info-wrapper">
                <div class="item-name">${item.name}</div>
                ${item.brand || item.model ? `<div class="item-details">${[item.brand, item.model].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}</div>` : ''}
            </div>
            <div class="item-controls-wrapper">
                <div class="quantity-stepper">
                    <button type="button" class="stepper-btn" data-action="decrease" data-index="${index}">−</button>
                    <div class="stepper-value">${item.quantity}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="stepper-btn" data-action="increase" data-index="${index}">+</button>
                </div>
                <button type="button" class="delete-btn" data-index="${index}">×</button>
            </div>
            <input type="hidden" name="quantity-${item.id}" value="${item.quantity}">
        </div>
    `).join('');

    container.querySelectorAll('.stepper-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const index = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-index'));
            const action = this.getAttribute('data-action');
            const maxQty = window.items[index].available || 999;
            if (action === 'increase' && window.items[index].quantity < maxQty) {
                window.items[index].quantity++;
                renderItems();
            } else if (action === 'decrease' && window.items[index].quantity > 1) {
                window.items[index].quantity--;
                renderItems();
            }
        });
    });

    container.querySelectorAll('.delete-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.items.splice(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-index')), 1);
            renderItems();
        });
    });

    document.getElementById('totalsSection').style.display = 'block';
    updateCounts();
}

function updateCounts() {
    const totalItems = window.items.length;
    const totalUnits = window.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
    document.getElementById('itemCount').textContent = `${totalItems} itens • ${totalUnits} un`;
    document.getElementById('totalItems').textContent = totalItems;
    document.getElementById('totalUnits').textContent = totalUnits;
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block extra_js %}
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<script>
let dadosGlobais = null;
let charts = {};

const colors = {
    gold: '#d4a574',
    success: '#2ecc71',
    danger: '#e74c3c',
    info: '#3498db',
    warning: '#f39c12',
    purple: '#9b59b6',
    cyan: '#1abc9c'
};

Chart.defaults.color = '#888';
Chart.defaults.borderColor = '#2a2a2a';
Chart.defaults.font.family = '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto';

function switchTab(tabName) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
    event.target.closest('.tab').classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById('tab-' + tabName).classList.add('active');
}

function formatMoney(value) {
    if (value === 0) return 'R$ 0';
    if (value < 1000) return 'R$ ' + value.toFixed(0);
    return 'R$ ' + (value / 1000).toFixed(0) + 'k';
}

async function carregarDados() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch('{{ url_for("relatorios.api_dados") }}');
        dadosGlobais = await response.json();

        document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('metrics-section').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('kpi-section').style.display = 'block';

        atualizarMetricas();
        criarKPIs();
        criarGraficos();
        carregarAlertas();
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Erro:', error);
        document.getElementById('loading').innerHTML = '<p style="color: #e74c3c;">Erro ao carregar dados</p>';
    }
}

function atualizarMetricas() {
    const m = dadosGlobais.metricas;
    document.getElementById('metric-receita').textContent = formatMoney(m.receita_mes);
    document.getElementById('metric-equipamentos').textContent = m.total_equipamentos;
    document.getElementById('metric-manutencoes').textContent = m.manutencoes_mes;
    document.getElementById('metric-custo-manutencao').textContent = formatMoney(m.custo_manutencao_mes);
    document.getElementById('metric-utilizacao').textContent = m.taxa_utilizacao.toFixed(1) + '%';
    document.getElementById('metric-margem').textContent = m.margem_lucro.toFixed(1) + '%';
}

function criarKPIs() {
    const container = document.getElementById('kpi-equipamentos');
    const cats = dadosGlobais.equipamentos.por_categoria;

    let html = '';
    for (const [nome, info] of Object.entries(cats)) {
        html += `
            <div class="kpi-card">
                <div class="kpi-icon">${info.icon}</div>
                <div class="kpi-value">${info.count}</div>
                <div class="kpi-label">${nome}</div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    html += `
        <div class="kpi-card">
            <div class="kpi-icon">✅</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">${dadosGlobais.equipamentos.disponiveis}</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">Disponíveis</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
            <div class="kpi-icon">🚚</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">${dadosGlobais.equipamentos.em_tour}</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">Em Tour</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
            <div class="kpi-icon">⚠️</div>
            <div class="kpi-value">${dadosGlobais.equipamentos.em_manutencao}</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">Manutenção</div>
        </div>
    `;

    container.innerHTML = html;
}

function criarGraficos() {
    const f = dadosGlobais.financeiro;
    const e = dadosGlobais.equipamentos;
    const m = dadosGlobais.manutencao;
    const a = dadosGlobais.aquisicoes;

    // Configuração comum para TODOS os gráficos
    const commonOptions = {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        scales: {
            y: {
                ticks: {
                    callback: function(value) {
                        if (value === 0) return 'R$ 0';
                        if (value < 1000) return 'R$ ' + value.toFixed(0);
                        return formatMoney(value);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    };

    // 1. Receitas vs Despesas
    charts.receitasDespesas = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-receitas-despesas'), {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: f.meses_labels,
            datasets: [
                {
                    label: 'Receitas',
                    data: f.receitas_12m,
                    borderColor: colors.success,
                    backgroundColor: colors.success + '20',
                    fill: true,
                    tension: 0.4
                },
                {
                    label: 'Despesas',
                    data: f.despesas_12m,
                    borderColor: colors.danger,
                    backgroundColor: colors.danger + '20',
                    fill: true,
                    tension: 0.4
                }
            ]
        },
        options: { ...commonOptions, plugins: { legend: { position: 'top' } } }
    });

    // 2. Despesas por Categoria
    charts.despesasCategoria = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-despesas-categoria'), {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
            labels: Object.keys(f.despesas_categoria),
            datasets: [{
                data: Object.values(f.despesas_categoria),
                backgroundColor: [colors.purple, colors.cyan, colors.warning, colors.info]
            }]
        },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
    });

    // 3. Margem de Lucro
    charts.margem = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-margem'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
            labels: f.margem_labels,
            datasets: [{
                label: 'Margem (%)',
                data: f.margem_6m,
                backgroundColor: colors.gold
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
            scales: { y: { ticks: { callback: v => v + '%' } } }
        }
    });

    // 4. Crescimento
    const crescimentoDatasets = [];
    const coresCat = [colors.gold, colors.success, colors.info, colors.purple];
    let i = 0;
    for (const [nome, valores] of Object.entries(e.crescimento)) {
        crescimentoDatasets.push({
            label: nome,
            data: valores,
            borderColor: coresCat[i],
            backgroundColor: coresCat[i] + '20',
            tension: 0.4
        });
        i++;
    }

    charts.crescimento = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-crescimento'), {
        type: 'line',
        data: { labels: f.meses_labels, datasets: crescimentoDatasets },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { position: 'top' } },
            scales: { y: { ticks: { stepSize: 1 } } }
        }
    });

    // 5. Patrimônio
    charts.patrimonio = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-patrimonio'), {
        type: 'polarArea',
        data: {
            labels: Object.keys(e.por_categoria),
            datasets: [{
                data: Object.values(e.por_categoria).map(v => v.count * 5000),
                backgroundColor: [colors.gold, colors.success, colors.info, colors.purple]
            }]
        },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
    });

    // 6. Taxa Utilização (simplificado - dados reais)
    charts.utilizacao = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-utilizacao'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
            labels: f.margem_labels,
            datasets: Object.keys(e.por_categoria).map((nome, idx) => ({
                label: nome,
                data: Array(6).fill(dadosGlobais.metricas.taxa_utilizacao),
                backgroundColor: coresCat[idx]
            }))
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { position: 'top' } },
            scales: { y: { ticks: { callback: v => v + '%' } } }
        }
    });

    // 7. Gastos Manutenção
    charts.gastosManutencao = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-gastos-manutencao'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
            labels: f.meses_labels,
            datasets: [{
                label: 'Gastos',
                data: m.gastos_12m,
                backgroundColor: colors.warning
            }]
        },
        options: { ...commonOptions, plugins: { legend: { display: false } } }
    });

    // 8. Tipos Manutenção
    charts.tiposManutencao = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-tipos-manutencao'), {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
            labels: Object.keys(m.tipos),
            datasets: [{
                data: Object.values(m.tipos),
                backgroundColor: [colors.success, colors.warning, colors.info, colors.danger]
            }]
        },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
    });

    // 9. Top Equipamentos
    charts.topEquipamentos = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-top-equipamentos'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
            labels: m.top_equipamentos.map(e => e.nome),
            datasets: [{
                label: 'Manutenções',
                data: m.top_equipamentos.map(e => e.count),
                backgroundColor: colors.danger
            }]
        },
        options: {
            indexAxis: 'y',
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: false } }
        }
    });

    // 10. Aquisições
    charts.aquisicoes = new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-aquisicoes'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
            labels: Object.keys(a),
            datasets: [{
                label: 'Investimento (R$)',
                data: Object.values(a),
                backgroundColor: [colors.gold, colors.success, colors.info, colors.purple]
            }]
        },
        options: { ...commonOptions, plugins: { legend: { display: false } } }
    });
}

function carregarAlertas() {
    const container = document.getElementById('alertas-container');
    let html = '';

    dadosGlobais.alertas.forEach(alerta => {
        html += `
            <div class="alerta-item ${alerta.tipo}">
                <div class="alerta-icon">${alerta.icone}</div>
                <div class="alerta-content">
                    <div class="alerta-titulo">${alerta.titulo}</div>
                    <div class="alerta-mensagem">${alerta.mensagem}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    });

    container.innerHTML = html;
}

carregarDados();
</script>
{% endblock %}
```
