```html
{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.index') }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1><i class="fas fa-hand-holding-usd"></i> Adiantamento</h1>
            <p>Vale salarial (max 40%)</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Form de novo adiantamento -->
    <form method="POST" class="form-card">
        <div class="form-title">Novo Adiantamento</div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">Funcionario</label>
            <select name="employee_id" id="employeeSelect" class="form-control" required onchange="updateEmployeeInfo()">
                <option value="">Selecione...</option>
                {% for emp in employees %}
                <option value="{{ emp.id }}" data-salary="{{ emp.salary }}">{{ emp.name }}</option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>
        </div>

        <div id="employeeInfo" class="employee-info">
            <div class="name" id="empName"></div>
            <div class="salary">Salario: R$ <span id="empSalary">0,00</span></div>
            <div class="max-value">Maximo (40%): R$ <span id="empMax">0,00</span></div>
        </div>

        <!-- Tipo de valor -->
        <div class="form-label">Tipo de Valor</div>
        <div class="tipo-valor-group">
            <div class="tipo-btn active" id="btnPercentual" onclick="setTipoValor('percentual')">
                <i class="fas fa-percent"></i>
                Percentual
            </div>
            <div class="tipo-btn" id="btnFixo" onclick="setTipoValor('fixo')">
                <i class="fas fa-dollar-sign"></i>
                Valor Fixo
            </div>
        </div>
        <input type="hidden" name="tipo_valor" id="tipoValor" value="percentual">

        <!-- Percentual -->
        <div id="percentualGroup" class="percentual-group visible">
            <div class="percentual-value"><span id="percentualDisplay">20</span>%</div>
            <input type="range" name="percentual" id="percentualSlider" class="percentual-slider" 
                   min="5" max="40" step="5" value="20" oninput="updatePercentual()">
            <div class="percentual-labels">
                <span>5%</span>
                <span>40%</span>
            </div>
            <div style="text-align: center; color: #888; margin-top: 8px;">
                Valor: R$ <span id="percentualValor">0,00</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Valor fixo -->
        <div id="valorFixoGroup" class="valor-fixo-group">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Valor (R$)</label>
                <input type="number" name="valor" id="valorFixo" class="form-control" step="0.01" min="0.01" placeholder="0,00">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">Data do Pagamento</label>
            <input type="date" name="data_pagamento" class="form-control" value="{{ today }}">
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="btn-submit">
            <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Criar Adiantamento
        </button>
    </form>

    <!-- Lista de solicitacoes pendentes de aprovacao -->
    <div class="section-title">Aguardando Aprovacao RH</div>

    <div class="list-card">
        {% if solicitacoes_pendentes and solicitacoes_pendentes|length > 0 %}
            {% for sol in solicitacoes_pendentes %}
            <div class="list-item">
                <div class="list-icon" style="background: rgba(251,191,36,0.2); color: #fbbf24;">
                    <i class="fas fa-clock"></i>
                </div>
                <div class="list-info">
                    <h4>{{ sol.employee.name }}</h4>
                    <p>Pagamento: {{ sol.data_pagamento.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</p>
                </div>
                <div class="list-value">
                    <div class="amount">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(sol.valor) }}</div>
                    <div class="date">Solicitado: {{ sol.data_solicitacao.strftime('%d/%m') }}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="list-actions">
                    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('rh.aprovar_adiantamento', id=sol.id) }}" style="display:inline;">
                        <button type="submit" class="btn-action pay" title="Aprovar">
                            <i class="fas fa-check"></i>
                        </button>
                    </form>
                    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('rh.rejeitar_adiantamento', id=sol.id) }}" style="display:inline;">
                        <button type="submit" class="btn-action cancel" title="Rejeitar">
                            <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                        </button>
                    </form>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        {% else %}
            <div class="empty-state">
                <i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i>
                <p>Nenhuma solicitacao pendente de aprovacao</p>
            </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    <!-- Lista de adiantamentos aprovados (pendentes de pagamento) -->
    <div class="section-title">Aprovados - Aguardando Pagamento</div>

    <div class="list-card">
        {% if adiantamentos_aprovados and adiantamentos_aprovados|length > 0 %}
            {% for ad in adiantamentos_aprovados %}
            <div class="list-item">
                <div class="list-icon">
                    <i class="fas fa-hand-holding-usd"></i>
                </div>
                <div class="list-info">
                    <h4>{{ ad.description }}</h4>
                    <p>Vence: {{ ad.due_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</p>
                </div>
                <div class="list-value">
                    <div class="amount">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(ad.amount) }}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="list-actions">
                    <a href="{{ url_for('rh.recibo_adiantamento', id=ad.id) }}" class="btn-action view" title="Ver Recibo">
                        <i class="fas fa-eye"></i>
                    </a>
                    <a href="{{ url_for('rh.recibo_adiantamento', id=ad.id) }}" onclick="setTimeout(()=>window.print(),500)" class="btn-action print" title="Imprimir">
                        <i class="fas fa-print"></i>
                    </a>
                    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('rh.pagar_adiantamento', id=ad.id) }}" style="display:inline;">
                        <button type="submit" class="btn-action pay" title="Pagar">
                            <i class="fas fa-check"></i>
                        </button>
                    </form>
                    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('rh.cancelar_adiantamento', id=ad.id) }}" style="display:inline;">
                        <button type="submit" class="btn-action cancel" title="Cancelar">
                            <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                        </button>
                    </form>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        {% else %}
            <div class="empty-state">
                <i class="fas fa-inbox"></i>
                <p>Nenhum adiantamento aprovado pendente de pagamento</p>
            </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<script>
let salarioAtual = 0;

function updateEmployeeInfo() {
    const select = document.getElementById('employeeSelect');
    const option = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
    const info = document.getElementById('employeeInfo');

    if (option.value) {
        salarioAtual = parseFloat(option.dataset.salary) || 0;
        const maxValue = salarioAtual * 0.40;

        document.getElementById('empName').textContent = option.text;
        document.getElementById('empSalary').textContent = salarioAtual.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2});
        document.getElementById('empMax').textContent = maxValue.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2});
        document.getElementById('valorFixo').max = maxValue;

        info.classList.add('visible');
        updatePercentual();
    } else {
        info.classList.remove('visible');
        salarioAtual = 0;
    }
}

function setTipoValor(tipo) {
    document.getElementById('tipoValor').value = tipo;

    document.getElementById('btnPercentual').classList.toggle('active', tipo === 'percentual');
    document.getElementById('btnFixo').classList.toggle('active', tipo === 'fixo');

    document.getElementById('percentualGroup').classList.toggle('visible', tipo === 'percentual');
    document.getElementById('valorFixoGroup').classList.toggle('visible', tipo === 'fixo');
}

function updatePercentual() {
    const percentual = document.getElementById('percentualSlider').value;
    document.getElementById('percentualDisplay').textContent = percentual;

    const valor = salarioAtual * (percentual / 100);
    document.getElementById('percentualValor').textContent = valor.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2});
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
        gap: 8px;
        margin-top: 12px;
        padding-top: 12px;
        border-top: 1px solid #333;
    }

    .btn-action {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: none;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .btn-pay-first {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1976d2 0%, #0d47a1 100%);
        color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-pay-second {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2e7d32 0%, #1b5e20 100%);
        color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-disabled {
        background: #333;
        color: #666;
        cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .empty-state {
        text-align: center;
        color: #666;
        padding: 60px 20px;
    }

    .info-box {
        background: #1a1a2e;
        border: 1px solid #3f51b5;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 12px;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        color: #9fa8da;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .info-box i {
        margin-right: 8px;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="thirteenth-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.index') }}" class="btn-back">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <h1 class="page-title"><i class="fas fa-gift"></i> 13o Salario</h1>
        <div></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Seletor de Ano e Gerar -->
    <div class="year-selector">
        <label>Ano:</label>
        <select id="yearSelect" onchange="changeYear()">
            {% for y in range(year - 2, year + 2) %}
            <option value="{{ y }}" {{ 'selected' if y == year else '' }}>{{ y }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
        </select>
        <form action="{{ url_for('rh.decimo_terceiro_gerar') }}" method="POST" style="margin-left: auto;">
            <input type="hidden" name="year" value="{{ year }}">
            <button type="submit" class="btn-generate">
                <i class="fas fa-sync-alt"></i> Gerar {{ year }}
            </button>
        </form>
    </div>

    <div class="info-box">
        <i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i>
        <strong>1a Parcela:</strong> ate 30/Nov (50% sem descontos) |
        <strong>2a Parcela:</strong> ate 20/Dez (50% com INSS e IRRF)
    </div>

    <!-- Estatisticas -->
    <div class="stats-row">
        <div class="stat-card">
            <div class="stat-value pending">{{ pendentes }}</div>
            <div class="stat-label">Pendentes</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-card">
            <div class="stat-value money">R$ {{ '{:,.0f}'.format(total_primeira).replace(',', '.') }}</div>
            <div class="stat-label">1a Parcela</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-card">
            <div class="stat-value money">R$ {{ '{:,.0f}'.format(total_segunda).replace(',', '.') }}</div>
            <div class="stat-label">2a Parcela</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Lista de Funcionarios -->
    {% if entries %}
        {% for entry in entries %}
        <div class="employee-card">
            <div class="employee-header">
                <div>
                    <div class="employee-name">{{ entry.employee.name }}</div>
                    <div class="employee-months">{{ entry.months_worked }} meses trabalhados</div>
                </div>
                <span class="status-badge status-{{ entry.status }}">
                    {% if entry.status == 'pending' %}PENDENTE
                    {% elif entry.status == 'first_paid' %}1a PAGA
                    {% elif entry.status == 'completed' %}COMPLETO
                    {% else %}{{ entry.status|upper }}{% endif %}
                </span>
            </div>

            <div class="parcelas-grid">
                <div class="parcela-card">
                    <div class="parcela-label">1a Parcela</div>
                    <div class="parcela-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(entry.first_installment_value or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
                    <span class="parcela-status {{ 'paid' if entry.first_installment_paid else 'pending' }}">
                        {{ 'PAGO' if entry.first_installment_paid else 'PENDENTE' }}
                    </span>
                </div>
                <div class="parcela-card">
                    <div class="parcela-label">2a Parcela</div>
                    <div class="parcela-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(entry.second_installment_net or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
                    <span class="parcela-status {{ 'paid' if entry.second_installment_paid else 'pending' }}">
                        {{ 'PAGO' if entry.second_installment_paid else 'PENDENTE' }}
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="employee-actions">
                {% if not entry.first_installment_paid %}
                <form action="{{ url_for('rh.decimo_terceiro_pagar_primeira', id=entry.id) }}" method="POST" style="flex: 1;">
                    <input type="hidden" name="method" value="transfer">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-action btn-pay-first" style="width: 100%;">
                        <i class="fas fa-check"></i> Pagar 1a
                    </button>
                </form>
                {% else %}
                <button class="btn-action btn-disabled" disabled style="flex: 1;">
                    <i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> 1a Paga
                </button>
                {% endif %}

                {% if entry.first_installment_paid and not entry.second_installment_paid %}
                <form action="{{ url_for('rh.decimo_terceiro_pagar_segunda', id=entry.id) }}" method="POST" style="flex: 1;">
                    <input type="hidden" name="method" value="transfer">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-action btn-pay-second" style="width: 100%;">
                        <i class="fas fa-check"></i> Pagar 2a
                    </button>
                </form>
                {% elif entry.second_installment_paid %}
                <button class="btn-action btn-disabled" disabled style="flex: 1;">
                    <i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> 2a Paga
                </button>
                {% else %}
                <button class="btn-action btn-disabled" disabled style="flex: 1;">
                    <i class="fas fa-lock"></i> Pagar 1a Antes
                </button>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    {% else %}
        <div class="empty-state">
            <i class="fas fa-gift fa-3x" style="margin-bottom: 16px; color: #444;"></i>
            <p>Nenhum 13o gerado para {{ year }}</p>
            <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #555; margin-top: 8px;">
                Clique em "Gerar {{ year }}" para criar automaticamente
            </p>
        </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<script>
function changeYear() {
    const year = document.getElementById('yearSelect').value;
    window.location.href = '{{ url_for("rh.decimo_terceiro_list") }}?year=' + year;
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{% if employee %}Editar{% else %}Novo{% endif %} Funcionario{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .form-container {
        padding: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 100px;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .page-header {
        margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .page-title {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .form-card {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 20px;
    }

    .form-section {
        margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .section-label {
        color: #7b1fa2;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-label.danger {
        color: #ef4444;
    }

    .form-group {
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .form-label {
        display: block;
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .form-control {
        width: 100%;
        background: #252525;
        border: 1px solid #333;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 12px;
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .form-control:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: #7b1fa2;
    }

    .form-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn-submit {
        width: 100%;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7b1fa2 0%, #4a148c 100%);
        color: white;
        border: none;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
        margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .btn-cancel {
        width: 100%;
        background: #333;
        color: #888;
        border: none;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        margin-top: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
    }

    /* Secao de desligamento */
    .desligamento-section {
        display: none;
        background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
        border: 1px solid #ef4444;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 16px;
        margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .desligamento-section.visible {
        display: block;
    }

    .desligamento-warning {
        color: #ef4444;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
    }

    .desligamento-warning i {
        font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="form-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="page-title">
            <i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i> 
            {% if employee %}Editar Funcionario{% else %}Novo Funcionario{% endif %}
        </h1>
    </div>

    <form method="POST" class="form-card">
        <div class="form-section">
            <div class="section-label">Dados Pessoais</div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Nome Completo *</label>
                <input type="text" name="name" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.name if employee else '' }}" required>
            </div>

            <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">CPF</label>
                    <input type="text" name="cpf" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.cpf if employee else '' }}">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">RG</label>
                    <input type="text" name="rg" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.rg if employee else '' }}">
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Data de Nascimento</label>
                <input type="date" name="birth_date" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.birth_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if employee and employee.birth_date else '' }}">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-section">
            <div class="section-label">Contato</div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Email</label>
                <input type="email" name="email" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.email if employee else '' }}">
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Telefone</label>
                <input type="tel" name="phone" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.phone if employee else '' }}">
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Endereco</label>
                <input type="text" name="address" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.address if employee else '' }}">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-section">
            <div class="section-label">Dados Profissionais</div>

            <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">Cargo *</label>
                    <input type="text" name="position" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.position if employee else '' }}" required>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">Departamento</label>
                    <input type="text" name="department" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.department if employee else '' }}">
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">Data Admissao</label>
                    <input type="date" name="admission_date" class="form-control" value="{{ employee.admission_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if employee and employee.admission_date else '' }}">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">Salario (R$) *</label>
                    <input type="number" name="salary" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ employee.salary if employee else '' }}" required>
                </div>
            </div>

            {% if employee %}
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Status</label>
                <select name="status" id="statusSelect" class="form-control" onchange="toggleDesligamento()">
                    <option value="active" {% if employee.status == 'active' %}selected{% endif %}>Ativo</option>
                    <option value="inactive" {% if employee.status == 'inactive' %}selected{% endif %}>Inativo</option>
                    <option value="vacation" {% if employee.status == 'vacation' %}selected{% endif %}>Ferias</option>
                </select>
            </div>

            <!-- Secao de Desligamento - aparece quando status = inactive -->
            <div id="desligamentoSection" class="desligamento-section {% if employee.status == 'inactive' %}visible{% endif %}">
                <div class="section-label danger">Dados do Desligamento</div>

                <div class="desligamento-warning">
                    <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
                    <span>Ao inativar, folhas e contas pendentes serao removidas automaticamente.</span>
                </div>

                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label class="form-label">Motivo</label>
                        <select name="motivo_desligamento" class="form-control">
                            <option value="demissao">Demissao (sem justa causa)</option>
                            <option value="pedido">Pedido de demissao</option>
                            <option value="justa_causa">Demissao por justa causa</option>
                            <option value="acordo">Acordo entre partes</option>
                            <option value="termino_contrato">Termino de contrato</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label class="form-label">Data Desligamento</label>
                        <input type="date" name="data_desligamento" class="form-control" id="data_desligamento">
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        {% if employee %}
        <div class="form-section">
            <div class="section-label">Beneficios</div>

            <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">Vale Transporte (R$)</label>
                    <input type="number" name="vt_value" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ employee.vt_value if employee else '0' }}">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">Vale Refeicao (R$)</label>
                    <input type="number" name="vr_value" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ employee.vr_value if employee else '0' }}">
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">Vale Alimentacao (R$)</label>
                    <input type="number" name="va_value" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ employee.va_value if employee else '0' }}">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label class="form-label">Plano de Saude (R$)</label>
                    <input type="number" name="health_insurance" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ employee.health_insurance if employee else '0' }}">
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Numero de Dependentes (IRRF)</label>
                <input type="number" name="dependents_count" class="form-control" min="0" value="{{ employee.dependents_count if employee else '0' }}">
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}

        <button type="submit" class="btn-submit">
            <i class="fas fa-save"></i> Salvar
        </button>

        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.employees') }}" class="btn-cancel">Cancelar</a>
    </form>
</div>

<script>
function toggleDesligamento() {
    const status = document.getElementById('statusSelect').value;
    const section = document.getElementById('desligamentoSection');
    const dataInput = document.getElementById('data_desligamento');

    if (status === 'inactive') {
        section.classList.add('visible');
        // Preencher data atual se vazio
        if (!dataInput.value) {
            dataInput.value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        }
    } else {
        section.classList.remove('visible');
    }
}

// Executar ao carregar para verificar estado inicial
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    toggleDesligamento();
});
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
                <div class="info-value">{{ employee.phone or '-' }}</div>

            <div class="info-item">
                <div class="info-label">CPF</div>
                <div class="info-value">{{ employee.cpf or '-' }}</div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="info-item">
                <div class="info-label">Status</div>
                <div class="info-value">
                    {% if employee.status == 'active' %}
                    <span style="color:#10b981;">Ativo</span>
                    {% elif employee.status == 'on_leave' %}
                    <span style="color:#f59e0b;">Afastado</span>
                    {% else %}
                    <span style="color:#ef4444;">Desligado</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <a href="{{ url_for('rh.edit_employee', id=employee.id) }}" class="btn-edit">
        <i class="fas fa-edit"></i> Editar Funcionario
    </a>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="employees-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="page-title"><i class="fas fa-id-card"></i> Funcionarios CLT</h1>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.new_employee') }}" class="btn-new">
            <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Novo
        </a>
    </div>

    {% if employees %}
        {% for emp in employees %}
        <div class="employee-card" style="flex-wrap: wrap;">
            <div class="employee-avatar">{{ emp.name[0].upper() }}</div>
            <div class="employee-info">
                <div class="employee-name">
                    {{ emp.name }}
                    <span class="status-badge status-{{ emp.status }}">
                        {{ 'Ativo' if emp.status == 'active' else 'Inativo' }}
                    </span>
                </div>
                <div class="employee-role">{{ emp.position or 'Sem cargo' }} {% if emp.department %} - {{ emp.department }}{% endif %}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="employee-salary">
                R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(emp.salary).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') if emp.salary else '-' }}
            </div>
            <div class="btn-action-row">
                <a href="{{ url_for('rh.edit_employee', id=emp.id) }}" class="btn-edit">
                    <i class="fas fa-edit"></i> Editar
                </a>
                {% if emp.status == 'active' %}
                <button type="button" onclick="startEmployeeWizard({{ emp.id }}, '{{ emp.name|e }}', {{ emp.salary or 0 }})" class="btn-despesas">
                    <i class="bi bi-magic"></i> Despesas Auto
                </button>
                {% else %}
                <button type="button" disabled class="btn-despesas" title="Funcionário inativo">
                    <i class="bi bi-magic"></i> Inativo
                </button>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    {% else %}
        <div class="empty-state">
            <i class="fas fa-user-slash fa-3x" style="margin-bottom: 16px; color: #444;"></i>
            <p>Nenhum funcionario cadastrado</p>
            <a href="{{ url_for('rh.new_employee') }}" class="btn-new" style="margin-top: 16px; display: inline-block;">Cadastrar Primeiro</a>
        </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="vacation-form-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_view', id=vacation.id) }}" class="btn-back">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <h1 class="page-title"><i class="fas fa-calendar-plus"></i> Agendar Ferias</h1>
    </div>

    <div class="alert-info">
        <i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i>
        O pagamento deve ser feito ate 2 dias antes do inicio das ferias
    </div>

    <!-- Funcionario -->
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-user"></i> Funcionario</div>
        <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">Nome</span>
            <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.employee.name }}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">Salario Base</span>
            <span class="info-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(vacation.employee.salary).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">Periodo Aquisitivo</span>
            <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.acquisition_start.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }} - {{ vacation.acquisition_end.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">Limite para Concessao</span>
            <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.concession_end.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if vacation.concession_end else '-' }}</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <form method="POST" id="vacationForm">
        <!-- Data Inicio -->
        <div class="section-card">
            <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-calendar"></i> Data das Ferias</div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Data de Inicio</label>
                <input type="date" name="vacation_start" id="vacation_start" class="form-control" required
                       min="{{ vacation.concession_start.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if vacation.concession_start else '' }}">
                <div class="form-hint">Pagamento sera em: <span id="payment_date">-</span></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Dias -->
        <div class="section-card">
            <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-clock"></i> Configuracao dos Dias</div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Dias de Gozo</label>
                <div class="range-container">
                    <input type="range" name="days_taken" id="days_taken" class="range-input" 
                           min="5" max="30" value="30" oninput="updatePreview()">
                    <span class="range-value" id="days_taken_value">30</span>
                </div>
                <div class="form-hint">Minimo 5 dias, maximo 30 dias</div>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Dias para Venda (Abono Pecuniario)</label>
                <div class="range-container">
                    <input type="range" name="days_sold" id="days_sold" class="range-input" 
                           min="0" max="10" value="0" oninput="updatePreview()">
                    <span class="range-value" id="days_sold_value">0</span>
                </div>
                <div class="form-hint">Maximo 10 dias podem ser vendidos</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Preview Valores -->
        <div class="preview-card">
            <div class="preview-title"><i class="fas fa-calculator"></i> Previsao de Valores</div>

            <div class="preview-row">
                <span class="preview-label">Ferias (<span id="preview_days">30</span> dias)</span>
                <span class="preview-value" id="preview_ferias">R$ 0,00</span>
            </div>
            <div class="preview-row">
                <span class="preview-label">1/3 Constitucional</span>
                <span class="preview-value" id="preview_terco">R$ 0,00</span>
            </div>
            <div class="preview-row" id="abono_row" style="display: none;">
                <span class="preview-label">Abono (<span id="preview_abono_days">0</span> dias)</span>
                <span class="preview-value" id="preview_abono">R$ 0,00</span>
            </div>
            <div class="preview-row" id="abono_terco_row" style="display: none;">
                <span class="preview-label">1/3 sobre Abono</span>
                <span class="preview-value" id="preview_abono_terco">R$ 0,00</span>
            </div>
            <div class="preview-row">
                <span class="preview-label">(-) INSS</span>
                <span class="preview-value discount" id="preview_inss">R$ 0,00</span>
            </div>
            <div class="preview-row">
                <span class="preview-label">(-) IRRF</span>
                <span class="preview-value discount" id="preview_irrf">R$ 0,00</span>
            </div>
            <div class="preview-row total">
                <span class="preview-label"><strong>VALOR LIQUIDO</strong></span>
                <span class="preview-value total" id="preview_liquido">R$ 0,00</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="btn-submit">
            <i class="fas fa-check"></i> Confirmar Agendamento
        </button>
    </form>
</div>

<script>
const salarioBase = {{ vacation.employee.salary or 0 }};

function updatePreview() {
    const daysTaken = parseInt(document.getElementById('days_taken').value);
    const daysSold = parseInt(document.getElementById('days_sold').value);

    // Atualizar displays
    document.getElementById('days_taken_value').textContent = daysTaken;
    document.getElementById('days_sold_value').textContent = daysSold;
    document.getElementById('preview_days').textContent = daysTaken;
    document.getElementById('preview_abono_days').textContent = daysSold;

    // Validar total de dias
    if (daysTaken + daysSold > 30) {
        document.getElementById('days_sold').value = 30 - daysTaken;
        return updatePreview();
    }

    // Calcular valores
    const valorDia = salarioBase / 30;
    const ferias = valorDia * daysTaken;
    const terco = ferias / 3;
    const abono = valorDia * daysSold;
    const abonoTerco = abono / 3;

    // Base para descontos (ferias + 1/3, NAO inclui abono)
    const baseInss = ferias + terco;
    const inss = calcularINSS(baseInss);
    const irrf = calcularIRRF(baseInss - inss);

    const bruto = ferias + terco + abono + abonoTerco;
    const liquido = bruto - inss - irrf;

    // Atualizar preview
    document.getElementById('preview_ferias').textContent = formatMoney(ferias);
    document.getElementById('preview_terco').textContent = formatMoney(terco);
    document.getElementById('preview_inss').textContent = formatMoney(inss);
    document.getElementById('preview_irrf').textContent = formatMoney(irrf);
    document.getElementById('preview_liquido').textContent = formatMoney(liquido);

    // Mostrar/esconder abono
    const abonoRow = document.getElementById('abono_row');
    const abonoTercoRow = document.getElementById('abono_terco_row');
    if (daysSold > 0) {
        abonoRow.style.display = 'flex';
        abonoTercoRow.style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('preview_abono').textContent = formatMoney(abono);
        document.getElementById('preview_abono_terco').textContent = formatMoney(abonoTerco);
    } else {
        abonoRow.style.display = 'none';
        abonoTercoRow.style.display = 'none';
    }
}

function calcularINSS(base) {
    // Tabela INSS 2025 simplificada
    const faixas = [
        {limite: 1518.00, aliquota: 0.075},
        {limite: 2793.88, aliquota: 0.09},
        {limite: 4190.83, aliquota: 0.12},
        {limite: 8157.41, aliquota: 0.14}
    ];

    let inss = 0;
    let anterior = 0;

    for (const faixa of faixas) {
        if (base <= anterior) break;
        const fatia = Math.min(base, faixa.limite) - anterior;
        if (fatia > 0) {
            inss += fatia * faixa.aliquota;
        }
        anterior = faixa.limite;
    }

    return Math.min(inss, 951.63); // Teto INSS
}

function calcularIRRF(base) {
    // Tabela IRRF 2025 simplificada
    if (base <= 2259.20) return 0;
    if (base <= 2826.65) return base * 0.075 - 169.44;
    if (base <= 3751.05) return base * 0.15 - 381.44;
    if (base <= 4664.68) return base * 0.225 - 662.77;
    return base * 0.275 - 896.00;
}

function formatMoney(value) {
    return 'R$ ' + value.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.');
}

// Atualizar data de pagamento
document.getElementById('vacation_start').addEventListener('change', function() {
    const startDate = new Date(this.value);
    if (!isNaN(startDate)) {
        startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - 2);
        const day = String(startDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        const month = String(startDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const year = startDate.getFullYear();
        document.getElementById('payment_date').textContent = `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
    }
});

// Inicializar
updatePreview();
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
        <div class="stat-card">
            <div class="stat-value warning">{{ total_pendentes }}</div>
            <div class="stat-label">Pendentes</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-card">
            <div class="stat-value danger">{{ total_vencidas }}</div>
            <div class="stat-label">Vencidas</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-card">
            <div class="stat-value info">{{ total_agendadas }}</div>
            <div class="stat-label">Agendadas</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Filtros -->
    <div class="filter-tabs">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_list', status='all') }}" 
           class="filter-tab {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'all' else '' }}">Todas</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_list', status='pending') }}" 
           class="filter-tab {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'pending' else '' }}">Pendentes</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_list', status='scheduled') }}" 
           class="filter-tab {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'scheduled' else '' }}">Agendadas</a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_list', status='paid') }}" 
           class="filter-tab {{ 'active' if status_filter == 'paid' else '' }}">Pagas</a>
    </div>

    <!-- Lista de Ferias -->
    {% if vacations %}
        {% for v in vacations %}
        <div class="vacation-card">
            <div class="vacation-header">
                <div>
                    <div class="employee-name">{{ v.employee.name }}</div>
                    <div class="vacation-period">
                        Periodo Aquisitivo: {{ v.acquisition_start.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }} - {{ v.acquisition_end.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <span class="status-badge status-{{ 'overdue' if v.is_overdue else v.status }}">
                    {% if v.is_overdue %}VENCIDAS
                    {% elif v.status == 'pending' %}PENDENTE
                    {% elif v.status == 'scheduled' %}AGENDADA
                    {% elif v.status == 'enjoying' %}EM GOZO
                    {% elif v.status == 'paid' %}PAGA
                    {% else %}{{ v.status|upper }}{% endif %}
                </span>
            </div>

            <div class="vacation-dates">
                <div class="date-item">
                    <div class="date-label">Limite Concessao</div>
                    <div class="date-value">{{ v.concession_end.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if v.concession_end else '-' }}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="date-item">
                    <div class="date-label">Inicio Ferias</div>
                    <div class="date-value">{{ v.vacation_start.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if v.vacation_start else '-' }}</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {% if v.net_value %}
            <div class="vacation-value">
                <span class="value-label">Valor Liquido</span>
                <span class="value-amount">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(v.net_value).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            <div class="vacation-actions">
                <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_view', id=v.id) }}" class="btn-action btn-view">
                    <i class="fas fa-eye"></i> Ver
                </a>
                {% if v.status == 'pending' %}
                <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_agendar', id=v.id) }}" class="btn-action btn-schedule">
                    <i class="fas fa-calendar-plus"></i> Agendar
                </a>
                {% elif v.status == 'scheduled' %}
                <form action="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_pagar', id=v.id) }}" method="POST" style="flex: 1;">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-action btn-pay" style="width: 100%;">
                        <i class="fas fa-check"></i> Pagar
                    </button>
                </form>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    {% else %}
        <div class="empty-state">
            <i class="fas fa-umbrella-beach fa-3x" style="margin-bottom: 16px; color: #444;"></i>
            <p>Nenhum periodo de ferias encontrado</p>
            <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #555; margin-top: 8px;">
                Periodos sao gerados automaticamente ao cadastrar funcionarios
            </p>
        </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}RH - Ferias - {{ vacation.employee.name }}{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .vacation-view-container {
        padding: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 100px;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .page-header {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 16px;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .btn-back {
        background: #333;
        color: white;
        border: none;
        padding: 10px 16px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
    }

    .page-title {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        flex: 1;
    }

    .status-badge {
        padding: 6px 12px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .status-pending { background: #ff9800; color: #000; }
    .status-scheduled { background: #2196f3; color: #fff; }
    .status-paid { background: #4caf50; color: #fff; }
    .status-overdue { background: #f44336; color: #fff; }

    .section-card {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 16px;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-title {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    }

    .info-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 16px;
    }

    .info-item {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .info-item.full {
        grid-column: span 2;
    }

    .info-label {
        color: #666;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .info-value {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 500;
    }

    .info-value.highlight {
        color: #4caf50;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 700;
    }

    .values-table {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .values-table tr {
        border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    }

    .values-table tr:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }

    .values-table td {
        padding: 10px 0;
        color: #f5f5f5;
    }

    .values-table td:first-child {
        color: #888;
    }

    .values-table td:last-child {
        text-align: right;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .values-table tr.total td {
        color: #4caf50;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        padding-top: 12px;
    }

    .values-table tr.discount td:last-child {
        color: #f44336;
    }

    .action-buttons {
        display: flex;
        gap: 12px;
        margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .btn-action {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        border: none;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-decoration: none;
        text-align: center;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .btn-schedule {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7b1fa2 0%, #4a148c 100%);
        color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-pay {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2e7d32 0%, #1b5e20 100%);
        color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-print {
        background: #333;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .alert-box {
        background: #331100;
        border: 1px solid #ff9800;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 12px;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .alert-box.danger {
        background: #330000;
        border-color: #f44336;
    }

    .alert-box i {
        margin-right: 8px;
    }

    .alert-box span {
        color: #ff9800;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .alert-box.danger span {
        color: #f44336;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="vacation-view-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_list') }}" class="btn-back">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <h1 class="page-title">Ferias</h1>
        <span class="status-badge status-{{ 'overdue' if vacation.is_overdue else vacation.status }}">
            {% if vacation.is_overdue %}VENCIDAS
            {% elif vacation.status == 'pending' %}PENDENTE
            {% elif vacation.status == 'scheduled' %}AGENDADA
            {% elif vacation.status == 'paid' %}PAGA
            {% else %}{{ vacation.status|upper }}{% endif %}
        </span>
    </div>

    {% if vacation.is_overdue %}
    <div class="alert-box danger">
        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
        <span>ATENCAO: Ferias vencidas! Periodo concessivo expirou em {{ vacation.concession_end.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
    </div>
    {% elif vacation.status == 'pending' and vacation.concession_end %}
    <div class="alert-box">
        <i class="fas fa-clock"></i>
        <span>Prazo limite para concessao: {{ vacation.concession_end.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Funcionario -->
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-user"></i> Funcionario</div>
        <div class="info-grid">
            <div class="info-item full">
                <span class="info-label">Nome</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.employee.name }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Cargo</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.employee.position or '-' }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Admissao</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.employee.admission_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if vacation.employee.admission_date else '-' }}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Periodos -->
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-calendar-alt"></i> Periodos</div>
        <div class="info-grid">
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Periodo Aquisitivo</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.acquisition_start.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }} - {{ vacation.acquisition_end.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Limite Concessao</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.concession_end.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if vacation.concession_end else '-' }}</span>
            </div>
            {% if vacation.vacation_start %}
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Inicio Ferias</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.vacation_start.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Fim Ferias</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.vacation_end.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if vacation.vacation_end else '-' }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Dias de Gozo</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.days_taken or 30 }} dias</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Dias Vendidos (Abono)</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.days_sold or 0 }} dias</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Valores -->
    {% if vacation.gross_value %}
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-dollar-sign"></i> Valores</div>
        <table class="values-table">
            <tr>
                <td>Ferias ({{ vacation.days_taken or 30 }} dias)</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(vacation.vacation_value or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td>1/3 Constitucional</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(vacation.bonus_value or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            {% if vacation.sold_value and vacation.sold_value > 0 %}
            <tr>
                <td>Abono Pecuniario ({{ vacation.days_sold }} dias)</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(vacation.sold_value).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td>1/3 sobre Abono</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(vacation.sold_bonus or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            {% endif %}
            <tr>
                <td><strong>Total Bruto</strong></td>
                <td><strong>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(vacation.gross_value).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</strong></td>
            </tr>
            <tr class="discount">
                <td>(-) INSS</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(vacation.inss_discount or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr class="discount">
                <td>(-) IRRF</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(vacation.irrf_discount or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr class="total">
                <td>VALOR LIQUIDO</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(vacation.net_value or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
        </table>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Pagamento -->
    {% if vacation.status == 'paid' %}
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> Pagamento</div>
        <div class="info-grid">
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Data Pagamento</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.paid_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if vacation.paid_at else '-' }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Metodo</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ vacation.payment_method or 'Transferencia' }}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Acoes -->
    <div class="action-buttons">
        {% if vacation.status == 'pending' %}
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_agendar', id=vacation.id) }}" class="btn-action btn-schedule">
            <i class="fas fa-calendar-plus"></i> Agendar Ferias
        </a>
        {% elif vacation.status == 'scheduled' %}
        <form action="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_pagar', id=vacation.id) }}" method="POST" style="flex: 1;">
            <input type="hidden" name="method" value="transfer">
            <button type="submit" class="btn-action btn-pay" style="width: 100%;">
                <i class="fas fa-check"></i> Confirmar Pagamento
            </button>
        </form>
        {% elif vacation.status == 'paid' %}
        <a href="#" class="btn-action btn-print" onclick="window.print()">
            <i class="fas fa-print"></i> Imprimir Recibo
        </a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{% if freelancer %}Editar{% else %}Novo{% endif %} Freelancer{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .form-container {
        padding: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 100px;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .page-header {
        margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .page-title {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .form-card {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 20px;
    }

    .form-group {
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .form-label {
        display: block;
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .form-control {
        width: 100%;
        background: #252525;
        border: 1px solid #333;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 12px;
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .form-control:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: #1565c0;
    }

    .form-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn-submit {
        width: 100%;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1565c0 0%, #0d47a1 100%);
        color: white;
        border: none;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
        margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .btn-cancel {
        width: 100%;
        background: #333;
        color: #888;
        border: none;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        margin-top: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="form-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="page-title">
            <i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i> 
            {% if freelancer %}Editar Freelancer{% else %}Novo Freelancer{% endif %}
        </h1>
    </div>

    <form method="POST" class="form-card">
        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">Nome Completo *</label>
            <input type="text" name="name" class="form-control" value="{{ freelancer.name if freelancer else '' }}" required>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">CPF/CNPJ</label>
            <input type="text" name="cpf_cnpj" class="form-control" value="{{ freelancer.cpf_cnpj if freelancer else '' }}">
        </div>

        <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Email</label>
                <input type="email" name="email" class="form-control" value="{{ freelancer.email if freelancer else '' }}">
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Telefone</label>
                <input type="tel" name="phone" class="form-control" value="{{ freelancer.phone if freelancer else '' }}">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">Funcao/Especialidade</label>
            <input type="text" name="role" class="form-control" placeholder="Ex: Tecnico de Som, Iluminador, Roadie..." value="{{ freelancer.role if freelancer else '' }}">
        </div>

        <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Valor Hora (R$)</label>
                <input type="number" name="hourly_rate" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ freelancer.hourly_rate if freelancer else '' }}">
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Valor Diaria (R$)</label>
                <input type="number" name="daily_rate" class="form-control" step="0.01" value="{{ freelancer.daily_rate if freelancer else '' }}">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">Observacoes</label>
            <textarea name="notes" class="form-control" rows="3">{{ freelancer.notes if freelancer else '' }}</textarea>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="btn-submit">
            <i class="fas fa-save"></i> Salvar
        </button>
        
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.freelancers') }}" class="btn-cancel">Cancelar</a>
    </form>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
    .assignment-card {
        margin: 0 16px 12px;
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 16px;
        border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
    }

    .assignment-info h4 {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .assignment-info p {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
    }

    .assignment-value {
        text-align: right;
    }

    .assignment-value .amount {
        color: #10b981;
        font-weight: 700;
    }

    .assignment-value .status {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        color: #888;
    }

    .btn-edit {
        display: block;
        margin: 16px;
        background: #8b5cf6;
        color: #fff;
        text-align: center;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-weight: 700;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.freelancers') }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1>Freelancer</h1>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="profile-card">
        <div class="profile-avatar">
            {{ freelancer.name[0].upper() if freelancer.name else 'F' }}
        </div>
        <div class="profile-name">{{ freelancer.name }}</div>
        <div class="profile-role">{{ freelancer.role or 'Tecnico' }}</div>
        <div class="score-badge">Score: {{ freelancer.overall_score }}/100</div>

        <div class="info-grid">
            <div class="info-item rate-card">
                <div class="info-label">Diaria</div>
                <div class="info-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(freelancer.daily_rate or 0) }}</div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="info-item rate-card">
                <div class="info-label">Hora</div>
                <div class="info-value">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(freelancer.hourly_rate or 0) }}</div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="info-item">
                <div class="info-label">Email</div>
                <div class="info-value">{{ freelancer.email or '-' }}</div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="info-item">
                <div class="info-label">Telefone</div>
                <div class="info-value">{{ freelancer.phone or '-' }}</div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="info-item">
                <div class="info-label">CPF/CNPJ</div>
                <div class="info-value">{{ freelancer.cpf_cnpj or '-' }}</div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="info-item">
                <div class="info-label">Total Jobs</div>
                <div class="info-value">{{ freelancer.total_jobs }}</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    {% if assignments %}
    <h4 class="section-title">Ultimos Trabalhos</h4>
    {% for a in assignments %}
    <div class="assignment-card">
        <div class="assignment-info">
            <h4>{{ a.role }}</h4>
            <p>{{ a.start_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if a.start_date else '-' }}</p>
        </div>
        <div class="assignment-value">
            <div class="amount">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(a.total_amount or 0) }}</div>
            <div class="status">{{ a.status }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endfor %}
    {% endif %}

    <a href="{{ url_for('rh.freelancers') }}" class="btn-edit">
        <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Voltar para Lista
    </a>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="freelancers-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="page-title"><i class="fas fa-user-clock"></i> Freelancers</h1>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.new_freelancer') }}" class="btn-new">
            <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Novo
        </a>
    </div>

    {% if freelancers %}
        {% for fl in freelancers %}
        <div class="freelancer-card">
            <div class="freelancer-header">
                <div class="freelancer-avatar">{{ fl.name[0].upper() }}</div>
                <div class="freelancer-info">
                    <div class="freelancer-name">{{ fl.name }}</div>
                    <div class="freelancer-role">{{ fl.role or 'Sem funcao' }}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="freelancer-score">
                    <div class="score-value">{{ fl.overall_score }}%</div>
                    <div class="score-label">Score</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="freelancer-rates">
                <div class="rate-item">
                    <div class="rate-value">
                        {% if fl.hourly_rate %}R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(fl.hourly_rate).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}{% else %}-{% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <div class="rate-label">Hora</div>
                </div>
                <div class="rate-item">
                    <div class="rate-value">
                        {% if fl.daily_rate %}R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(fl.daily_rate).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}{% else %}-{% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <div class="rate-label">Diaria</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #333;">
                <a href="{{ url_for('rh.edit_freelancer', id=fl.id) }}" style="flex: 1; background: #333; color: #fff; padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.85rem;">
                    <i class="fas fa-edit"></i> Editar
                </a>
                <button type="button" onclick="startFreelancerPaymentWizard({{ fl.id }}, '{{ fl.name|e }}', 'Evento', {{ fl.daily_rate or 0 }})" 
                        style="flex: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1565c0 0%, #0d47a1 100%); color: #fff; padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem;">
                    <i class="bi bi-cash"></i> Pagar + Conta
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    {% else %}
        <div class="empty-state">
            <i class="fas fa-user-clock fa-3x" style="margin-bottom: 16px; color: #444;"></i>
            <p>Nenhum freelancer cadastrado</p>
            <a href="{{ url_for('rh.new_freelancer') }}" class="btn-new" style="margin-top: 16px; display: inline-block;">Cadastrar Primeiro</a>
        </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="rh-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <h1 class="page-title"><i class="fas fa-users"></i> RH</h1>
    </div>

    <!-- Alertas -->
    {% if ferias_vencidas and ferias_vencidas > 0 %}
    <div class="alert-card danger">
        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
        <div class="alert-card-content">
            <div class="alert-card-title">{{ ferias_vencidas }} Ferias Vencidas!</div>
            <div class="alert-card-desc">Funcionarios com periodo concessivo expirado</div>
        </div>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_list', status='pending') }}" class="alert-card-action">Ver</a>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    {% if ferias_proximas and ferias_proximas > 0 %}
    <div class="alert-card">
        <i class="fas fa-umbrella-beach"></i>
        <div class="alert-card-content">
            <div class="alert-card-title">{{ ferias_proximas }} Ferias Proximas</div>
            <div class="alert-card-desc">Agendadas para os proximos 30 dias</div>
        </div>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_list', status='scheduled') }}" class="alert-card-action">Ver</a>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- KPIs -->
    <div class="kpis">
        <div class="kpi-card">
            <div class="kpi-value purple">{{ employees|length }}</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">Funcionarios CLT</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
            <div class="kpi-value">{{ freelancers|length }}</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">Freelancers</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
            <div class="kpi-value green">R$ {{ '{:,.0f}'.format(payroll_total).replace(',', '.') }}</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">Folha {{ current_month }}/{{ current_year }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
            <div class="kpi-value orange">{{ pending_payrolls }}</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">Folhas Pendentes</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Acoes Rapidas - Gestao -->
    <h3 class="section-title">
        <span><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> Gestao de Pessoas</span>
    </h3>

    <div class="quick-actions">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.employees') }}" class="action-card employees">
            <i class="fas fa-id-card"></i>
            <span>Funcionarios</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.freelancers') }}" class="action-card freelancers">
            <i class="fas fa-user-clock"></i>
            <span>Freelancers</span>
        </a>
    </div>

    <!-- Acoes Rapidas - Financeiro RH -->
    <h3 class="section-title">
        <span><i class="fas fa-dollar-sign"></i> Financeiro RH</span>
    </h3>

    <div class="quick-actions">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.payroll') }}" class="action-card payroll">
            <i class="fas fa-money-check-alt"></i>
            <span>Folha de Pagamento</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.adiantamento') }}" class="action-card adiantamento">
            <i class="fas fa-hand-holding-usd"></i>
            <span>Adiantamentos</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.ferias_list') }}" class="action-card ferias">
            <i class="fas fa-umbrella-beach"></i>
            <span>Ferias{% if ferias_vencidas %}<span class="badge">{{ ferias_vencidas }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.decimo_terceiro_list') }}" class="action-card decimo">
            <i class="fas fa-gift"></i>
            <span>13o Salario</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.rescisoes_list') }}" class="action-card rescisao">
            <i class="fas fa-user-times"></i>
            <span>Rescisoes</span>
        </a>
    </div>

    <!-- Acoes Rapidas - Cadastros -->
    <h3 class="section-title">
        <span><i class="fas fa-plus-circle"></i> Cadastros Rapidos</span>
    </h3>

    <div class="quick-actions">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.new_employee') }}" class="action-card">
            <i class="fas fa-user-plus" style="color: #7b1fa2;"></i>
            <span>Novo Funcionario</span>
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.new_freelancer') }}" class="action-card">
            <i class="fas fa-user-plus" style="color: #1565c0;"></i>
            <span>Novo Freelancer</span>
        </a>
    </div>

    <!-- Ranking -->
    <h3 class="section-title">
        <span><i class="fas fa-trophy"></i> Ranking de Performance</span>
    </h3>

    <div class="ranking-list">
        {% if ranking %}
            {% for item in ranking %}
            <div class="ranking-item">
                <div class="ranking-position {% if loop.index == 1 %}gold{% elif loop.index == 2 %}silver{% elif loop.index == 3 %}bronze{% endif %}">
                    {{ loop.index }}
                </div>
                <div class="ranking-info">
                    <div class="ranking-name">{{ item.employee.name }}</div>
                    <div class="ranking-role">{{ item.employee.position or 'Sem cargo' }}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="ranking-score">{{ item.score }}%</div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        {% else %}
            <div class="empty-state">Nenhum funcionario cadastrado</div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Folha de Pagamento - {{ month }}/{{ year }}{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .page-container {
        padding: 0;
        min-height: 100vh;
        padding-bottom: 100px;
        background: #000;
    }

    .page-header {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.3) 0%, rgba(41, 128, 185, 0.2) 100%);
        padding: 20px 16px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
    }

    .back-btn {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        text-decoration: none;
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;

    .page-title h1 {
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #f5f5f5;
        margin: 0;

        align-items: center;

        color: #888;
        text-decoration: none;

        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #1a1a1a;

    .month-nav a:active {
        background: #2a2a2a;
    }

    .month-nav .current-month {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #f5f5f5;
    }

    /* Botão Gerar */
    .form-card {
        margin: 16px;
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 16px;
        border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    }

    .btn-generate {
        width: 100%;
        background: #f1c40f;
        color: #000;
        border: none;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
```
