```html
    /* Lista de folhas */
    .section-title {
        padding: 16px;
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    }

    .list-card {
        margin: 0 16px;
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    }

    .list-item {
        padding: 16px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    }

    .list-item:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }

    .list-header {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .employee-name {
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .status-badge {
        padding: 4px 12px;
        border-radius: 15px;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .status-pending { background: #f39c12; color: #000; }
    .status-approved { background: #3498db; color: #fff; }
    .status-paid { background: #27ae60; color: #fff; }

    /* Valores em linha */
    .values-row {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .value-item {
        text-align: center;
        flex: 1;
    }

    .value-item .label {
        font-size: 0.65rem;
        color: #666;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .value-item .amount {
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #f5f5f5;
    }

    .value-item .amount.green { color: #27ae60; }
    .value-item .amount.red { color: #e74c3c; }

    /* Botões de ação */
    .list-actions {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        gap: 8px;
        padding-top: 12px;
        border-top: 1px dashed #2a2a2a;
    }

    .btn-action {
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        border: none;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .btn-action.view {
        background: #3b82f6;
        color: white;
    }

    .btn-action.print {
        background: #f59e0b;
        color: white;
    }

    .btn-action.approve {
        background: #3498db;
        color: white;
    }

    .btn-action.pay {
        background: #10b981;
        color: white;
    }

    .btn-action.paid-icon {
        background: #27ae60;
        color: white;
        cursor: default;
    }

    /* Resumo do mês */
    .summary-section {
        margin: 16px;
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 16px;
        border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    }

    .summary-title {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #f59e0b;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .summary-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 10px;
    }

    .summary-item {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 10px;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    .summary-item .label {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        color: #888;
    }

    .summary-item .value {
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        color: #f5f5f5;
    }

    .empty-state {
        padding: 40px;
        text-align: center;
        color: #666;
    }

    .empty-state i {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        display: block;
        color: #444;
    }

    /* Cards resumo topo */
    .top-summary {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    .top-card {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 14px;
        text-align: center;
        border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    }

    .top-card.liquido {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #27ae60 0%, #2ecc71 100%);
        border: none;
    }

    .top-card.custo {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8e44ad 0%, #9b59b6 100%);
        border: none;
    }

    .top-card .label {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        opacity: 0.8;
        color: #888;
    }

    .top-card.liquido .label,
    .top-card.custo .label {
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
    }

    .top-card .value {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin-top: 4px;
        color: #f5f5f5;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.index') }}" class="back-btn">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <div class="page-title">
            <h1><i class="fas fa-file-invoice-dollar"></i> Folha de Pagamento</h1>
            <p>Holerites CLT</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Navegação de meses -->
    <div class="month-nav">
        {% set prev_month = month - 1 if month > 1 else 12 %}
        {% set prev_year = year if month > 1 else year - 1 %}
        {% set next_month = month + 1 if month < 12 else 1 %}
        {% set next_year = year if month < 12 else year + 1 %}

        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.payroll', month=prev_month, year=prev_year) }}">
            <i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>
        </a>
        <span class="current-month">
            {{ ['Janeiro','Fevereiro','Março','Abril','Maio','Junho','Julho','Agosto','Setembro','Outubro','Novembro','Dezembro'][month-1] }} / {{ year }}
        </span>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.payroll', month=next_month, year=next_year) }}">
            <i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
        </a>
    </div>

    <!-- Cards resumo topo -->
    <div class="top-summary">
        <div class="top-card liquido">
            <div class="label">Total Líquido</div>
            <div class="value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(total_liquido) }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="top-card custo">
            <div class="label">Custo Total</div>
            <div class="value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(total_custo) }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="top-card">
            <div class="label">INSS Total</div>
            <div class="value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(total_inss) }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="top-card">
            <div class="label">FGTS Total</div>
            <div class="value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(total_fgts) }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Botão gerar -->
    <div class="form-card">
        <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('rh.generate_payroll') }}">
            <input type="hidden" name="month" value="{{ month }}">
            <input type="hidden" name="year" value="{{ year }}">
            <button type="submit" class="btn-generate">
                📋 Gerar Folhas do Mês
            </button>
        </form>
    </div>

    <!-- Lista de holerites -->
    <div class="section-title">Folhas do Mês</div>

    <div class="list-card">
        {% if entries %}
            {% for entry in entries %}
            <div class="list-item">
                <div class="list-header">
                    <span class="employee-name">{{ entry.employee.name }}</span>
                    <span class="status-badge status-{{ entry.status }}">
                        {% if entry.status == 'pending' %}Pendente
                        {% elif entry.status == 'approved' %}Aprovado
                        {% else %}Pago{% endif %}
                    </span>
                </div>

                <div class="values-row">
                    <div class="value-item">
                        <span class="label">Bruto</span>
                        <span class="amount">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(entry.gross_salary|float) }}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="value-item">
                        <span class="label">Descontos</span>
                        <span class="amount red">- R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(entry.deductions|float) }}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="value-item">
                        <span class="label">Líquido</span>
                        <span class="amount green">R$ {{ "%.0f"|format(entry.net_salary|float) }}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="list-actions">
                    <!-- Ver holerite -->
                    <a href="{{ url_for('rh.view_payroll', id=entry.id) }}" class="btn-action view" title="Ver Holerite">
                        <i class="fas fa-eye"></i>
                    </a>

                    <!-- Imprimir -->
                    <a href="{{ url_for('rh.view_payroll', id=entry.id) }}" target="_blank" class="btn-action print" title="Imprimir">
                        <i class="fas fa-print"></i>
                    </a>

                    {% if entry.status == 'pending' %}
                    <!-- Aprovar -->
                    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('rh.approve_payroll', id=entry.id) }}" style="display:inline; margin:0;">
                        <button type="submit" class="btn-action approve" title="Aprovar">
                            <i class="fas fa-check"></i>
                        </button>
                    </form>
                    {% elif entry.status == 'approved' %}
                    <!-- Pagar -->
                    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('rh.pay_payroll', id=entry.id) }}" style="display:inline; margin:0;">
                        <button type="submit" class="btn-action pay" title="Registrar Pagamento">
                            <i class="fas fa-dollar-sign"></i>
                        </button>
                    </form>
                    {% else %}
                    <!-- Já pago -->
                    <span class="btn-action paid-icon" title="Pago">
                        <i class="fas fa-check-double"></i>
                    </span>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        {% else %}
            <div class="empty-state">
                <i class="fas fa-file-invoice-dollar"></i>
                <p>Nenhuma folha para este mês</p>
                <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 8px;">Clique em "Gerar Folhas" para criar</p>
            </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    <!-- Resumo do mês -->
    {% if entries %}
    <div class="summary-section">
        <div class="summary-title">📊 Resumo do Mês</div>
        <div class="summary-grid">
            <div class="summary-item">
                <span class="label">IRRF</span>
                <span class="value">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(total_irrf) }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="summary-item">
                <span class="label">Folhas</span>
                <span class="value">{{ entries|length }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="summary-item">
                <span class="label">Pendentes</span>
                <span class="value">{{ entries|selectattr('status', 'equalto', 'pending')|list|length }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="summary-item">
                <span class="label">Pagas</span>
                <span class="value">{{ entries|selectattr('status', 'equalto', 'paid')|list|length }}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="page-container">

    <!-- ============================================
         TOOLBAR - NÃO IMPRIME
         ============================================ -->
    <div class="toolbar no-print">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.payroll', month=entry.reference_month, year=entry.reference_year) }}" class="btn btn-back">
            ← Voltar
        </a>

        <h2>📋 {{ entry.employee.name }} - {{ '%02d'|format(entry.reference_month) }}/{{ entry.reference_year }}</h2>

        <span class="status status-{{ entry.status }}">
            {% if entry.status == 'pending' %}⏳ Pendente
            {% elif entry.status == 'approved' %}✓ Aprovado
            {% else %}💰 Pago{% endif %}
        </span>

        {% if entry.status == 'pending' %}
        <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('rh.approve_payroll', id=entry.id) }}" style="display:inline; margin:0;">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-approve">✓ Aprovar</button>
        </form>
        {% elif entry.status == 'approved' %}
        <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('rh.pay_payroll', id=entry.id) }}" style="display:inline; margin:0;">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-pay">💵 Registrar Pagamento</button>
        </form>
        {% endif %}

        <button onclick="window.print()" class="btn btn-print">🖨️ Imprimir</button>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
         HOLERITE - MEIA FOLHA A4
         ============================================ -->
    <div class="holerite-wrapper">
    <div class="holerite">

        <!-- CABEÇALHO EMPRESA -->
        <table class="emp-header">
        <tr>
            <td style="width:60%">
                <div class="emp-info">
                    <strong>EMPRESA:</strong> {{ current_user.company.name or 'EMPRESA LTDA' }}<br>
                    <strong>CNPJ:</strong> {{ current_user.company.cnpj or '00.000.000/0001-00' }}<br>
                    <strong>ENDEREÇO:</strong> {{ current_user.company.address or 'Endereço da Empresa' }}
                </div>
            </td>
            <td class="titulo-box">
                <div>RECIBO DE PAGAMENTO</div>
                <div>DE SALÁRIO</div>
                <div class="periodo">Referente: {{ '%02d'|format(entry.reference_month) }}/{{ entry.reference_year }}</div>
            </td>
        </tr>
        </table>

        <!-- DADOS DO FUNCIONÁRIO -->
        <table>
        <tr class="func-header">
            <th style="width:12%">MATRÍCULA</th>
            <th>NOME DO FUNCIONÁRIO</th>
            <th style="width:15%">ADMISSÃO</th>
            <th style="width:18%">FUNÇÃO</th>
        </tr>
        <tr class="func-data">
            <td style="text-align:center; font-weight:bold;">{{ '%05d'|format(entry.employee.id) }}</td>
            <td style="font-weight:bold;">{{ entry.employee.name|upper }}</td>
            <td style="text-align:center;">{{ entry.employee.admission_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if entry.employee.admission_date else '-' }}</td>
            <td>{{ (entry.employee.position or 'FUNCIONÁRIO')|upper }}</td>
        </tr>
        </table>

        <!-- PROVENTOS E DESCONTOS -->
        <table>
        <tr>
            <th class="codigo">CÓD.</th>
            <th class="descricao">DESCRIÇÃO</th>
            <th class="ref">REF.</th>
            <th class="col-prov">PROVENTOS</th>
            <th class="col-desc">DESCONTOS</th>
        </tr>

        <!-- PROVENTOS -->
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">001</td>
            <td>SALÁRIO BASE</td>
            <td class="ref">220:00</td>
            <td class="valores valores-prov">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.base_salary|float) }}</td>
            <td></td>
        </tr>

        {% if entry.overtime_hours and entry.overtime_hours > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">002</td>
            <td>HORAS EXTRAS 50%</td>
            <td class="ref">{{ "%.1f"|format(entry.overtime_hours|float) }}h</td>
            <td class="valores valores-prov">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.overtime_amount|float) }}</td>
            <td></td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        {% if entry.night_shift_amount and entry.night_shift_amount > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">003</td>
            <td>ADICIONAL NOTURNO</td>
            <td class="ref">{{ "%.1f"|format(entry.night_shift_hours|float) }}h</td>
            <td class="valores valores-prov">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.night_shift_amount|float) }}</td>
            <td></td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        {% if entry.bonuses and entry.bonuses > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">004</td>
            <td>GRATIFICAÇÕES / BÔNUS</td>
            <td class="ref"></td>
            <td class="valores valores-prov">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.bonuses|float) }}</td>
            <td></td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        {% if entry.commissions and entry.commissions > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">005</td>
            <td>COMISSÕES</td>
            <td class="ref"></td>
            <td class="valores valores-prov">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.commissions|float) }}</td>
            <td></td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        <!-- LINHA SEPARADORA -->
        <tr class="linha-vazia"><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>

        <!-- DESCONTOS -->
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">901</td>
            <td>INSS</td>
            <td class="ref">{{ "%.1f"|format((entry.inss_employee|float / entry.gross_salary|float * 100) if entry.gross_salary and entry.gross_salary > 0 else 0) }}%</td>
            <td></td>
            <td class="valores valores-desc">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.inss_employee|float) }}</td>
        </tr>

        {% if entry.irrf and entry.irrf > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">902</td>
            <td>IRRF</td>
            <td class="ref"></td>
            <td></td>
            <td class="valores valores-desc">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.irrf|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        {% if entry.vt_discount and entry.vt_discount > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">903</td>
            <td>VALE TRANSPORTE</td>
            <td class="ref">6%</td>
            <td></td>
            <td class="valores valores-desc">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.vt_discount|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        {% if entry.vr_discount and entry.vr_discount > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">904</td>
            <td>VALE REFEIÇÃO</td>
            <td class="ref"></td>
            <td></td>
            <td class="valores valores-desc">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.vr_discount|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        {% if entry.health_discount and entry.health_discount > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">905</td>
            <td>PLANO DE SAÚDE</td>
            <td class="ref"></td>
            <td></td>
            <td class="valores valores-desc">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.health_discount|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        {% if entry.advances and entry.advances > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">910</td>
            <td>ADIANTAMENTO</td>
            <td class="ref"></td>
            <td></td>
            <td class="valores valores-desc">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.advances|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        {% if entry.other_deductions and entry.other_deductions > 0 %}
        <tr>
            <td class="codigo">999</td>
            <td>OUTROS DESCONTOS</td>
            <td class="ref"></td>
            <td></td>
            <td class="valores valores-desc">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.other_deductions|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}

        <!-- TOTAIS -->
        <tr class="totais-row">
            <td colspan="3" class="total-prov-bg" style="text-align:right;">TOTAL PROVENTOS:</td>
            <td class="total-prov-bg valores">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.gross_salary|float) }}</td>
            <td class="total-prov-bg"></td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="totais-row">
            <td colspan="3" class="total-desc-bg" style="text-align:right;">TOTAL DESCONTOS:</td>
            <td class="total-desc-bg"></td>
            <td class="total-desc-bg valores">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.deductions|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="totais-row">
            <td colspan="3" class="total-liq-bg" style="text-align:right;">LÍQUIDO A RECEBER:</td>
            <td colspan="2" class="total-liq-bg valores" style="text-align:center;">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.net_salary|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        </table>

        <!-- BASES DE CÁLCULO -->
        <table class="bases-table">
        <tr>
            <td>
                <span class="label">BASE INSS</span>
                <span class="valor">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.gross_salary|float) }}</span>
            </td>
            <td>
                <span class="label">BASE FGTS</span>
                <span class="valor">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.gross_salary|float) }}</span>
            </td>
            <td>
                <span class="label">FGTS DO MÊS</span>
                <span class="valor">{{ "%.2f"|format(entry.fgts|float) }}</span>
            </td>
            <td>
                <span class="label">BASE IRRF</span>
                <span class="valor">{{ "%.2f"|format((entry.gross_salary|float) - (entry.inss_employee|float)) }}</span>
            </td>
            <td>
                <span class="label">FAIXA IRRF</span>
                <span class="valor">
                    {% set base_irrf = (entry.gross_salary|float) - (entry.inss_employee|float) %}
                    {% if base_irrf <= 2259.20 %}ISENTO
                    {% elif base_irrf <= 2826.65 %}7,5%
                    {% elif base_irrf <= 3751.05 %}15%
                    {% elif base_irrf <= 4664.68 %}22,5%
                    {% else %}27,5%{% endif %}
                </span>
            </td>
        </tr>
        </table>

        <!-- PROVISÕES (13º E FÉRIAS) - SÓ TELA, NÃO IMPRIME -->
        <table class="prov-section no-print">
        <tr>
            <td colspan="6" class="section-title">📅 PROVISÕES DO MÊS (13º Salário e Férias)</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td class="label">13º Salário:</td>
            <td class="valor">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.provision_13th|float) }}</td>
            <td class="label">Férias:</td>
            <td class="valor">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.provision_vacation|float) }}</td>
            <td class="label">1/3 Férias:</td>
            <td class="valor">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.provision_vacation_bonus|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td class="label">FGTS s/ 13º:</td>
            <td class="valor">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.provision_fgts_13th|float) }}</td>
            <td class="label">FGTS s/ Férias:</td>
            <td class="valor">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.provision_fgts_vacation|float) }}</td>
            <td class="label prov-total">TOTAL PROVISÕES:</td>
            <td class="valor prov-total">R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.total_provisions|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        </table>

        <!-- ENCARGOS PATRONAIS - SÓ TELA, NÃO IMPRIME -->
        <table class="enc-section no-print">
        <tr>
            <td colspan="4" class="section-title">🏢 ENCARGOS PATRONAIS (Não descontam do funcionário)</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td><span class="label">INSS Patronal (20%):</span> <strong>R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.inss_employer|float) }}</strong></td>
            <td><span class="label">RAT/SAT:</span> <strong>R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.inss_rat|float) }}</strong></td>
            <td><span class="label">Sistema S:</span> <strong>R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.inss_terceiros|float) }}</strong></td>
            <td><span class="label">FGTS (8%):</span> <strong>R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.fgts|float) }}</strong></td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="custo-total-row">
            <td colspan="4">💰 CUSTO TOTAL EMPRESA: R$ {{ "%.2f"|format(entry.total_employer_cost|float) }}</td>
        </tr>
        </table>

        <!-- ASSINATURA -->
        <table class="assinatura-section">
        <tr>
            <td style="width:50%;">
                DECLARO TER RECEBIDO A IMPORTÂNCIA LÍQUIDA DISCRIMINADA NESTE RECIBO
            </td>
            <td>
                ASSINATURA DO FUNCIONÁRIO / DATA: ____/____/________
            </td>
        </tr>
        </table>

        <!-- LINHA DE CORTE (opcional para imprimir 2ª via) -->
        <div class="linha-corte no-print"></div>

    </div>
    </div>

</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Relatorio de Custo por Funcionario{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .report-container {
        padding: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 100px;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .page-header {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 12px;
    }

    .page-title {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .period-badge {
        background: #2a2a2a;
        color: #d4a574;
        padding: 6px 12px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .summary-cards {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
        gap: 12px;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .summary-card {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2a2a2a 100%);
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 16px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .summary-card.highlight {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7b1fa2 0%, #4a148c 100%);
    }

    .summary-label {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .summary-card.highlight .summary-label {
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
    }

    .summary-value {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        font-weight: 700;
    }

    .employee-table {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        overflow: hidden;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .table-header {
        background: #2a2a2a;
        padding: 12px 16px;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 8px;
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .employee-row {
        padding: 12px 16px;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 8px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
        align-items: center;
    }

    .employee-row:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }

    .employee-name {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .employee-role {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
    }

    .value-cell {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        text-align: right;
    }

    .value-highlight {
        color: #d4a574;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .detail-section {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .detail-header {
        background: #2a2a2a;
        padding: 12px 16px;
        color: #d4a574;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .detail-content {
        padding: 16px;
    }

    .cost-breakdown {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
        gap: 16px;
    }

    .cost-item {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 8px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    }

    .cost-label {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .cost-value {
        color: #f5f5f5;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .empty-state {
        text-align: center;
        color: #666;
        padding: 60px 20px;
    }

    .btn-back {
        background: #333;

        border-radius: 8px;

    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .table-header, .employee-row {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        }
        .table-header > :nth-child(n+3),
        .employee-row > :nth-child(n+3) {
            display: none;
        }
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="report-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <div>
            <h1 class="page-title">Custo Total por Funcionario</h1>
            <span class="period-badge">
                <i class="fas fa-calendar"></i>
                {{ periodo_inicio.strftime('%m/%Y') }} - {{ periodo_fim.strftime('%m/%Y') }}
            </span>
        </div>
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.dashboard') }}" class="btn-back">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Voltar
        </a>
    </div>

    {% if relatorio %}
    <div class="summary-cards">
        <div class="summary-card highlight">
            <div class="summary-label">Custo Total Mensal</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(totais.custo_total).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-card">
            <div class="summary-label">Salarios</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(totais.salarios).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-card">
            <div class="summary-label">INSS Patronal</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(totais.inss_patronal).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-card">
            <div class="summary-label">FGTS</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(totais.fgts).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-card">
            <div class="summary-label">Prov. Ferias</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(totais.provisao_ferias).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-card">
            <div class="summary-label">Prov. 13o</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(totais.provisao_13).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-card">
            <div class="summary-label">Beneficios</div>
            <div class="summary-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(totais.beneficios).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="detail-section">
        <div class="detail-header">
            <i class="fas fa-users"></i> Detalhamento por Funcionario
        </div>
        <div class="employee-table">
            <div class="table-header">
                <div>Funcionario</div>
                <div style="text-align: right;">Salario</div>
                <div style="text-align: right;">Encargos</div>
                <div style="text-align: right;">Beneficios</div>
                <div style="text-align: right;">Custo Total</div>
            </div>
            {% for item in relatorio %}
            <div class="employee-row">
                <div>
                    <div class="employee-name">{{ item.funcionario.name }}</div>
                    <div class="employee-role">{{ item.funcionario.position or 'Sem cargo' }}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="value-cell">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(item.salario).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
                <div class="value-cell">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(item.inss_patronal + item.fgts + item.provisao_ferias + item.provisao_13).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
                <div class="value-cell">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(item.beneficios).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
                <div class="value-cell value-highlight">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(item.custo_mensal).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="detail-section">
        <div class="detail-header">
            <i class="fas fa-chart-pie"></i> Analise de Composicao
        </div>
        <div class="detail-content">
            <div class="cost-breakdown">
                <div>
                    <div class="cost-item">
                        <span class="cost-label">Salarios Brutos</span>
                        <span class="cost-value">{{ '{:.1f}'.format((totais.salarios / totais.custo_total * 100) if totais.custo_total else 0) }}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="cost-item">
                        <span class="cost-label">INSS Patronal (20%)</span>
                        <span class="cost-value">{{ '{:.1f}'.format((totais.inss_patronal / totais.custo_total * 100) if totais.custo_total else 0) }}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="cost-item">
                        <span class="cost-label">FGTS (8%)</span>
                        <span class="cost-value">{{ '{:.1f}'.format((totais.fgts / totais.custo_total * 100) if totais.custo_total else 0) }}%</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <div class="cost-item">
                        <span class="cost-label">Provisao Ferias</span>
                        <span class="cost-value">{{ '{:.1f}'.format((totais.provisao_ferias / totais.custo_total * 100) if totais.custo_total else 0) }}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="cost-item">
                        <span class="cost-label">Provisao 13o Salario</span>
                        <span class="cost-value">{{ '{:.1f}'.format((totais.provisao_13 / totais.custo_total * 100) if totais.custo_total else 0) }}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="cost-item">
                        <span class="cost-label">Beneficios</span>
                        <span class="cost-value">{{ '{:.1f}'.format((totais.beneficios / totais.custo_total * 100) if totais.custo_total else 0) }}%</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    {% else %}
    <div class="empty-state">
        <i class="fas fa-users" style="font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 16px;"></i>
        <h3>Nenhum funcionario ativo</h3>
        <p>Cadastre funcionarios para visualizar o relatorio de custos.</p>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}RH - Nova Rescisao{% endblock %}

{% block extra_css %}
<style>
    .termination-form-container {
        padding: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 100px;
        background: #0a0a0a;

    .btn-back {

    .page-title {

        font-weight: 600;

    .section-card {
        background: #1a1a1a;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 16px;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-title {
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    }

    .form-group {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

        display: block;
        color: #888;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
        text-transform: uppercase;

        width: 100%;
        background: #0a0a0a;
        border: 1px solid #333;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 14px;
        color: #f5f5f5;

    .form-control:focus {
        outline: none;

    .form-hint {

    }

        padding: 12px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    }

    .employee-select-item:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="termination-form-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.rescisoes_list') }}" class="btn-back">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <h1 class="page-title"><i class="fas fa-user-times"></i> Nova Rescisao</h1>
    </div>

    <div class="alert-warning">
        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
        Atencao: A rescisao sera calculada automaticamente com base no tipo selecionado. Verifique os valores antes de confirmar.
    </div>

    <form method="POST" id="terminationForm">
        <!-- Funcionario -->
        <div class="section-card">
            <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-user"></i> Funcionario</div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Selecione o Funcionario</label>
                <select name="employee_id" id="employee_id" class="form-control" required onchange="updateEmployeeInfo()">
                    <option value="">Selecione...</option>
                    {% for emp in employees %}
                    <option value="{{ emp.id }}" 
                            data-salary="{{ emp.salary }}"
                            data-admission="{{ emp.admission_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if emp.admission_date else '' }}"
                            data-name="{{ emp.name }}">
                        {{ emp.name }} - {{ emp.position or 'Sem cargo' }}
                    </option>
                    {% endfor %}
                </select>
            </div>

            <div id="employeeInfo" style="display: none;">
                <div class="form-hint" style="margin-top: -10px; padding: 12px; background: #0a0a0a; border-radius: 8px;">
                    <div><strong>Salario:</strong> <span id="infoSalary">-</span></div>
                    <div><strong>Admissao:</strong> <span id="infoAdmission">-</span></div>
                    <div><strong>Tempo:</strong> <span id="infoTime">-</span></div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Data e Tipo -->
        <div class="section-card">
            <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-calendar-times"></i> Data e Tipo</div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Data do Desligamento</label>
                <input type="date" name="termination_date" id="termination_date" class="form-control" required>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Tipo de Rescisao</label>
                <div class="type-cards">
                    <label class="type-card" onclick="selectType('sem_justa_causa')">
                        <input type="radio" name="termination_type" value="sem_justa_causa" required>
                        <div class="type-icon">🔴</div>
                        <div class="type-name">Sem Justa Causa</div>
                        <div class="type-desc">Demissao pela empresa</div>
                    </label>
                    <label class="type-card" onclick="selectType('pedido_demissao')">
                        <input type="radio" name="termination_type" value="pedido_demissao">
                        <div class="type-icon">🔵</div>
                        <div class="type-name">Pedido Demissao</div>
                        <div class="type-desc">Funcionario pediu</div>
                    </label>
                    <label class="type-card" onclick="selectType('acordo_mutuo')">
                        <input type="radio" name="termination_type" value="acordo_mutuo">
                        <div class="type-icon">🟢</div>
                        <div class="type-name">Acordo Mutuo</div>
                        <div class="type-desc">Reforma trabalhista</div>
                    </label>
                    <label class="type-card" onclick="selectType('justa_causa')">
                        <input type="radio" name="termination_type" value="justa_causa">
                        <div class="type-icon">🟣</div>
                        <div class="type-name">Justa Causa</div>
                        <div class="type-desc">Falta grave</div>
                    </label>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Aviso Previo -->
        <div class="section-card" id="noticeSection">
            <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-clock"></i> Aviso Previo</div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Tipo de Aviso</label>
                <div class="notice-options">
                    <label class="notice-option" onclick="selectNotice('indenizado')">
                        <input type="radio" name="notice_type" value="indenizado" checked>
                        <div class="notice-label">Indenizado</div>
                    </label>
                    <label class="notice-option" onclick="selectNotice('trabalhado')">
                        <input type="radio" name="notice_type" value="trabalhado">
                        <div class="notice-label">Trabalhado</div>
                    </label>
                    <label class="notice-option" onclick="selectNotice('dispensado')">
                        <input type="radio" name="notice_type" value="dispensado">
                        <div class="notice-label">Dispensado</div>
                    </label>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- FGTS -->
        <div class="section-card" id="fgtsSection">
            <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-piggy-bank"></i> FGTS</div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Saldo FGTS Depositado</label>
                <input type="text" name="fgts_balance" id="fgts_balance" class="form-control" 
                       placeholder="0,00" oninput="formatMoney(this)">
                <div class="form-hint">Consulte o extrato do FGTS do funcionario</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Motivo -->
        <div class="section-card">
            <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-comment-alt"></i> Motivo (Opcional)</div>

            <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom: 0;">
                <textarea name="reason" class="form-control" rows="3" 
                          placeholder="Descreva o motivo da rescisao..."></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Preview -->
        <div class="preview-card" id="previewCard" style="display: none;">
            <div class="preview-title"><i class="fas fa-calculator"></i> Previsao de Valores</div>
            <div id="previewContent">
                <!-- Preenchido via JS -->
            </div>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="btn-submit">
            <i class="fas fa-calculator"></i> Calcular Rescisao
        </button>
    </form>
</div>

<script>
let selectedType = '';
let selectedNotice = 'indenizado';

function selectType(type) {
    selectedType = type;
    document.querySelectorAll('.type-card').forEach(card => {
        card.classList.remove('selected');
    });
    event.currentTarget.classList.add('selected');

    // Mostrar/esconder secoes
    const noticeSection = document.getElementById('noticeSection');
    const fgtsSection = document.getElementById('fgtsSection');

    if (type === 'justa_causa') {
        noticeSection.style.display = 'none';
        fgtsSection.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        noticeSection.style.display = 'block';
        fgtsSection.style.display = 'block';
    }
}

function selectNotice(notice) {
    selectedNotice = notice;
    document.querySelectorAll('.notice-option').forEach(opt => {
        opt.classList.remove('selected');
    });
    event.currentTarget.classList.add('selected');
}

function updateEmployeeInfo() {
    const select = document.getElementById('employee_id');
    const option = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
    const infoDiv = document.getElementById('employeeInfo');

    if (option.value) {
        const salary = parseFloat(option.dataset.salary || 0);
        const admission = option.dataset.admission;

        document.getElementById('infoSalary').textContent = 'R$ ' + salary.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
        document.getElementById('infoAdmission').textContent = admission ? formatDate(admission) : '-';

        if (admission) {
            const years = calculateYears(admission);
            document.getElementById('infoTime').textContent = years + ' anos';
        }

        infoDiv.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
        infoDiv.style.display = 'none';
    }
}

function calculateYears(admissionDate) {
    const admission = new Date(admissionDate);
    const today = new Date();
    let years = today.getFullYear() - admission.getFullYear();
    const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - admission.getMonth();
    if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < admission.getDate())) {
        years--;
    }
    return Math.max(0, years);
}

function formatDate(dateStr) {
    const parts = dateStr.split('-');
    return parts[2] + '/' + parts[1] + '/' + parts[0];
}

function formatMoney(input) {
    let value = input.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
    value = (parseInt(value) / 100).toFixed(2);
    value = value.replace('.', ',');
    value = value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.');
    input.value = value;
}

// Inicializar
document.getElementById('termination_date').valueAsDate = new Date();
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="termination-view-container">
    <div class="page-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('rh.rescisoes_list') }}" class="btn-back">
            <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </a>
        <h1 class="page-title">Rescisao</h1>
        <span class="status-badge status-{{ termination.status }}">
            {% if termination.status == 'calculated' %}CALCULADO
            {% elif termination.status == 'approved' %}APROVADO
            {% elif termination.status == 'paid' %}PAGO
            {% else %}{{ termination.status|upper }}{% endif %}
        </span>
    </div>

    <!-- Funcionario -->
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-user"></i> Funcionario</div>
        <div class="info-grid">
            <div class="info-item full">
                <span class="info-label">Nome</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ termination.employee.name }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Cargo</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ termination.employee.position or '-' }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Salario Base</span>
                <span class="info-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.base_salary or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Admissao</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ termination.admission_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if termination.admission_date else '-' }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Tempo de Servico</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ termination.years_worked }} anos</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Tipo de Rescisao -->
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-file-contract"></i> Tipo de Rescisao</div>
        <div class="info-grid">
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Tipo</span>
                <span class="termination-type-badge type-{{ termination.termination_type }}">
                    {% if termination.termination_type == 'sem_justa_causa' %}Sem Justa Causa
                    {% elif termination.termination_type == 'pedido_demissao' %}Pedido de Demissao
                    {% elif termination.termination_type == 'justa_causa' %}Justa Causa
                    {% elif termination.termination_type == 'acordo_mutuo' %}Acordo Mutuo
                    {% else %}{{ termination.termination_type }}{% endif %}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Data Desligamento</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ termination.termination_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Aviso Previo</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ termination.notice_type or 'Indenizado' }} ({{ termination.notice_days or 30 }} dias)</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Verbas Rescisorias -->
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-dollar-sign"></i> Verbas Rescisorias</div>
        <table class="values-table">
            <tr>
                <td>Saldo de Salario</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.salary_balance or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            {% if termination.notice_value and termination.notice_value > 0 %}
            <tr>
                <td>Aviso Previo Indenizado</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.notice_value).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            {% endif %}
            {% if termination.thirteenth_prop and termination.thirteenth_prop > 0 %}
            <tr>
                <td>13o Proporcional</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.thirteenth_prop).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            {% endif %}
            {% if termination.vacation_overdue and termination.vacation_overdue > 0 %}
            <tr>
                <td>Ferias Vencidas</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.vacation_overdue).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td>1/3 Ferias Vencidas</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.vacation_overdue_bonus or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            {% endif %}
            {% if termination.vacation_prop and termination.vacation_prop > 0 %}
            <tr>
                <td>Ferias Proporcionais</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.vacation_prop).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td>1/3 Ferias Proporcionais</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.vacation_prop_bonus or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            {% endif %}
            <tr class="subtotal">
                <td><strong>Total Bruto</strong></td>
                <td><strong>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.gross_total or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</strong></td>
            </tr>
            <tr class="discount">
                <td>(-) INSS</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.inss_discount or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr class="discount">
                <td>(-) IRRF</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.irrf_discount or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr class="total">
                <td>VALOR LIQUIDO</td>
                <td>R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.net_total or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</td>
            </tr>
        </table>
    </div>

    <!-- FGTS -->
    {% if termination.fgts_balance and termination.fgts_balance > 0 %}
    <div class="fgts-card">
        <div class="fgts-title"><i class="fas fa-piggy-bank"></i> FGTS</div>
        <div class="fgts-grid">
            <div class="fgts-item">
                <div class="fgts-label">Saldo Depositado</div>
                <div class="fgts-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.fgts_balance).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="fgts-item">
                <div class="fgts-label">Multa ({{ termination.fgts_fine_percent or 0 }}%)</div>
                <div class="fgts-value">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.fgts_fine or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="fgts-item" style="grid-column: span 2;">
                <div class="fgts-label">Total a Sacar</div>
                <div class="fgts-value" style="font-size: 1.4rem;">R$ {{ '{:,.2f}'.format(termination.fgts_total_withdraw or 0).replace(',', 'X').replace('.', ',').replace('X', '.') }}</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Seguro Desemprego -->
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-shield-alt"></i> Seguro Desemprego</div>
        {% if termination.seguro_desemprego %}
        <span class="seguro-badge seguro-yes">
            <i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> Tem direito ao Seguro Desemprego
        </span>
        {% else %}
        <span class="seguro-badge seguro-no">
            <i class="fas fa-times-circle"></i> Nao tem direito ao Seguro Desemprego
        </span>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    <!-- Motivo -->
    {% if termination.reason %}
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-comment-alt"></i> Motivo</div>
        <div class="reason-box">{{ termination.reason }}</div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Pagamento -->
    {% if termination.status == 'paid' %}
    <div class="section-card">
        <div class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> Pagamento</div>
        <div class="info-grid">
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Data Pagamento</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ termination.paid_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if termination.paid_at else '-' }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="info-item">
                <span class="info-label">Metodo</span>
                <span class="info-value">{{ termination.payment_method or 'Transferencia' }}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Acoes -->
    <div class="action-buttons">
        {% if termination.status == 'calculated' %}
        <form action="{{ url_for('rh.rescisao_aprovar', id=termination.id) }}" method="POST" style="flex: 1;">
            <button type="submit" class="btn-action btn-approve" style="width: 100%;">
                <i class="fas fa-check"></i> Aprovar Rescisao
            </button>
        </form>
        {% elif termination.status == 'approved' %}
        <form action="{{ url_for('rh.rescisao_pagar', id=termination.id) }}" method="POST" style="flex: 1;">
            <input type="hidden" name="method" value="transfer">
            <button type="submit" class="btn-action btn-pay" style="width: 100%;">
                <i class="fas fa-dollar-sign"></i> Confirmar Pagamento
            </button>
        </form>
        {% elif termination.status == 'paid' %}
        <a href="#" class="btn-action btn-print" onclick="window.print()">
            <i class="fas fa-print"></i> Imprimir TRCT
        </a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
        cursor: pointer;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.3);
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .btn-primary-nfc:disabled {
        opacity: 0.6;
        cursor: not-allowed;

        .scanner-card {
            max-width: 500px;
            margin: var(--spacing-xl) auto;
        }
    }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="scanner-container">
    <div class="scanner-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('equipment.index') }}" class="back-button">←</a>
        <div>
            <h1 class="scanner-title">📱 Scanner NFC</h1>
            <p class="scanner-subtitle">
                {% if mode == 'associate' and equipment %}
                    Associar tag ao equipamento
                {% else %}
                    Aproxime o celular da tag NFC
                {% endif %}
            </p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scanner-card">
        <div id="alertBox" class="alert-box">
            <div class="alert-header" id="alertHeader">⚠️ Aviso</div>
            <div class="alert-text" id="alertText"></div>
        </div>

        {% if mode == 'associate' and equipment %}
        <div class="equipment-info">
            <h3>Equipamento Selecionado</h3>
            <div class="name">{{ equipment.name }}</div>
            <div class="code">{{ equipment.code }}</div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}

        <div class="nfc-preview">
            <div class="nfc-icon" id="nfcIcon">📱</div>
            <div class="status-text" id="statusText">Pronto para ler</div>
        </div>

        <div id="resultCard" class="result-card">
            <h3>Equipamento Encontrado</h3>
            <div class="equipment-name" id="resultName"></div>
            <div class="equipment-code" id="resultCode"></div>
            <a href="#" id="resultLink" class="btn-view">Ver Detalhes</a>
        </div>

        <div class="scanner-actions">
            <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="window.history.back()">Voltar</button>
            <button class="btn-primary-nfc" id="nfcButton" onclick="activateNFC()">Ativar NFC</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
const mode = "{{ mode }}";
const equipmentId = {{ equipment.id if equipment else 'null' }};
let isScanning = false;

function showAlert(type, header, text) {
    const box = document.getElementById('alertBox');
    const headerEl = document.getElementById('alertHeader');
    const textEl = document.getElementById('alertText');
    
    box.className = 'alert-box show ' + type;
    headerEl.textContent = header;
    textEl.textContent = text;
}

function hideAlert() {
    document.getElementById('alertBox').classList.remove('show');
}

function showResult(equipment) {
    const card = document.getElementById('resultCard');
    document.getElementById('resultName').textContent = equipment.name;
    document.getElementById('resultCode').textContent = equipment.code;
    document.getElementById('resultLink').href = equipment.url;
    card.classList.add('show');
}

async function handleTagRead(serialNumber) {
    const tagId = serialNumber.replace(/:/g, '');
    
    if (mode === 'associate' && equipmentId) {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/scanner/associate/nfc', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ equipment_id: equipmentId, tag_id: tagId })
            });
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data.success) {
                showAlert('success', '✅ Sucesso!', 'Tag NFC associada ao equipamento ' + data.equipment.code);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = '/equipment/' + equipmentId;
                }, 2000);
            } else {
                showAlert('error', '❌ Erro', data.error);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            showAlert('error', '❌ Erro', 'Falha na comunicação com o servidor');
        }
    } else {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/scanner/nfc/scan', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ tag_id: tagId })
            });
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data.found) {
                showResult(data.equipment);
                showAlert('success', '✅ Encontrado!', 'Equipamento identificado');
            } else {
                showAlert('', '📱 Tag Lida', 'Tag: ' + tagId + ' - Não associada a nenhum equipamento');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            showAlert('error', '❌ Erro', 'Falha na comunicação com o servidor');
        }
    }
}

async function activateNFC() {
    if (!('NDEFReader' in window)) {
        showAlert('error', '❌ NFC não suportado', 'Seu navegador não suporta Web NFC. Use Chrome no Android.');
        return;
    }

    const button = document.getElementById('nfcButton');
    const icon = document.getElementById('nfcIcon');
    const status = document.getElementById('statusText');

    if (isScanning) {
        return;
    }

    try {
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = 'Ativando...';
        
        const ndef = new NDEFReader();
        await ndef.scan();
        
        isScanning = true;
        icon.classList.add('scanning');
        status.textContent = 'Aguardando tag NFC...';
        status.classList.add('active');
        button.textContent = 'Escaneando...';
        hideAlert();
        
        ndef.addEventListener("reading", ({ serialNumber }) => {
            handleTagRead(serialNumber);
        });
        
        ndef.addEventListener("error", (error) => {
            showAlert('error', '❌ Erro NFC', error.message);
        });
        
    } catch (error) {
        showAlert('error', '❌ Erro', error.message);
        button.disabled = false;
        button.textContent = 'Ativar NFC';
    }
}

if ('NDEFReader' in window) {
    document.getElementById('statusText').textContent = 'NFC disponível - Clique para ativar';
} else {
    showAlert('error', '❌ NFC não suportado', 'Seu navegador não suporta Web NFC. Use Chrome no Android.');
    document.getElementById('nfcButton').disabled = true;
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
            max-width: 500px;
            margin: var(--spacing-xl) auto;
        }
    }
</style>

{% block content %}
<div class="scanner-container">
    <div class="scanner-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('equipment.index') }}" class="back-button">←</a>
        <div>
            <h1 class="scanner-title">📷 Scanner QR</h1>
            <p class="scanner-subtitle">Posicione o QR Code dentro do quadro</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scanner-card">
        <div class="camera-preview">
            <video id="video" autoplay playsinline></video>
            <canvas id="canvas" style="display: none;"></canvas>
            <div class="camera-frame"></div>
            <div class="camera-icon">📷</div>
        </div>

        <div class="status-text" id="status">Aguardando QR Code...</div>

        <div class="scanner-actions">
            <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="window.history.back()">Voltar</button>
            <button class="btn-primary-scan" onclick="simulateScan()">Simular Scan</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
let videoStream = null;

async function startCamera() {
    try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ 
            video: { facingMode: 'environment' } 
        });
        const video = document.getElementById('video');
        video.srcObject = stream;
        videoStream = stream;
        document.querySelector('.camera-icon').style.display = 'none';
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Erro ao acessar câmera:', error);
        document.getElementById('status').textContent = 'Erro ao acessar câmera. Use "Simular Scan".';
    }
}

function stopCamera() {
    if (videoStream) {
        videoStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
    }
}

function simulateScan() {
    // Simular leitura de QR code
    const mockCode = 'EQP-' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000).toString().padStart(3, '0');
    document.getElementById('status').textContent = '✓ QR Code detectado: ' + mockCode;
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        window.location.href = '{{ url_for("equipment.detail_equipment", id=1) }}';
    }, 1000);
}

// Start camera on load
window.addEventListener('load', startCamera);
window.addEventListener('beforeunload', stopCamera);
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% block content %}
<div class="scanner-container">
    <div class="scanner-header">
        <a href="{{ url_for('equipment.index') }}" class="back-button">←</a>
        <div>
            <h1 class="scanner-title">📡 Leitura RFID</h1>
            <p class="scanner-subtitle">
                {% if mode == 'associate' and equipment %}
                    Associar tag RFID ao equipamento
                {% else %}
                    Para leitores industriais RFID UHF
                {% endif %}
            </p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scanner-card">
        <div class="info-box">
            <div class="info-header">📡 Sobre RFID UHF</div>
            <div class="info-text">
                RFID UHF permite leitura em massa a distância (1-12m). 
                Ideal para inventário rápido e controle de carregamento.
                Requer leitor industrial (Zebra, Impinj, etc).
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="alertBox" class="alert-box">
            <div id="alertText"></div>
        </div>

        {% if mode == 'associate' and equipment %}
        <div class="equipment-info">
            <h3>Equipamento Selecionado</h3>
            <div class="name">{{ equipment.name }}</div>
            <div class="code">{{ equipment.code }}</div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}

        <div class="rfid-preview">
            <div class="rfid-icon">📡</div>
            <div class="status-text">Digite ou escaneie o código EPC</div>
        </div>

        <div class="manual-input">
            <label for="epcInput">Código EPC da Tag RFID</label>
            <input type="text" id="epcInput" placeholder="Ex: 300833B2DDD9014000000001" maxlength="128">
        </div>

        <div id="resultCard" class="result-card">
            <h3>Equipamento Encontrado</h3>
            <div class="equipment-name" id="resultName"></div>
            <div class="equipment-code" id="resultCode"></div>
            <a href="#" id="resultLink" class="btn-view">Ver Detalhes</a>
        </div>

        <div class="scanner-actions">
            <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="window.history.back()">Voltar</button>
            <button class="btn-primary-rfid" onclick="processRFID()">
                {% if mode == 'associate' %}Associar Tag{% else %}Buscar{% endif %}
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
const mode = "{{ mode }}";
const equipmentId = {{ equipment.id if equipment else 'null' }};

function showAlert(type, text) {
    const box = document.getElementById('alertBox');
    box.className = 'alert-box show ' + type;
    document.getElementById('alertText').textContent = text;
}

function showResult(equipment) {
    document.getElementById('resultName').textContent = equipment.name;
    document.getElementById('resultCode').textContent = equipment.code;
    document.getElementById('resultLink').href = equipment.url;
    document.getElementById('resultCard').classList.add('show');
}

async function processRFID() {
    const epc = document.getElementById('epcInput').value.trim();
    
    if (!epc) {
        showAlert('error', 'Digite o código EPC da tag RFID');
        return;
    }

    if (mode === 'associate' && equipmentId) {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/scanner/associate/rfid', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ equipment_id: equipmentId, epc: epc })
            });
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data.success) {
                showAlert('', '✅ Tag RFID associada com sucesso!');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = '/equipment/' + equipmentId;
                }, 2000);
            } else {
                showAlert('error', data.error);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            showAlert('error', 'Erro ao comunicar com servidor');
        }
    } else {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/scanner/rfid/scan', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ epc: epc })
            });
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data.found) {
                showResult(data.equipment);
                showAlert('', '✅ Equipamento encontrado!');
            } else {
                showAlert('error', 'Tag não associada a nenhum equipamento');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            showAlert('error', 'Erro ao comunicar com servidor');
        }
    }
}

document.getElementById('epcInput').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        processRFID();
    }
});
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
        color: var(--text-secondary);
        margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .current-eq-name {
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        font-weight: bold;
        color: var(--accent-gold);
    }

    .epc-input {
        width: 100%;
        padding: var(--spacing-md);
        background: var(--bg-primary);
        border: 2px solid var(--border-subtle);
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
        color: var(--text-primary);
        font-family: monospace;
        font-size: 1rem;
        margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
    }

    .epc-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: #9b59b6;
    }

    .btn-row {
        display: flex;
        gap: var(--spacing-sm);
    }

    .btn {
        flex: 1;
        padding: var(--spacing-md);
        border: none;
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .btn-primary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9b59b6 0%, #8e44ad 100%);
        color: white;
    }

    .btn-secondary {
        background: var(--bg-primary);
        color: var(--text-secondary);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    }

    .btn-success {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2ecc71 0%, #27ae60 100%);
        color: white;
    }

    .progress-bar {
        background: var(--bg-primary);
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        overflow: hidden;
        margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
    }

    .progress-fill {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9b59b6 0%, #8e44ad 100%);
        height: 100%;
        transition: width 0.3s ease;
    }

    .progress-text {
        text-align: center;
        color: var(--text-secondary);
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
    }

    .filter-row {
        display: flex;
        gap: var(--spacing-sm);
        margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
```
