```html
                                        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-outline-danger" title="Desativar">
                                            <i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i>
                                        </button>
                                    </form>
                                    {% endif %}
                                </div>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="mt-4">
        <a href="{{ url_for('company.settings') }}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">
            <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i> Voltar
        </a>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
</div>

<div class="form-container">
    <form method="POST">
        <div class="form-section">
            <h3 class="section-title">Dados do Convite</h3>
            <p class="section-subtitle">Preencha os dados iniciais. O tecnico completara o cadastro ao escanear o QR.</p>
            
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Nome (opcional)</label>
                <input type="text" name="name" class="form-input" placeholder="Nome do tecnico">
            </div>
            
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Telefone (opcional)</label>
                <input type="tel" name="phone" class="form-input" placeholder="(00) 00000-0000">
            </div>
            
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Validade do Acesso</label>
                <input type="date" name="expires_at" class="form-input">
                <div class="form-hint">Deixe em branco para acesso permanente</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-section">
            <h3 class="section-title">Permissoes</h3>
            <p class="section-subtitle">Selecione o que este tecnico pode acessar</p>
            
            <div class="permissions-grid">

                    <input type="checkbox" name="can_equipment" checked>
                    <span class="permission-check"><i class="fas fa-check"></i></span>
                    <div class="permission-info">
                        <i class="fas fa-box"></i>
                        <span>Equipamentos</span>
                    </div>
                </label>
                
                <label class="permission-item">
                    <input type="checkbox" name="can_maintenance" checked>
                    <span class="permission-check"><i class="fas fa-check"></i></span>
                    <div class="permission-info">
                        <i class="fas fa-tools"></i>
                        <span>Manutencao</span>
                    </div>
                </label>
                
                <label class="permission-item">
                    <input type="checkbox" name="can_separation" checked>
                    <span class="permission-check"><i class="fas fa-list-check"></i></span>
                    <div class="permission-info">
                        <i class="fas fa-clipboard-list"></i>
                        <span>Separacao</span>
                    </div>
                </label>
                
                <label class="permission-item">
                    <input type="checkbox" name="can_tours" checked>
                    <span class="permission-check"><i class="fas fa-check"></i></span>
                    <div class="permission-info">
                        <i class="fas fa-route"></i>
                        <span>Tours</span>
                    </div>
                </label>
                
                <label class="permission-item">
                    <input type="checkbox" name="can_scanner" checked>
                    <span class="permission-check"><i class="fas fa-check"></i></span>
                    <div class="permission-info">
                        <i class="fas fa-qrcode"></i>
                        <span>Scanner</span>
                    </div>
                </label>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-actions">
            <a href="{{ url_for('users.technicians') }}" class="btn btn-outline">Cancelar</a>

            </button>
        </div>
    </form>
</div>

<style>
.form-container {
    max-width: 600px;
}
.form-section {
    background: #1a1a1a;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
}
.section-title {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: #f5f5f5;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.section-subtitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #707070;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.permissions-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
}
.permission-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: #0a0a0a;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 2px solid #2a2a2a;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
}
.permission-item:hover {
    border-color: #404040;
}
.permission-item input {
    display: none;
}
.permission-item input:checked + .permission-check {
    background: #3498db;
    border-color: #3498db;
}
.permission-item input:checked ~ .permission-info {
    color: #f5f5f5;
}
.permission-check {
    width: 24px;

    border: 2px solid #404040;
    border-radius: 6px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 12px;
}
.permission-check i { opacity: 0; }
.permission-item input:checked + .permission-check i { opacity: 1; }
.permission-info {

    align-items: center;

    color: #707070;

}
.permission-info i { font-size: 18px; }
.form-actions {
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}QR Code Tecnico{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="page-header">
    <a href="{{ url_for('users.technicians') }}" class="btn-back">
        <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
    </a>
    <h1 class="page-title">QR Code de Acesso</h1>
</div>

<div class="qr-card">
    <div class="qr-header">
        <div class="qr-icon tech">
            <i class="fas fa-wrench"></i>
        </div>
        <h2 class="qr-title">Tecnico</h2>
        <span class="badge {{ access.status_badge }}">{{ access.status_label }}</span>
    </div>

    {% if access.invite_name %}
    <div class="qr-name">{{ access.invite_name }}</div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="qr-image-container">
        {% if access.qr_code_url %}
        <img src="{{ access.qr_code_url }}" alt="QR Code" class="qr-image">
        {% else %}
        <div class="qr-placeholder">
            <i class="fas fa-qrcode"></i>
            <span>QR nao gerado</span>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    <div class="qr-info">
        <div class="qr-info-item">
            <span class="label">Validade</span>
            <span class="value">
                {% if access.expires_at %}
                {{ access.expires_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}
                {% else %}
                Permanente
                {% endif %}
            </span>
        </div>
        <div class="qr-info-item">
            <span class="label">Criado em</span>
            <span class="value">{{ access.created_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') }}</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="qr-permissions">
        <h4>Permissoes</h4>
        <div class="permissions-list">
            {% if access.can_equipment %}
            <span class="permission-badge"><i class="fas fa-box"></i> Equipamentos</span>
            {% endif %}
            {% if access.can_maintenance %}
            <span class="permission-badge"><i class="fas fa-tools"></i> Manutencao</span>
            {% endif %}
            {% if access.can_separation %}
            <span class="permission-badge"><i class="fas fa-clipboard-list"></i> Separacao</span>
            {% endif %}
            {% if access.can_tours %}
            <span class="permission-badge"><i class="fas fa-route"></i> Tours</span>
            {% endif %}
            {% if access.can_scanner %}
            <span class="permission-badge"><i class="fas fa-qrcode"></i> Scanner</span>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="qr-actions">
        <button onclick="shareQR()" class="btn btn-primary">
            <i class="fas fa-share-alt"></i> Compartilhar
        </button>
        <button onclick="printQR()" class="btn btn-outline">
            <i class="fas fa-print"></i> Imprimir
        </button>
        {% if access.status != 'revoked' %}
        <form action="{{ url_for('users.revoke_technician', id=access.id) }}" method="POST" style="display:inline">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger" onclick="return confirm('Revogar acesso?')">
                <i class="fas fa-ban"></i> Revogar
            </button>
        </form>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<style>
.qr-card {
    max-width: 400px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #1a1a1a;
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 32px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    text-align: center;
}
.qr-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.qr-icon {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 28px;
}
.qr-icon.tech { background: rgba(52,152,219,0.2); color: #3498db; }
.qr-title { color: #f5f5f5; font-size: 24px; margin: 0; }
.qr-name { font-size: 18px; color: #a0a0a0; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.qr-image-container {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.qr-image { width: 100%; max-width: 250px; }
.qr-placeholder {
    width: 250px;
    height: 250px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #ccc;
    font-size: 48px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}
.qr-placeholder span { font-size: 14px; margin-top: 8px; }
.qr-info {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.qr-info-item { text-align: center; }
.qr-info-item .label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #707070; text-transform: uppercase; }
.qr-info-item .value { display: block; font-size: 14px; color: #f5f5f5; margin-top: 4px; }
.qr-permissions { margin-bottom: 24px; }
.qr-permissions h4 { font-size: 14px; color: #707070; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.permissions-list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; }
.permission-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    background: rgba(52,152,219,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(52,152,219,0.3);
    border-radius: 20px;
    color: #3498db;
    font-size: 12px;
}
.qr-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; justify-content: center; }
</style>

<script>
function shareQR() {
    if (navigator.share) {
        navigator.share({
            title: 'Acesso TOUR - Tecnico',
            text: 'Escaneie este QR Code para acessar o sistema',
            url: window.location.href
        });
    } else {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
        alert('Link copiado!');
    }
}
function printQR() {
    window.print();
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}Gestao de Acessos{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="page-header">
    <h1 class="page-title">Gestao de Acessos</h1>
    <div class="header-actions">
        <a href="{{ url_for('users.new_technician') }}" class="btn btn-primary">
            <i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i> Novo Tecnico
        </a>
        <a href="{{ url_for('users.new_tour_access') }}" class="btn btn-success">
            <i class="fas fa-route"></i> Acesso Tour
        </a>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" onclick="showTab('technicians')">
        <i class="fas fa-wrench"></i> Tecnicos
    </button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('tours')">
        <i class="fas fa-route"></i> Acessos Tour
    </button>
</div>

<div id="tab-technicians" class="tab-content active">
    {% if tech_accesses %}
    <div class="access-list">
        {% for access in tech_accesses %}
        <div class="access-card">
            <div class="access-icon tech">
                <i class="fas fa-wrench"></i>
            </div>
            <div class="access-info">
                <div class="access-name">{{ access.invite_name or access.user.name if access.user else 'Aguardando cadastro' }}</div>
                <div class="access-meta">
                    {% if access.user %}
                    <span><i class="fas fa-check-circle text-success"></i> Cadastrado</span>
                    {% else %}
                    <span><i class="fas fa-clock text-warning"></i> Pendente</span>
                    {% endif %}
                    {% if access.expires_at %}
                    <span><i class="fas fa-calendar"></i> Expira: {{ access.expires_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
                    {% else %}
                    <span><i class="fas fa-infinity"></i> Permanente</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="access-status">
                <span class="badge {{ access.status_badge }}">{{ access.status_label }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="access-actions">
                <a href="{{ url_for('users.view_technician', id=access.id) }}" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline">
                    <i class="fas fa-qrcode"></i>
                </a>
                {% if access.status != 'revoked' %}
                <form action="{{ url_for('users.revoke_technician', id=access.id) }}" method="POST" style="display:inline">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onclick="return confirm('Revogar acesso?')">
                        <i class="fas fa-ban"></i>
                    </button>
                </form>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <div class="empty-state">
        <i class="fas fa-users"></i>
        <p>Nenhum tecnico cadastrado</p>
        <a href="{{ url_for('users.new_technician') }}" class="btn btn-primary">Criar Convite</a>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<div id="tab-tours" class="tab-content">
    {% if tour_accesses %}
    <div class="access-list">
        {% for access in tour_accesses %}
        <div class="access-card">
            <div class="access-icon tour">
                <i class="fas fa-route"></i>
            </div>
            <div class="access-info">
                <div class="access-name">{{ access.invite_name or access.user.name if access.user else 'Aguardando cadastro' }}</div>
                <div class="access-meta">
                    <span><i class="fas fa-music"></i> {{ access.tour.name if access.tour else 'Tour' }}</span>
                    <span><i class="fas fa-calendar"></i> {{ access.start_date.strftime('%d/%m') }} - {{ access.end_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="access-status">
                <span class="badge {{ access.status_badge }}">{{ access.status_label }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="access-actions">
                <a href="{{ url_for('users.view_tour_access_new', id=access.id) }}" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline">
                    <i class="fas fa-qrcode"></i>
                </a>
                {% if access.status != 'revoked' %}
                <form action="{{ url_for('users.revoke_tour_access', id=access.id) }}" method="POST" style="display:inline">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onclick="return confirm('Revogar acesso?')">
                        <i class="fas fa-ban"></i>
                    </button>
                </form>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <div class="empty-state">
        <i class="fas fa-route"></i>
        <p>Nenhum acesso de tour</p>
        <a href="{{ url_for('users.new_tour_access') }}" class="btn btn-success">Criar Acesso</a>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<style>
.tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    padding-bottom: 8px;
}
.tab {
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: #707070;
    font-size: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
    transition: all 0.3s;
}
.tab:hover { color: #a0a0a0; }
.tab.active {
    color: #d4af37;
    background: rgba(212,175,55,0.1);
    border-bottom: 2px solid #d4af37;
}
.tab-content { display: none; }
.tab-content.active { display: block; }
.access-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.access-card {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    background: #1a1a1a;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 16px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
}
.access-icon {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 20px;
}
.access-icon.tech { background: rgba(52,152,219,0.2); color: #3498db; }
.access-icon.tour { background: rgba(46,204,113,0.2); color: #2ecc71; }
.access-info { flex: 1; }
.access-name { font-weight: 600; color: #f5f5f5; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.access-meta { display: flex; gap: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: #707070; }
.access-status { padding: 0 16px; }
.access-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.text-success { color: #2ecc71; }
.text-warning { color: #f1c40f; }
.badge-warning { background: rgba(241,196,15,0.2); color: #f1c40f; }
.badge-success { background: rgba(46,204,113,0.2); color: #2ecc71; }
.badge-secondary { background: rgba(112,112,112,0.2); color: #707070; }
.badge-danger { background: rgba(231,76,60,0.2); color: #e74c3c; }
</style>

<script>
function showTab(tabName) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
    event.target.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('tab-' + tabName).classList.add('active');
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
        <div>
            <a href="{{ url_for('users.index') }}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm mb-2">
                <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i> Voltar
            </a>
            <h2 class="text-white mb-0">
                <i class="bi bi-qr-code"></i> Acesso Temporário
            </h2>
            <p class="text-muted">{{ user.name }} ({{ user.email }})</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="row">
        <div class="col-lg-5">
            <div class="card bg-dark border-secondary mb-4">
                <div class="card-header bg-transparent border-secondary">
                    <h5 class="text-white mb-0">
                        <i class="bi bi-plus-circle"></i> Novo Acesso
                    </h5>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body">
                    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('users.tour_access', user_id=user.id) }}">
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label text-white">Tour *</label>
                            <select name="tour_id" class="form-select bg-dark text-white border-secondary" required>
                                <option value="">Selecione uma tour...</option>
                                {% for tour in tours %}
                                <option value="{{ tour.id }}">{{ tour.name }} - {{ tour.artist }}</option>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </select>
                        </div>

                        <div class="row">
                            <div class="col-6">
                                <div class="mb-3">
                                    <label class="form-label text-white">Data Início *</label>
                                    <input type="date" name="start_date" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary" required>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="col-6">
                                <div class="mb-3">
                                    <label class="form-label text-white">Data Fim *</label>
                                    <input type="date" name="end_date" class="form-control bg-dark text-white border-secondary" required>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-warning w-100">
                            <i class="bi bi-qr-code"></i> Gerar QR de Acesso
                        </button>
                    </form>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-lg-7">
            <div class="card bg-dark border-secondary">
                <div class="card-header bg-transparent border-secondary">
                    <h5 class="text-white mb-0">
                        <i class="bi bi-list-check"></i> Acessos Existentes
                    </h5>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body p-0">
                    {% if accesses %}
                    <div class="table-responsive">
                        <table class="table table-dark table-hover mb-0">
                            <thead>
                                <tr>
                                    <th>Tour</th>
                                    <th>Período</th>
                                    <th>Status</th>
                                    <th class="text-center">Ações</th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                                {% for access in accesses %}
                                <tr>
                                    <td>{{ access.tour_name }}</td>
                                    <td>
                                        {{ access.start_date.strftime('%d/%m') }} - {{ access.end_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}
                                    </td>
                                    <td>
                                        <span class="badge {{ access.status_badge }}">
                                            {{ access.status_label }}
                                        </span>
                                    </td>
                                    <td class="text-center">
                                        <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm">
                                            <a href="{{ url_for('users.view_access', access_id=access.id) }}" class="btn btn-outline-light" title="Ver QR">
                                                <i class="bi bi-qr-code"></i>
                                            </a>
                                            {% if access.is_active and not access.is_expired %}
                                            <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('users.revoke_access', access_id=access.id) }}" style="display: inline;" onsubmit="return confirm('Revogar este acesso?')">
                                                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-outline-danger" title="Revogar">
                                                    <i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i>
                                                </button>
                                            </form>
                                            {% endif %}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                    {% else %}
                    <div class="p-4 text-center text-muted">
                        <i class="bi bi-qr-code" style="font-size: 2rem;"></i>
                        <p class="mt-2">Nenhum acesso configurado</p>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}Novo Acesso Tour{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="page-header">
    <a href="{{ url_for('users.technicians') }}" class="btn-back">
        <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
    </a>
    <h1 class="page-title">Novo Acesso Tour</h1>
</div>

<div class="form-container">
    <form method="POST">
        <div class="form-section">
            <h3 class="section-title">Selecione a Tour</h3>
            
            {% if tours %}
            <div class="tour-grid">
                {% for tour in tours %}
                <label class="tour-option">
                    <input type="radio" name="tour_id" value="{{ tour.id }}" required>
                    <div class="tour-card">
                        <div class="tour-name">{{ tour.name }}</div>
                        {% if tour.artist %}
                        <div class="tour-artist"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> {{ tour.artist }}</div>
                        {% endif %}
                        <div class="tour-dates">
                            <i class="fas fa-calendar"></i>
                            {{ tour.start_date.strftime('%d/%m') if tour.start_date else '?' }} - 
                            {{ tour.end_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if tour.end_date else '?' }}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </label>
                {% endfor %}
            </div>
            {% else %}
            <div class="empty-state">
                <i class="fas fa-route"></i>
                <p>Nenhuma tour ativa</p>
                <a href="{{ url_for('tour.new_tour') }}" class="btn btn-primary">Criar Tour</a>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        {% if tours %}
        <div class="form-section">
            <h3 class="section-title">Dados do Convite (opcional)</h3>
            <p class="section-subtitle">O tecnico completara o cadastro ao escanear o QR</p>
            
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Nome</label>
                <input type="text" name="name" class="form-input" placeholder="Nome do tecnico">
            </div>
            
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Telefone</label>
                <input type="tel" name="phone" class="form-input" placeholder="(00) 00000-0000">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="info-notice">
            <i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i>
            <div>
                <strong>Acesso Temporario</strong>
                <p>O acesso sera valido apenas durante o periodo da tour selecionada e expirara automaticamente ao final.</p>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-actions">
            <a href="{{ url_for('users.technicians') }}" class="btn btn-outline">Cancelar</a>
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success">
                <i class="fas fa-qrcode"></i> Gerar QR Code
            </button>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </form>
</div>

<style>
.form-container { max-width: 600px; }
.form-section {
    background: #1a1a1a;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
}
.section-title { font-size: 18px; color: #f5f5f5; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.section-subtitle { font-size: 14px; color: #707070; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.tour-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.tour-option { cursor: pointer; }
.tour-option input { display: none; }
.tour-card {
    padding: 16px;
    background: #0a0a0a;
    border: 2px solid #2a2a2a;
    border-radius: 12px;
    transition: all 0.3s;
}
.tour-option input:checked + .tour-card {
    border-color: #2ecc71;
    background: rgba(46,204,113,0.1);
}
.tour-option:hover .tour-card { border-color: #404040; }
.tour-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #f5f5f5; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.tour-artist { font-size: 14px; color: #a0a0a0; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.tour-dates { font-size: 13px; color: #707070; }
.info-notice {
    display: flex;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: rgba(46,204,113,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3);
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.info-notice i { color: #2ecc71; font-size: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.info-notice strong { color: #2ecc71; display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.info-notice p { color: #a0a0a0; font-size: 14px; margin: 0; }
.form-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-end; }
</style>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}QR Code Tour{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="page-header">
    <a href="{{ url_for('users.technicians') }}" class="btn-back">
        <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
    </a>
    <h1 class="page-title">QR Code de Acesso</h1>
</div>

<div class="qr-card">
    <div class="qr-header">
        <div class="qr-icon tour">
            <i class="fas fa-route"></i>
        </div>
        <h2 class="qr-title">Acesso Tour</h2>
        <span class="badge {{ access.status_badge }}">{{ access.status_label }}</span>
    </div>

    {% if access.tour %}
    <div class="tour-info">
        <div class="tour-name">{{ access.tour.name }}</div>
        {% if access.tour.artist %}
        <div class="tour-artist"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> {{ access.tour.artist }}</div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    {% if access.invite_name %}
    <div class="qr-name">{{ access.invite_name }}</div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="qr-image-container">
        {% if access.qr_code_url %}
        <img src="{{ access.qr_code_url }}" alt="QR Code" class="qr-image">
        {% else %}
        <div class="qr-placeholder">
            <i class="fas fa-qrcode"></i>
            <span>QR nao gerado</span>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    <div class="qr-info">
        <div class="qr-info-item">
            <span class="label">Inicio</span>
            <span class="value">{{ access.start_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="qr-info-item">
            <span class="label">Termino</span>
            <span class="value">{{ access.end_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="validity-notice">
        <i class="fas fa-clock"></i>
        <span>Expira automaticamente ao fim da tour</span>
    </div>

    <div class="qr-actions">
        <button onclick="shareQR()" class="btn btn-success">
            <i class="fas fa-share-alt"></i> Compartilhar
        </button>
        <button onclick="printQR()" class="btn btn-outline">
            <i class="fas fa-print"></i> Imprimir
        </button>
        {% if access.status != 'revoked' %}
        <form action="{{ url_for('users.revoke_tour_access', id=access.id) }}" method="POST" style="display:inline">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger" onclick="return confirm('Revogar acesso?')">
                <i class="fas fa-ban"></i> Revogar
            </button>
        </form>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<style>
.qr-card {
    max-width: 400px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #1a1a1a;
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 32px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    text-align: center;
}
.qr-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.qr-icon {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 28px;
}
.qr-icon.tour { background: rgba(46,204,113,0.2); color: #2ecc71; }
.qr-title { color: #f5f5f5; font-size: 24px; margin: 0; }
.tour-info {
    background: rgba(46,204,113,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.tour-name { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #2ecc71; }
.tour-artist { font-size: 14px; color: #a0a0a0; margin-top: 4px; }
.qr-name { font-size: 16px; color: #a0a0a0; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.qr-image-container {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.qr-image { width: 100%; max-width: 250px; }
.qr-placeholder {
    width: 250px;
    height: 250px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #ccc;
    font-size: 48px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}
.qr-placeholder span { font-size: 14px; margin-top: 8px; }
.qr-info {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.qr-info-item { text-align: center; }
.qr-info-item .label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #707070; text-transform: uppercase; }
.qr-info-item .value { display: block; font-size: 14px; color: #f5f5f5; margin-top: 4px; }
.validity-notice {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    background: rgba(241,196,15,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(241,196,15,0.3);
    border-radius: 20px;
    color: #f1c40f;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.qr-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; justify-content: center; }
</style>

<script>
function shareQR() {
    if (navigator.share) {
        navigator.share({
            title: 'Acesso TOUR',
            text: 'Escaneie este QR Code para acessar a tour',
            url: window.location.href
        });
    } else {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
        alert('Link copiado!');
    }
}
function printQR() {
    window.print();
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}QR Code de Acesso{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 500px;">
    <div class="text-center mb-4">
        <a href="{{ url_for('users.tour_access', user_id=user.id) }}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm">
            <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i> Voltar
        </a>
    </div>

    <div class="card bg-dark border-secondary">
        <div class="card-body text-center">
            <h4 class="text-white mb-3">
                <i class="bi bi-qr-code"></i> QR Code de Acesso
            </h4>
            
            <div class="mb-3">
                <span class="badge {{ access.status_badge }} fs-6">
                    {{ access.status_label }}
                </span>
            </div>

            {% if access.qr_code_url %}
            <div class="bg-white p-3 rounded d-inline-block mb-3">
                <img src="{{ access.qr_code_url }}" alt="QR Code" style="max-width: 250px;">
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            <div class="text-start mt-4">
                <table class="table table-dark table-sm">
                    <tr>
                        <th class="text-muted">Técnico:</th>
                        <td class="text-white">{{ user.name }}</td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <th class="text-muted">Tour:</th>
                        <td class="text-white">{{ access.tour_name }}</td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <th class="text-muted">Período:</th>
                        <td class="text-white">
                            {{ access.start_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }} a {{ access.end_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <th class="text-muted">Criado em:</th>
                        <td class="text-white">{{ access.created_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') }}</td>
                    </tr>
                </table>
            </div>

            {% if access.is_valid %}
            <div class="alert alert-success mt-3">
                <i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> Acesso ativo - Técnico pode acessar a tour
            </div>
            {% elif access.is_expired %}
            <div class="alert alert-secondary mt-3">
                <i class="bi bi-clock-history"></i> Acesso expirado automaticamente
            </div>
            {% else %}
            <div class="alert alert-danger mt-3">
                <i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i> Acesso revogado
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            <div class="mt-4">
                <button onclick="window.print()" class="btn btn-outline-light">
                    <i class="bi bi-printer"></i> Imprimir QR
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{{ work_list.name }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <div>
            <a href="{{ url_for('work_list.list_work_lists') }}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm mb-2">
                <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i> Voltar
            </a>
            <h2 class="text-white mb-0">{{ work_list.name }}</h2>
            <span class="badge {{ work_list.status_badge }} mt-2">{{ work_list.status_label }}</span>
        </div>

        {% if work_list.status != 'completed' and work_list.progress == 100 %}
        <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('work_list.complete', id=work_list.id) }}" 
              onsubmit="return confirm('Finalizar esta lista de trabalho?')">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success">
                <i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> Finalizar Lista
            </button>
        </form>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    {% if work_list.description %}
    <div class="alert alert-dark border-secondary mb-4">
        <i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> {{ work_list.description }}
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="row mb-4">
        <div class="col-md-3">
            <div class="card bg-dark border-secondary">
                <div class="card-body text-center">
                    <h5 class="text-muted mb-2">Total de Itens</h5>
                    <h2 class="text-white">{{ work_list.total_items }}</h2>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-3">
            <div class="card bg-dark border-success">
                <div class="card-body text-center">
                    <h5 class="text-muted mb-2">Separados</h5>
                    <h2 class="text-success">{{ work_list.separated_items }}</h2>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-3">
            <div class="card bg-dark border-warning">
                <div class="card-body text-center">
                    <h5 class="text-muted mb-2">Pendentes</h5>
                    <h2 class="text-warning">{{ work_list.total_items - work_list.separated_items }}</h2>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-3">
            <div class="card bg-dark border-info">
                <div class="card-body text-center">
                    <h5 class="text-muted mb-2">Progresso</h5>
                    <h2 class="text-info">{{ work_list.progress }}%</h2>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card bg-dark border-secondary">
        <div class="card-header bg-transparent border-secondary">
            <h5 class="text-white mb-0">
                <i class="bi bi-list-check"></i> Itens da Lista
            </h5>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body p-0">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-dark table-hover mb-0">
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th style="width: 5%"></th>
                            <th>Item</th>
                            <th style="width: 15%" class="text-center">Quantidade</th>
                            <th style="width: 20%" class="text-center">Status</th>
                            <th style="width: 15%" class="text-center">Ação</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {% for item in work_list.items %}
                        <tr class="{% if item.separated %}table-success{% endif %}">
                            <td class="text-center">
                                {% if item.separated %}
                                <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success"></i>
                                {% else %}
                                <i class="bi bi-circle text-secondary"></i>
                                {% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td>
                                <span class="{% if item.separated %}text-decoration-line-through text-muted{% else %}text-white{% endif %}">
                                    {{ item.item_name }}
                                </span>
                            </td>
                            <td class="text-center">
                                <span class="badge bg-secondary">{{ item.quantity }}x</span>
                            </td>
                            <td class="text-center">
                                {% if item.separated %}
                                <span class="badge bg-success">
                                    <i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> Separado
                                </span>
                                {% else %}
                                <span class="badge bg-warning text-dark">
                                    <i class="bi bi-clock"></i> Pendente
                                </span>
                                {% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td class="text-center">
                                {% if work_list.status != 'completed' %}
                                <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('work_list.mark_separated', id=work_list.id, item_id=item.id) }}" style="display: inline;">
                                    {% if item.separated %}
                                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-warning" title="Desmarcar">
                                        <i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i>
                                    </button>
                                    {% else %}
                                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" title="Marcar como separado">
                                        <i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i>
                                    </button>
                                    {% endif %}
                                </form>
                                {% else %}
                                <span class="text-muted">-</span>
                                {% endif %}
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="mt-4 text-muted">
        <small>
            <i class="bi bi-calendar"></i> Criada em: {{ work_list.created_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y às %H:%M') }}
            {% if work_list.completed_at %}
            <br>
            <i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> Finalizada em: {{ work_list.completed_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y às %H:%M') }}
            {% endif %}
        </small>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Listas de Trabalho{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid py-4">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h2 class="text-white mb-0">
            <i class="bi bi-clipboard-check"></i> Listas de Trabalho
        </h2>
    </div>

    {% if work_lists %}
        <div class="row g-3">
            {% for wl in work_lists %}
            <div class="col-md-6 col-lg-4">
                <div class="card bg-dark border-secondary h-100">
                    <div class="card-body">
                        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-3">
                            <h5 class="card-title text-white mb-0">{{ wl.name }}</h5>
                            <span class="badge {{ wl.status_badge }}">
                                {{ wl.status_label }}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        {% if wl.description %}
                        <p class="card-text text-muted small">{{ wl.description }}</p>
                        {% endif %}

                        <div class="row text-center mt-3 mb-3">
                            <div class="col-6">
                                <div class="border-end border-secondary">
                                    <h4 class="text-white mb-0">{{ wl.separated_items }}/{{ wl.total_items }}</h4>
                                    <small class="text-muted">Separados</small>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="col-6">
                                <h4 class="text-white mb-0">{{ wl.progress }}%</h4>
                                <small class="text-muted">Progresso</small>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="progress mb-3" style="height: 6px;">
                            <div class="progress-bar bg-success" role="progressbar" 
                                 style="width: {{ wl.progress }}%" 
                                 aria-valuenow="{{ wl.progress }}" 
                                 aria-valuemin="0" 
                                 aria-valuemax="100"></div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center text-muted small">
                            <span>
                                <i class="bi bi-calendar3"></i>
                                {{ wl.created_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') }}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <a href="{{ url_for('work_list.detail', id=wl.id) }}" 
                           class="btn btn-outline-light btn-sm w-100 mt-3">
                            <i class="bi bi-eye"></i> Ver Detalhes
                        </a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
    {% else %}
        <div class="alert alert-dark border-secondary text-center py-5">
            <i class="bi bi-clipboard-x" style="font-size: 3rem; color: #666;"></i>
            <h4 class="text-white mt-3">Nenhuma Lista de Trabalho</h4>
            <p class="text-muted">As listas aparecem aqui quando um administrador aprova uma Lista de Separação.</p>
        </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
                    <i class="bi bi-calendar-event"></i>
                    <span>{{ work_list.event_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}</span>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
                {% if work_list.event_location %}
                <div class="info-item">
                    <i class="bi bi-geo-alt"></i>
                    <span>{{ work_list.event_location }}</span>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="container pb-5">
        <div class="card p-3 mb-4">
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-2">
                <span class="text-secondary">Progresso da Separação</span>
                <span class="accent-text fw-bold">{{ work_list.separated_items }}/{{ work_list.total_items }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="progress-bar-custom">
                <div class="fill" style="width: {{ work_list.progress_percentage }}%"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <h5 class="mb-3 text-secondary">
            <i class="bi bi-box-seam"></i> Itens para Separação
        </h5>

        {% for item in items %}
        <div class="item-card {% if item.separated %}separated{% endif %}">
            <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3">
                <i class="bi {% if item.separated %}bi-check-circle-fill text-success{% else %}bi-circle text-secondary{% endif %}" style="font-size: 1.5rem;"></i>
                <div>
                    <div class="fw-medium">{{ item.item_name }}</div>
                    {% if item.separated %}
                    <small class="text-success">Separado</small>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
            <span class="quantity-badge">{{ item.quantity }}x</span>
        </div>
        {% else %}
        <div class="text-center text-secondary py-5">
            <i class="bi bi-inbox" style="font-size: 3rem;"></i>
            <p class="mt-2">Nenhum item na lista</p>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}

        <div class="text-center mt-4 text-secondary">
            <small>
                <i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i> 
                Lista de visualização - os valores não são exibidos
            </small>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>
```

```python
from functools import wraps
from flask import redirect, url_for, flash
from flask_login import current_user

def admin_required(f):
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        if not current_user.is_authenticated:
            flash('Faça login para acessar esta página.', 'warning')
            return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))
        if current_user.role != 'admin':
            flash('Acesso negado. Apenas administradores.', 'danger')
            return redirect(url_for('index'))
        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function

def login_required_custom(f):
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        if not current_user.is_authenticated:
            flash('Faça login para acessar esta página.', 'warning')
            return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))
        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function
```

```python
"""Decoradores de permissão para controle de acesso"""
from functools import wraps
from flask import flash, redirect, url_for, g
from flask_login import current_user


def get_user_permissions():
    """Retorna as permissões do usuário atual baseado no role e TechnicianAccess"""
    if not current_user.is_authenticated:
        return {
            'can_equipment': False,
            'can_maintenance': False,
            'can_separation': False,
            'can_tours': False,
            'can_scanner': False,
            'can_financial': False,
            'can_users': False,
            'can_view_prices': False
        }
    
    if current_user.role == 'admin':
        return {
            'can_equipment': True,
            'can_maintenance': True,
            'can_separation': True,
            'can_tours': True,
            'can_scanner': True,
            'can_financial': True,
            'can_users': True,
            'can_view_prices': True
        }
    
    if current_user.role == 'tech_responsible':
        from models.user import TechnicianAccess
        tech_access = TechnicianAccess.query.filter_by(
            user_id=current_user.id,
            status='active'
        ).first()
        
        if tech_access and tech_access.is_valid:
            return {
                'can_equipment': tech_access.can_equipment,
                'can_maintenance': tech_access.can_maintenance,
                'can_separation': tech_access.can_separation,
                'can_tours': tech_access.can_tours,
                'can_scanner': tech_access.can_scanner,
                'can_financial': False,
                'can_users': False,
                'can_view_prices': False
            }
        return {
            'can_equipment': True,
            'can_maintenance': True,
            'can_separation': True,
            'can_tours': True,
            'can_scanner': True,
            'can_financial': False,
            'can_users': False,
            'can_view_prices': False
        }
    
    if current_user.role == 'tech_tour':
        return {
            'can_equipment': False,
            'can_maintenance': False,
            'can_separation': False,
            'can_tours': True,
            'can_scanner': True,
            'can_financial': False,
            'can_users': False,
            'can_view_prices': False
        }
    
    return {
        'can_equipment': False,
        'can_maintenance': False,
        'can_separation': False,
        'can_tours': False,
        'can_scanner': False,
        'can_financial': False,
        'can_users': False,
        'can_view_prices': False
    }


def admin_required(f):
    """Apenas admin pode acessar"""
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        if not current_user.is_authenticated:
            return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))
        if current_user.role != 'admin':
            flash('Acesso restrito a administradores.', 'danger')
            return redirect(url_for('dashboard'))
        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function


def admin_or_tech_required(f):
    """Admin ou Técnico Responsável podem acessar"""
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        if not current_user.is_authenticated:
            return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))
        if current_user.role not in ['admin', 'tech_responsible']:
            flash('Acesso restrito.', 'danger')
            return redirect(url_for('dashboard'))
        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function


def permission_required(permission_name):
    """Decorator genérico para verificar permissão específica"""
    def decorator(f):
        @wraps(f)
        def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
            if not current_user.is_authenticated:
                return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))
            
            permissions = get_user_permissions()
            if not permissions.get(permission_name, False):
                flash('Voce nao tem permissao para acessar esta funcionalidade.', 'danger')
                return redirect(url_for('dashboard'))
            return f(*args, **kwargs)
        return decorated_function
    return decorator


def can_view_prices(f):
    """Injeta variável para templates verificarem se pode ver preços"""
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function


def hide_prices_for_non_admin():
    """Helper para templates verificarem se deve ocultar preços"""
    if not current_user.is_authenticated:
        return True
    return current_user.role != 'admin'


def inject_permissions():
    """Context processor para injetar permissões em todos os templates"""
    if current_user.is_authenticated:
        return {'user_permissions': get_user_permissions()}
    return {'user_permissions': get_user_permissions()}
```
